raw.description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous models and hardware. The General Capabilities team is developing the science that makes that possible: a principled, evidence-based method for building agentic systems automatically.

We are hiring for several positions on this team through one application. Depending on your background, you will work on our agent runtime, on evaluation, or on automated agentic system optimisation. We are looking for experienced systems engineers and researchers. Since we are an interdisciplinary team, we expect depth in one area and a willingness to work across the others.

What You'll Build

Depending on the position, you will work on some of the following:

  • Design and build stateful, asynchronous agent runtimes across distributed environments

  • Develop clear Python APIs, libraries, and DSLs with stable extension points for tools, backends, and new execution models.

  • Develop evaluation and observability tooling for long-horizon, tool-using agents.

  • Research methods that improve agents automatically, such as program search, routing, context management, multi-agent collaboration and post-training.

  • Work with our infrastructure teams to optimise agents for cost and latency on heterogeneous hardware.

What Sets You Apart

We are seeking candidates with demonstrable experience in one or more of these areas:

  • Experience building runtimes, workflow engines, distributed systems or developer frameworks that other engineers adopted.

  • Deep familiarity with the internals of SGLang, vLLM or comparable inference serving frameworks: scheduler design, memory management and execution pipelines.

  • Depth in multi-agent systems, program synthesis, or evolutionary and LLM-driven search over programs and agents, including systems that run the research loop themselves.

  • Experience with RL or post-training for long-horizon, multi-step or tool-use tasks.

  • Evaluations, benchmarks or agent harnesses you built that other people went on to use.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

  • Equity & Ownership

  • Private healthcare

  • We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

raw.title: Transactional Financial Controller
raw.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Transactional Finance (AP, Billing and Credit control) Management

  • Full management of the Accounts Payable and Billing and Credit control functions, including team leadership, prioritisation and quality control.

  • Oversight of all banking and expense transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate controls.

  • Own working capital management, including planning and execution of payment runs.

  • Implement and manage the Purchase Order (PO) system end-to-end, liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure compliance and efficient processing.

  • Act as the escalation point for AP, Billing and Credit control queries, both internal and external, ensuring timely and professional resolution.

  • Oversee & drive DSO performance improvement, setting and monitoring cash collection targets and driving corrective action where collection is behind plan by using escalation channels with various business stakeholders

  • Overseeing the review AR ledgers regularly, identifying and escalating aged debt in line with credit control policy.

  • Line-manage direct reports based in Portugal & London, while providing day-to-day supervision and quality oversight of AP, Billing and Credit Control activity across the UK, Portugal, and Spain.

  • Partner with the Director of Financial Control and wider Finance team on reporting, audit requirements and process governance.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

  • Support along with Finance Transformation the finance systems automation roadmap, driving the elimination of manual processes and delivering scalable, efficient finance operations.

  • Own the optimisation of the finance systems landscape, reviewing and enhancing NetSuite integrations with Moss, Precoro, Abacum, Salesforce and QV to ensure scalability, data integrity, and accurate revenue recognition.

  • Drive continuous improvement of finance system integrations and workflows, proactively identifying and resolving issues to enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Lead the transformation of Billing and AP processes through enhanced controls, automated workflows, invoice validation, credit management, supplier remittance optimisation, and customer communications.

  • Drive continuous improvement of transactional and billing processes, with a focus on automation and efficiency gains.

  • Supporting with Finance Transformation the rollout of a unified Source-to-Procure (S2P) solution — consolidating procurement, support ticketing, contract management, and expense reimbursement into one platform to improve control and user experience

  • Ensure alignment between NetSuite financial reporting (Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet) and Abacum planning and forecasting models to provide consistent financial insights across the business.

  • Establish and maintain effective finance systems governance through the optimisation of user roles, permissions, access controls, and segregation of duties.

  • Partner with Finance, Technology, and Business stakeholders to ensure finance systems effectively support commercial growth, operational excellence, and evolving business requirements.

COMPETENCIES

  • Team management: Experience managing a team, delegating effectively and developing (5) direct reports.

  • Stakeholder management: Able to build relationships and influence across Finance, Technology & product and the business stakeholders.

  • System expertise: Strong proficiency with NetSuite, Salesforce, Moss, Precoro, Abacum and Banking tools.

  • Finance foundations: Solid grounding in financial operations, accounting and finance principles.

  • Problem-solving: Able to troubleshoot system issues and implement effective solutions.

  • Attention to detail: High accuracy in managing data integrity and financial records.

  • Technical & analytical skills: Understanding of databases and being able to analyse processes and data flows to optimise system performance.

  • AI: High level of proficiency in Claude, Gemini

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Project management: Experience managing system implementations, upgrades or process improvement projects.

  • Prioritisation: Ability to manage competing priorities between multiple scopes.

  • 'Professional qualification: ACA/ACCA/CIMA (or equivalent) qualified accountant, with strong grounding in financial controls and reporting.'

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: People Team Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Team Call: Experience (60 mins)

  • Step 3: Technical Task In-Person (60 mins)

  • Step 4: Exec Call (60 mins)

  • Step 5: Values Interview (45 min)

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
raw.description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING

We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Cloud & Platform Engineering
    • Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
    • Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
    • Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
    • Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud Security 
    • Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
    • Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
    • Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
  • Technology leader
    • Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult's global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
    • Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to  infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
    • Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
  • Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
  • Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
  • Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
  • Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
  • Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In 6 months time…

By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult's infrastructure.

  • Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
  • Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
  • Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
  • Have a full understanding of Catapult's products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.

In 12 months time…

By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult's technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.

  • End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
  • Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
  • Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
  • Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

raw.title: Senior Agent Harness Engineer
raw.description:
About us:

Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes.

We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making.

Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence. 

About the team

We’re hiring AI engineers to help us transform research outcomes in biomedical sciences. We utilise generative AI and agents to help scientists find novel connections and insights from biomedical literature and datasets.

Delivering a faster research experience is not just a matter of picking the latest LLM model. Getting accurate, scientifically relevant, trustworthy and meaningful results relies on building trust with our users that comes from integrating proper levels of guardrails, biomedical curation, consistent update cycles and robust deployment practices that make our platform a one-stop shop for a researcher’s needs.

We’re looking for AI engineers who will champion this cause and help us apply AI to transform the way biomedical professionals carry out their research and day-to-day exploration.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design and implement AI agents end-to-end, from the first idea to deployment and monitoring, balancing cutting-edge techniques with pragmatism to deliver measurable impact.

  • Apply strong software engineering principles, such as modularity, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and observability, to ensure AI systems are reliable, maintainable, production-ready and can be readily adapted to future developments.

  • Choose the right approach for the problem at hand, evaluating different models, prompts, tools and agent designs to balance trade-offs between speed, cost, complexity, interpretability, and performance.

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to scope work, align on success metrics, and incrementally ship improvements in user-facing features powered by AI.

  • Document system architectures and decision rationale early and clearly, enabling alignment across teams and accelerating onboarding and iteration.

  • Champion model and data quality, including robust evaluation, hallucination checks, and real-world performance tracking.

  • Mentor junior AI engineers and cross-functional teammates, sharing best practices in modelling, coding, maintaining and integrating product features, and helping grow a high-trust, high-performance team culture.

  • Stay up-to-date with emerging research and tools, distilling key insights and bringing back relevant innovations to elevate team capabilities and product opportunities.

  • Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, through company-wide Slack channels, Show and Tell presentations and technical deep-dives.

What experience you’ll need to be successful

  • A master's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience building software in production environments, including LLM-based systems, with ownership of key lifecycle stages: design, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Proficiency in Python and modern agentic frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, with experience integrating LLMs into applications.

  • A solid understanding of LLMs and agents, including topics such as tool use, context management, prompt engineering and evals.

  • Strong software engineering foundations such as version control, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, containerization plus a mindset of building for reliability and scale.

  • Experience working in product-focused teams, collaborating with designers, engineers, and PMs, to scope and ship AI features iteratively

  • Ability to reason about system behaviour end-to-end, including model performance, latency, and observability, and how these impact user experience.

  • Clear, structured communicator, comfortable documenting and defending architectural decisions and engaging in thoughtful technical debate.

Not required, but it’s a plus if you also have:

  • Experience with LLMOps frameworks and best practices

  • A PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • A background or work experience in life-sciences, health-tech, or other data-intensive domains

Benefits

💰 Competitive compensation package

🩺 Private medical & dental insurance

📔 Life insurance (4 x salary)

🤓 Personal development budget

🧘 Individual wellbeing budget

🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

🥳 Your birthday off!

 

🚀 Potential to have real impact and accelerated career growth as a member of an international team that's building a transformative AI product.

We are on a mission to accelerate scientific breakthroughs for ALL humankind, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and fairly consider qualified candidates without regard to race, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, genetics, age, religion or belief, marital/civil partnership status, domestic / family status, veteran status or any other difference.

raw.title: Corporate Tax Services - Senior Manager
raw.description:
About CFGI:
 
Corporate Finance Group, Inc. (“CFGI”) was founded in 2000 by former Big 4 professionals. CFGI is an established industry leader with the resources to successfully navigate today’s complex accounting, reporting, compliance, and tax landscape. An assemblage of top-flight professionals with in-depth public accounting expertise, CFGI can fulfil a variety of client needs without the restrictions of auditor independence. With a foundation of knowledge amassed while serving a variety of industries, CFGI can guide companies through a wide range of routine and complex business scenarios. The resulting partnership is an innovative resource with the power to address our clients’ most crucial accounting, finance, and operational challenges.
 
We provide our clients with a unique combination of integrity, flexibility, creative solutions, and deep tax technical expertise. Many of our clients are global, market leading, publicly held companies, while others are privately held, early stage, or venture-backed emerging businesses. Here at CFGI, we place a high value on a culture of continued learning, where teamwork is encouraged, and professional excellence is rewarded. 
 
 Overview of role:
 
CFGI seeks a highly motivated tax manager to join its UK tax team. This role will provide a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is driven, entrepreneurial and constantly looking to challenge the status quo around the UK tax services industry.
 
You will be involved in all aspects of UK corporate tax (reporting, compliance, governance and advisory) and will have direct interaction with both our clients and senior members of the UK tax team in order to deliver these services. 
 
1.     Client service delivery      
 
a)     Tax reporting:
 
You will be involved in the delivery of UK tax reporting services to our diverse client base, which includes the following:
 
·       UK publicly listed companies.
·       US headquartered multinationals (including US listed groups).
·       UK privately owned and private equity backed groups.
 
The exact scope of tax reporting work for our clients will vary but is likely to include the following:
 
·       Preparation of UK entity only tax numbers in accordance with IFRS or UK GAAP.
·       Preparation of UK group tax numbers, likely to involve the incorporation of tax numbers for non-UK subsidiaries, GAAP-to GAAP adjustments (e.g. US GAAP to IFRS) and consolidation adjustments.
·       Advising on client’s tax reporting processes.
·       Advising on the tax aspects of GAAP conversion projects.
·       Advising on the tax reporting (and other) aspects of IPO readiness.
 
b)    UK corporation tax compliance:
 
You will be involved in the preparation and submission of UK corporation tax returns for our clients. This will involve you leading the day-to-day interaction with our clients to obtain all the information required to complete and file their returns in a timely manner. Whilst a formalized compliance process is in place, you will have a good degree of autonomy to manage the process in your own way, albeit with a focus on ensuring that our tax compliance offering is high quality, efficient and cost effective for our clients.
 
c)     Tax governance
 
You will be involved in the delivery of our tax governance proposition to clients, advising on tax strategy, risk management and controls.
 
d)    Tax advisory
 
You will be involved in tax advisory work likely to include the following:
 
·       Ad hoc corporate tax advisory work originating from compliance engagements – e.g. loss planning and utilization, tax implications of trade and asset transfers, interest deductibility.
·       Cash tax modelling exercises.
·       Group simplification exercises.
·       Tax due diligence for client transactions.
·       Tax structuring for client transactions.
 
2.     Business development
 
As CFGI is looking to rapidly expand in the UK, there will be plenty of opportunity to get involved in business development activities, including the following:
 
·       Assisting with the origination of tax opportunities on new and existing clients, drafting of proposals and involvement in the sales process (e.g. meetings, pitches, etc.).
·       Teaming with colleagues from other CFGI UK and US service areas (e.g. accounting advisory, business transformation) to identify and propose tax opportunities.
·       Teaming with the CFGI US tax team to support with and identify UK tax opportunities on US clients.
·       Identifying additional revenue streams with our clients.
 
Skills and Competencies:
 
Knowledge:
 
·       Experience of UK tax reporting processes.
·       Knowledge of tax reporting IFRS and UK GAAP; high level understanding of US GAAP desired but not essential.
·       Experience of the UK tax return preparation process, and good technical understanding with common tax adjusting items such as capital allowances and other incentives, interest deductibility, hybrid mismatches, loss utilisation etc.
·       Experience of responding to and managing HMRC tax enquiries.
·       Knowledge / an appreciation of cross-border tax matters would be highly desirable, e.g. transfer pricing, country by country reporting etc.
 
Skills:
 
·       Experienced with using Microsoft Excel and tax software packages i.e. OneSource.
·       Demonstrated ability to effectively present information and appropriately respond to questions from clients and team members.
·       Excellent organizational skills, ability to multi-task, and work under deadlines.
·       Excellent analytical, supervisory, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills are necessary.
·       Demonstrated ability to be accountable for independently completing assignments.
·       Capable of collaborating and communicating with people of different technical backgrounds and roles.
·       Analytical ability to navigate work-related situations with practicality, sound reasoning, and demonstrating creativity in problem solving.
·       Other key characteristics: the ideal candidate must demonstrate integrity and accountability, always remaining flexible, adaptable, and willing to accept coaching, building and managing professionally healthy relationships, and continually developing awareness of business-related topics.
·       As an entrepreneurial business you will be working with a growing team and with a range of service lines and so a desire to collaborate and work cross service line will be important. 
 
 Qualifications:
 
·       Three to five years of corporate tax experience with some/all of this time ideally spent in the Big 4.
·       Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA) required; additional tax qualification (e.g. CTA) strongly desired.

raw.title: Finance & Accounting Advisory - Managing Director
raw.description:
Managing Director – Finance & Accounting Advisory

At CFGI, Managing Directors serve as key leaders in our organization, working closely with C-level executives at FTSE 100, mid-cap and start-up companies. As a Managing Director, you will take ownership of client relationships, drive engagement success, and play a pivotal role in the firm’s business development and growth strategies.

Take ownership of your career at CFGI: 

  • Lead high-impact engagements across various industries and complex accounting topics.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to clients, providing expertise in technical accounting, transaction support, and regulatory reporting.
  • Build and manage long-term client relationships and expand CFGI’s market presence.
  • Drive firm initiatives, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor high-performing teams.

What you might expect:

  • Interact with clients’ executive team and auditors, serving as a subject matter expert, leading clients through complex accounting issues and driving conclusions.
  • Lead and oversee all aspects of client engagements, from scoping to execution, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.
  • Drive client deliverables of financial and regulatory information in accordance with regulatory requirements.
  • Drive business development initiatives by identifying new client opportunities, maintaining strong industry relationships, and actively participating in firm-wide growth strategies.
  • Mentor and develop professionals at all levels, fostering a culture of integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.
  • Develop and enhance the firm’s training programs, providing guidance on new accounting standards and best practices.

Who you are:

  • An undergraduate degree in Accounting – ACA, ACCA, CPA and/or MBA combined with solid accounting experience will be considered in lieu of a degree in accounting.
  • 14+ years of experience in accounting, finance, or consulting, including tenure at a Big 4 accounting firm.
  • Outstanding interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with an ability to assimilate easily into teams.
  • Strong technical skills and a working knowledge of IFRS, UK GAAP and US GAAP.
  • Proactive in identifying client needs and effective in building a strong relationship with clients.
  • Highly organized and focused and demonstrates the ability to set overall engagement expectations and direction.
  • Effective analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Entrepreneurial nature, self-motivated, ethical, and dependable.
  • High energy with commitment to quality client service, focusing on ensuring positive resolutions to conflicts.
  • Consistently seek opportunities to enhance your skills by attending higher-level training, develop firm training materials and enhance overall firm knowledge base.

raw.title: Financial Due Diligence - Director
raw.description:
Transaction Advisory Services: Financial Due Diligence - Director

CFGI, founded in 2000 by former Big 4 professionals, is a dynamic and fast-growing financial consulting firm serving as a trusted partner to CFOs and their organisations. We help clients tackle complex challenges across accounting, financial reporting, transactions, regulatory compliance, tax, and business transformation.

We blend deep technical expertise with a hands-on, entrepreneurial approach to help leading public, private, private equity-backed, and emerging companies move forward with confidence. Without the restrictions of auditor independence, our professionals have the flexibility to provide practical, creative solutions to complex business challenges.

We are actively expanding our Transaction Advisory Services practice in the UK and are seeking an experienced Director to lead complex buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements. Directors serve as trusted advisors to senior client stakeholders, oversee multiple engagements, develop client relationships, contribute to business development, and help drive the continued growth of CFGI’s Transaction Advisory Services practice.

What you might expect:

  • Lead complex buy-side and sell-side transaction advisory engagements, providing financial and business due diligence support to private equity firms, strategic buyers, and corporate clients.
  • Analyse and oversee the analysis of target company financial information to identify historical and projected operating trends, quality of earnings and assets, pro forma financial information, working capital considerations, debt and debt-like items, and other potential liabilities or risks.
  • Advise clients on financial matters that may impact transaction valuation, deal structure, negotiations, and overall transaction execution.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for clients throughout the transaction process and build trusted relationships with private equity sponsors, portfolio company executives, corporate development teams, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Lead and coordinate multiple complex engagements simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting transaction deadlines.
  • Manage and coordinate CFGI engagement teams, clients, and third-party diligence providers throughout the transaction lifecycle.
  • Review and approve financial analyses, due diligence workpapers, client-ready reports, and executive-level presentations.
  • Oversee engagement planning, staffing, project economics, risk management, and overall client delivery.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop Senior Managers, Managers, and Consultants through technical leadership, coaching, and professional development.
  • Contribute to proposal development, client relationship management, networking, cross-selling, and broader business development and practice growth initiatives.

 

What you must have:

  • At least 12 years of experience in assurance and/or transaction advisory within a Big 4 firm.
  • Professional services experience, including experience leading complex client engagements.
  • Exposure to private equity transactions, including experience working with private equity clients and/or their portfolio companies.

 

What sets you apart:

  • Experience leading buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements.
  • Experience analysing and advising clients on quality of earnings, working capital, debt and debt-like items, cash flow, historical and projected financial performance, and other transaction-related financial considerations.
  • Experience serving as a senior advisor to private equity sponsors, portfolio company executives, strategic buyers, and corporate clients throughout the transaction lifecycle.
  • Strong current knowledge of IFRS, UK GAAP, and/or other accounting principles relevant to transaction advisory engagements.
  • Experience leading client presentations and delivering executive-level financial due diligence reports and transaction recommendations.
  • Experience managing multiple engagement teams while overseeing staffing, engagement economics, quality, risk management, and client delivery.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills used for financial modelling and data analysis, including PivotTables, lookups, arrays, Power Pivot, Power Query, and related functionality.
  • Experience developing long-term client relationships and contributing to business development through proposals, client expansion, networking, cross-selling, and other revenue-generation activities.
  • Experience mentoring and developing transaction advisory professionals and contributing to the growth of a practice or team.

 

Nice to have:

  • ACA, ACCA, CA, or another relevant professional accounting qualification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience across both assurance and transaction advisory engagements.
  • Experience with mergers and acquisitions, carve-outs, post-close integration planning, or other complex transaction environments.

 

Who thrives here:

  • Outstanding interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to build credibility with senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Proactive in identifying client needs and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities with sound judgement in complex transaction environments.
  • Highly organised with the ability to lead multiple engagements, teams, and competing priorities.
  • Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, adaptable, ethical, and dependable.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transaction environment where workload may increase around critical deal deadlines.
  • High energy with a commitment to exceptional client service, practice growth, and talent development.

VAT – Senior Manager

Join a new and entrepreneurial VAT practice where you will have a genuine opportunity to help build something from the ground up.

As a VAT Senior Manager, you will support in the growth of our VAT practice, combining deep technical VAT expertise with client ownership, project leadership and assisting with business development. You will help shape our client offering, propositions and ways of working as the practice develops.

The work is varied and no two days are quite the same. You could be leading advice on a complex cross-border supply chain matter, overseeing a client’s VAT compliance challenge, developing a new opportunity or helping shape the future direction of the practice.

This is an opportunity to have a real voice in a growing practice. You will have significant autonomy to take ownership, develop areas of expertise and influence how we deliver VAT services, while working closely with experienced senior members of the team.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Support and oversee the delivery of complex UK and international VAT advisory and compliance engagements, providing technically robust, practical and commercially focused advice.
  • Support and oversee a varied portfolio of VAT work, determining the appropriate approach, managing delivery and identifying wider risks, opportunities and solutions for clients.
  • Support the development of CFGI’s VAT technology capability, including ERP systems, tax engines, digital reporting, automation, AI and agentic workflows, and help shape how technology is embedded into the client offering.
  • Proactively contribute on business development activity, identifying new opportunities, developing client propositions and contributing to the growth of the VAT practice.
  • Help shape the future direction of the practice, including its propositions, processes and ways of working.
  • Work closely with senior members of the team to develop the practice and identify opportunities across the broader CFGI offering.

What you must have

  • At least 9 years of VAT advisory or compliance experience gained within a professional services environment, or through a combination of practice and in-house roles.

What sets you apart

  • Strong technical VAT knowledge across UK and international VAT matters, with experience advising on complex issues.
  • Experience working across complex VAT engagements and managing delivery across multiple workstreams or stakeholders.
  • Proficient in translating complex technical VAT matters into clear, practical and commercially focused advice.
  • Having worked on a varied portfolio of advisory and compliance work and determining appropriate approaches to client challenges.
  • Willingness to contribute to the development of new propositions, processes or ways of working.

Nice to have

  • Broad international indirect tax experience.
  • Experience across both professional practice and an in-house environment.

Who thrives here

raw.title: Client Account Executive - Financial Services
raw.description:
Job Title: Client Account Executive - Financial Services

Location: United Kingdom

The Chainalysis Private Sector team helps financial services organizations understand blockchain activity, manage financial crime risk, and adopt digital assets with confidence. In the UK, we work with banks, fintechs, payments businesses, and digital asset companies to address compliance, fraud, and investigation needs. Our Account Executives combine market knowledge, clear storytelling, and a consultative approach to build trusted customer relationships.

As a Client Account Executive, you own new business and account expansion across an assigned portfolio of UK financial services prospects and customers. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Regional Sales Director, Private Sector (Financial Services), NEMEA. You lead complex enterprise sales cycles, build relationships with senior stakeholders, and translate customer priorities into clear business cases for Chainalysis solutions. We measure your success through quota attainment, forecast accuracy, and growth across your accounts.

In this role, you'll:

  • Meet and exceed your assigned quota through new customer acquisition and expansion within existing UK financial services accounts.

  • Create and execute territory and account plans that prioritize opportunities, map decision-makers, and define a clear path to revenue growth.

  • Build and qualify your pipeline through strategic prospecting, referrals, and collaboration with Sales Development, Marketing, and partners.

  • Own enterprise sales cycles from discovery and solution evaluation through business case development, procurement, negotiation, and close.

  • Build trusted relationships with compliance, financial crime, fraud, risk, investigations, technology, and executive stakeholders, tailoring your approach to their priorities.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and other specialists to connect customer needs with the right solutions and deliver compelling presentations, demonstrations, and proposals.

  • Maintain accurate Salesforce records and revenue forecasts, identifying deal risks early and defining clear next steps for each opportunity.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to support the transition after a sale, understand customer outcomes, and identify opportunities to expand adoption.

  • Share UK market insight and customer feedback with Product and Marketing to improve positioning, inform account strategies, and strengthen customer conversations.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings and relevant industry events, building relationships that generate referrals and new opportunities.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • A record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota in enterprise B2B technology or SaaS sales, with success in both new business and account expansion.

  • Strong knowledge of the UK financial services market and experience selling to banks, fintechs, payments businesses, or other financial institutions.

  • Experience independently managing complex enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, formal procurement processes, and senior decision-makers.

  • The ability to understand compliance, financial crime, fraud, or risk priorities and translate them into a clear, commercially relevant business case.

  • A disciplined approach to territory planning, prospecting, pipeline qualification, and account development.

  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in an approachable way and engage executive audiences.

  • Strong negotiation skills and commercial judgment, with a record of building trust and securing customer commitments.

  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM to maintain accurate opportunity records and deliver reliable revenue forecasts.

  • The ability to collaborate across sales and customer teams, learn technical concepts, and travel for customer meetings and industry events.


Nice to have experience:

  • Experience selling financial crime analytics, fraud prevention, RegTech, or blockchain intelligence solutions.

  • An established network of UK financial services contacts, particularly in compliance, financial crime, fraud, or risk.

  • Knowledge of digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain use cases in banking and payments.

  • Familiarity with UK digital asset regulation, AML/KYC obligations, or FATF guidance. You do not need to be a blockchain expert, but you should be curious and ready to learn.

 
 

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. Some of the ways we’re ensuring we keep learning are an internal Diversity Committee, Days of Reflection throughout the year including International Women’s Day, Harvey Milk Day, World Humanitarian Day, and UN International Migrants Day, and a commitment to continue revisiting and reevaluating our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. Additionally, if you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

Location: United Kingdom

The Chainalysis Private Sector team helps financial services organizations understand blockchain activity, manage financial crime risk, and adopt digital assets with confidence. In the UK, we work with banks, fintechs, payments businesses, and digital asset companies to address compliance, fraud, and investigation needs. Our Account Executives combine market knowledge, clear storytelling, and a consultative approach to build trusted customer relationships.

As a Client Account Executive, you own new business and account expansion across an assigned portfolio of UK financial services prospects and customers. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Regional Sales Director, Private Sector (Financial Services), NEMEA. You lead complex enterprise sales cycles, build relationships with senior stakeholders, and translate customer priorities into clear business cases for Chainalysis solutions. We measure your success through quota attainment, forecast accuracy, and growth across your accounts.

In this role, you'll:

  • Meet and exceed your assigned quota through new customer acquisition and expansion within existing UK financial services accounts.

  • Create and execute territory and account plans that prioritize opportunities, map decision-makers, and define a clear path to revenue growth.

  • Build and qualify your pipeline through strategic prospecting, referrals, and collaboration with Sales Development, Marketing, and partners.

  • Own enterprise sales cycles from discovery and solution evaluation through business case development, procurement, negotiation, and close.

  • Build trusted relationships with compliance, financial crime, fraud, risk, investigations, technology, and executive stakeholders, tailoring your approach to their priorities.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and other specialists to connect customer needs with the right solutions and deliver compelling presentations, demonstrations, and proposals.

  • Maintain accurate Salesforce records and revenue forecasts, identifying deal risks early and defining clear next steps for each opportunity.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to support the transition after a sale, understand customer outcomes, and identify opportunities to expand adoption.

  • Share UK market insight and customer feedback with Product and Marketing to improve positioning, inform account strategies, and strengthen customer conversations.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings and relevant industry events, building relationships that generate referrals and new opportunities.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • A record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota in enterprise B2B technology or SaaS sales, with success in both new business and account expansion.

  • Strong knowledge of the UK financial services market and experience selling to banks, fintechs, payments businesses, or other financial institutions.

  • Experience independently managing complex enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, formal procurement processes, and senior decision-makers.

  • The ability to understand compliance, financial crime, fraud, or risk priorities and translate them into a clear, commercially relevant business case.

  • A disciplined approach to territory planning, prospecting, pipeline qualification, and account development.

  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in an approachable way and engage executive audiences.

  • Strong negotiation skills and commercial judgment, with a record of building trust and securing customer commitments.

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. raw.title: Senior Data Scientist
raw.description:
Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and creating products that build trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization who thrive on the challenging work we do and doing it with other exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry changes constantly, and our job is to create user-facing products supported by our best-in-class data, allowing us to adapt to those rapid changes and bring maximal value to our customers.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Research and Intelligence organisation in London. You'll sit within the Wallet Intelligence Research team focussing on one of the most critical and important data sets in the company and help maintain and build it out through investigative research, behavioral heuristics, graph algorithms, and machine learning techniques. Much of what we work on is state of the art, and often ahead of academia, and your work will directly shape the data that fuels Chainalysis' products and customers across the globe.

This role is ideal for someone who is energised by deeply technical, ambiguous problems at the intersection of data science, graph computation, and on-chain investigation, and who wants to take ownership of projects end-to-end.

In this role, you'll:

  • Own the execution of one or more production data science projects, translating broad problem statements into well-scoped tasks and credible analytical results that meet stakeholder expectations.

  • Design, develop, and validate novel behavioral heuristics and algorithms over blockchain data to attribute on-chain activity and uncover new insights.

  • Apply advanced techniques including graph computation, statistical modeling, and machine learning to large-scale on-chain datasets.

  • Identify and resolve inefficiencies in code, methodology, and workflows; ensure your work integrates cleanly into our production data and tooling stack.

  • Clearly articulate and defend methodology and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, maintaining alignment through consistent communication.

  • Mentor junior team members, contribute to technical hiring, and share knowledge.

  • Collaborate closely with peers to bring research from prototype to production.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field – or equivalent industry experience working on advanced, data-intensive problems.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL, with a track record of writing clean, testable, production-quality code using agentic workflows.

  • Demonstrated experience applying advanced analytical techniques (e.g. graph algorithms, ML, statistical inference) to large, messy datasets.

  • Comfort working with blockchain data, or strong evidence of the aptitude to ramp up quickly on blockchain data structures and protocols.

  • A demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects: decomposing requirements, driving them to completion, and proactively seeking clarity from stakeholders.

  • An analytical, open-minded approach to problem solving – comfortable navigating ambiguity and willing to dive into problems outside your day-to-day scope.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex methodology to diverse audiences.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Databricks, DBT, Spark/PySpark, or similar large-scale data platforms.

  • Experience modifying infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform) or contributing to production data pipelines.

  • Experience mentoring junior data scientists or engineers.

  • Knowledge of, or passion for, the cryptocurrency and blockchain space.

raw.title: Founding Product
raw.description:
Building a More Resilient World

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Founding Product to own our internal product - the AI systems and tools our claims teams use every day to handle claims faster and better.

  • You’ll own the internal product roadmap - decide what we build next based on what matters most to our claims teams and our operational goals, and make sure it ships and gets used.

  • You’ll be the bridge between engineering and the people using what they build - translate what claims handlers need into clear requirements engineering can execute against, and translate technical capability back into something non-technical teams can actually use.

  • You’ll make impact measurable, not assumed - track usage, gather feedback, and flag when a feature or automation isn’t landing the way it should, before it becomes a bigger problem.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a tight-knit team that genuinely enjoys building this together, and we think you’ll feel that from day one.

Who You Are

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resume. You might come from a product management, product operations, or technical program management background - what matters is you can sit between a technical team and a non-technical one and make both sides successful.

  • Strong understanding of how AI/agentic systems actually work - enough to have a real conversation with engineers, even if you’re not writing the code yourself

  • Excellent at translating technical capability into plain language - you can explain what a feature does and why it matters to someone with no technical background

  • Structured and process-minded - you can prioritise, scope and plan a roadmap, not just react to the loudest request



Our Values

 

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

 

Compensation & Benefits

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • Skilled Worker visa sponsorship

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 30 days of remote work annually

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • Company offsites

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Compensation: £80K – £140K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

raw.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're looking for a Finance Director to lead our finance team at Codat. You'll own the numbers from start to finish: the plan, the monthly close, the board pack and the conversations with our investors.

This is both a hands-on role and a senior role. You'll have one direct report and still do plenty yourself: one day you'll be taking the board through the forecast, and the next you'll be sorting out a payroll query or approving expenses. You'll report to the Chief Legal and Business Officer and work closely with the leadership team on where we spend money and why, and you'll be the person who tells us when the numbers don't support a plan.

What You'll Work On

  • Budgeting, forecasting and cash. You'll build the annual and longer-range plan with budget holders across the business, keep the forecast current and track how we're doing against it. You’ll also own cash flow forecasting and runway, plus headcount planning with the people team.

  • Board and investor reporting. You'll prepare the board pack, covering ARR, unit economics and customer metrics, and the analysis investors and advisers need.

  • The month-end close, management accounts and statutory consolidation across our UK and US entities, including intercompany. You'll also run the annual audit to sign-off and own our technical accounting positions, such as revenue recognition and share-based payments.

  • Group tax and compliance across the UK and US, and our relationships with auditors, tax advisers, lawyers and banks.

  • ARR and revenue modelling. You’ll partner with the team to ensure our commercial reporting keeps pace as the business evolves, covering the impact of product and pricing changes, and the bridge from ARR to recognised revenue. You’ll also work with the commercial team on pricing and contract terms, and what they mean for revenue recognition and billing.

  • Day-to-day finance operations: You’ll work alongside our Senior Finance Manager on AP, AR, billing, payroll and expenses, and share the operational load rather than just overseeing it. , The finance systems stack. We want finance to need less manual work every quarter, and automation and AI tools are part of how we'll get there.

  • A small finance team. You'll set their priorities and help them grow.

You'll Probably Have

  • A professional accounting qualification: ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent.

  • Held a senior finance role at a fast-growing, VC-backed tech or SaaS business, ideally across more than one entity and country. You've sat in board meetings and answered investors' questions yourself.

  • Experience in international tax compliance or managing tax advisers across jurisdictions.

  • A good grasp of SaaS metrics and revenue recognition, and the ability to explain them to people outside finance.

  • Stayed close to the detailed work as you got more senior. You're as comfortable building a model as you are closing the books.

  • The confidence to challenge senior people when the numbers call for it. If the data says a plan won't work, you'll say so.

  • Experience managing a small team and helping them grow.

  • AI is already built into how you work. You’ve used automation and AI to change how a finance function runs, not just to speed up the odd task. You can show us a process or system you’ve rebuilt and what it changed for the team.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather make a sound decision quickly and adjust it than wait for perfect information. What you own is yours from start to finish.

We operate hybrid working but without strict mandates on how many days. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would.

raw.title: Senior AI Engineer
raw.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers would rather spend time with clients than dig through the books to find out what's changed. We're building this for them.

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. A banker can ask it anything about a client and get an answer from that client's actual books. If they don't ask, it tells them anyway when something important changes, and suggests what to do.

It's a senior role and a hands-on one. Bankers make real decisions based on what the assistant says, so impressing people in a demo isn't enough. It has to be right. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves, with agents handling the repetitive work so engineers can focus on the hard problems. You'll build what you design and look after it once it's live, and you'll have a real say in where we take it.

What You'll Work On

  • The reasoning layer. What goes into the model's context, which tools it calls, and when it should break a question into steps. Every number it gives has to trace back to a source, and it needs to know when to say it doesn't know. That last part is harder than it sounds.

  • Evals. You'll build the eval sets and harness, and do the analysis that tells us whether a change made the assistant better or just different. When a banker corrects an answer, that correction becomes a new test case.

  • Model choice and token economics. Which model should handle which job, and what that costs us per answer. Caching or a smaller model is often enough. For some questions a banker needs the strongest model available, and that's worth paying for.

  • The semantic and signal layers. You'll work on both with the data engineers. That means the definitions the model is allowed to use, and the signals that spot when something changes for a client. How the model uses them is down to you.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. This covers the tools the assistant can call, including the ones that will eventually let it draft that email. You'll work out how they break, and add the tracing we need to see what happened inside an answer.

  • Classical modelling where it beats an LLM. Anomaly detection, peer benchmarks, classifiers. Sometimes the best answer is a simple statistical model, not an LLM.

You'll Probably Have

  • Shipped LLM features that people actually used, and been the person they came to when something broke. You've designed how a model works with tools or structured data, and there are things you'd do differently now.

  • Built evals for your own work, and probably had one mislead you. We'd like to hear what you changed.

  • A feel for numbers, whether that comes from a quantitative degree or from your work. You want the denominator before you believe a percentage, and you notice when a headline figure is really about the mix of the data.

  • Opinions about models that come from using them. You've chosen between models on how well they did and what they cost, and you know when a classical model would do a better job.

  • Good engineering habits in Python or another general-purpose language. That means tested, modular services rather than notebooks. Strong SQL as well, and some experience with CI/CD, Docker, cloud (we're on Azure) and tracing for LLM systems.

  • Led work without having the title. People followed an approach you set because you made the case with evidence, and you can explain the trade-offs to someone who isn't technical.

  • AI as part of how you work, for research and prototyping as well as code.

  • Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark or Databricks; semantic layers or metric views; fine-tuning.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how you knew it worked than in a perfect match.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.
