raw.title: Network Production Engineer
raw.description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

raw.title: Director of Data Analytics
raw.description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

Fractile designs chips and systems that are manufactured, tested and assembled by a global network of subcontractors. The Director of Data Analytics owns how that data reaches Fractile and how it is handled, stored and processed so the business can turn it into actionable intel.

You will set up the data pipes to our subcontractors, build full chip-to-system genealogy to provide full system traceability and integrate cleansed supplier data into the Fractile ERP system. The result is the data framework behind real-time product WIP reports, raw material inventory levels and product cost variance reporting.

What the role entails

Manufacturing and test data

• Set up and run secure and resilient data pipes to global subcontractors to gather and organise all real-time manufacturing data and complex production test data.

• Define data standards, formats, delivery schedules and quality checks with each subcontractor, and hold them to those standards.

• Build tools and maintain data stores and backups that hold this data in a consistent and cleansed form to enable fast and accurate analysis.

Traceability and genealogy

• Build full chip-to-system genealogy flows: every chip, package, board, chassis and rack system connected and traceable through each assembly and test step.

• Provide exact and live traceability through serialisation so that any unit can be traced back to its components, lots, processes and test results.

• Build databases so traceability can be queried by engineering, operations, quality and customer support.

ERP data integration and cleansing

• Integrate and cleanse chip-to-system data into the Fractile ERP system from supplier B2B reports to enable real-time lot and yield tracking.

• Maintain bill of materials (BOM) and build standard management to ensure consistency between Fractile and supplier ERP and PLM tools.

• Own the data flow for purchase orders and invoice matching, so that orders, receipts and invoices reconcile.

• Build tools and capabilities to calculate and track product cost variances and alert the team of trends and deviations.

• Set the data quality rules, validation and exception handling that keep ERP data accurate.

Reporting and analytics

• Generate automated reports for real-time product WIP reports and raw material inventory levels, including calculations of working capital and inventory financial exposure levels and risk to business.

• Provide the data framework for product cost variance reporting to provide guidance for standard cost adjustments on a monthly and quarterly basis.

• Work with manufacturing operations, finance, supply chain and engineering to define the business metrics needed to monitor company health and deliver them in the form of automated reports and dashboards.

Team and ways of working

• Build and lead a small team of data engineers and analysts in a timely manner to support the growth of the business and the increases in data management needs.

• Work multi-functionally to set the architecture, tooling, documentation and security practice for Fractile's operational and financial data.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Proven experience leading data engineering or analytics for hardware, semiconductor and electronics manufacturing within a complex global supply chain.

• Experience building secure data pipelines and integrations with external partners, including overseas contract manufacturers and test houses.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing and test data, and of production flow traceability and genealogy.

• Hands-on experience integrating data into an ERP system, and working knowledge of BOMs, WIP, inventory, procure-to-pay and book-to-bill processes.

• Strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern data platforms, data modelling and data quality tooling.

• Experience building reports and dashboards to enable knowledge-based decisions.

• Ability to work with suppliers across time zones and to set standards that they follow.

Desirable

• Experience in a fabless semiconductor or AI hardware company.

• Familiarity with OSAT, wafer test, final test, CM and system assembly and test flows.

• Experience with standard cost and cost variance analysis.

• Experience building a company-wide data function from the ground up in an early-stage company.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

raw.description:
Location: Oxford, London or RTP (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

Role Purpose

A genetic association tells you where in the genome a disease signal lives. It doesn’t tell you why. That’s the question you’ll answer.

As a Scientist in Functional Genomics, you’ll turn genetic associations into biological understanding. You’ll work out which genes and variants are likely to be causal, and through which cell types, tissues and pathways they act. The Life Sciences team then uses that to triage targets and build the evidence behind a development programme. Your work will span the therapeutic development cycle, from target discovery to patient stratification and finding new uses for existing drugs.

This is an early-career role in a highly collaborative team. You’ll have the support to develop and run innovative, rigorous science, and the visibility to share it with internal and external stakeholders.

A Day in the Life

  • Prioritising causal variants and genes at disease-associated loci, bringing together statistical fine-mapping, colocalisation with molecular QTLs (eQTL, pQTL), functional annotation and variant-to-gene evidence

  • Mining our in-house data resources alongside single-cell, bulk expression, epigenomic and proteomic datasets to understand the causal biology of diseases with unmet need

  • Triaging and ranking potential targets, and telling programme teams honestly how strong (and how limited) the genetic evidence is

  • Writing reproducible, well-documented code and methods that feed into the growth of our technology

  • Presenting your findings, in writing and in person, to colleagues and partners at every level of seniority

Who You Are

You’ll bring:

  • A PhD in a quantitative discipline

  • Solid foundations in genetics and molecular biology

  • Solid foundations in statistics (modelling, regression)

  • Statistical programming in Python or R

  • Clear spoken and written communication, the ability to manage your own objectives and deliver on time, and a team-player mindset that puts your work in the bigger picture

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • A broad range of statistical genetics approaches (GWAS, colocalisation, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomisation, polygenic risk scores)

  • Experience with functional genomic data (eQTL/pQTL resources, single-cell or epigenomic data, CRISPR screens)

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high-dimensional statistics and causal inference

  • Software engineering practices (Git and GitHub, testing, documentation, agentic coding, containerisation)

  • Reproducible pipelines (WDL, Snakemake or Nextflow) and cloud or trusted research environments (DNAnexus, Verily Workbench)

  • Methods development within statistical genetics

Genetic analyses are only as good as the definitions of disease they’re built on. Get the phenotype wrong and everything downstream wobbles.

As a Scientist in Clinical Informatics, you’ll define, curate and validate phenotypes from electronic health records and other clinical data. You’ll join the Life Sciences team, which tackles challenges across the therapeutic development cycle, from target discovery to patient stratification and finding new opportunities for existing drugs.

raw.title: Electrical Integration Engineer
raw.description:
At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

About the Role

The Electrical Integration Engineer owns the electrical interface between the Hive autonomy system and each customer vehicle. This person designs robust, serviceable electrical integrations suitable for demanding industrial environments.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze existing vehicle electrical architectures and interfaces.

  • Design vehicle wiring harnesses, power distribution, grounding, protection, and I/O circuits.

  • Select connectors, cables, fuses, relays, contactors, and other electrical components.

  • Define electrical interfaces between Hive hardware and OEM vehicle systems.

  • Design CAN physical connections, termination, isolation, and signal protection.

  • Produce schematics, harness drawings, connector tables, BOMs, and installation documentation.

  • Validate voltage drop, power quality, continuity, grounding, and communication integrity.

  • Support electrical safety reviews and fault analysis.

  • Lead electrical bring-up and troubleshooting on customer machines.

  • Guide technicians through harness assembly, installation, testing, and rework.

  • Improve reusable electrical integration standards and components.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with automotive, off-highway, robotics, industrial, or vehicle electrical systems.

  • Experience designing wiring harnesses and low-voltage power distribution systems.

  • Strong understanding of connectors, grounding, shielding, circuit protection, and EMC practices.

  • Experience with CAN and J1939 physical interfaces.

  • Proficiency with electrical CAD and harness design tools.

  • Hands-on experience with multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and CAN tools.

  • Ability to troubleshoot electrical systems directly on vehicles.

  • Experience producing release-quality drawings, BOMs, and build documentation.

  • Willingness to travel regularly and work in customer facilities.

raw.title: Strategic Account Manager
raw.description:
At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The Role

A European building materials group has agreed with Hive at CEO level to roll out supervised autonomy across its quarries. Pilots are running, and the agreement covers around 80 sites in several countries over the next years.

The signed agreement is where your work starts. Head office has said yes, but every site still has to: the plant manager, the safety team and the production planner. You get each site commercially ready before our Delivery team arrives, and you decide with the customer in which order sites go live.

This role sits between Sales and Delivery. Account Executives land new customers. Delivery installs and runs the machines. You own the rollout inside the accounts that have already signed at group level, starting with this one and followed by the next global customers.

Nobody has held this job at Hive before. How you run this account becomes how Hive runs every global account after it.

What You Will Do

Own the rollout plan

  • Build the site by site rollout plan with the customer's executive sponsor.

  • Sequence the rollout against what Hive can actually deliver, and defend that sequence to the customer and internally.

  • Get each site to yes on its own numbers.

Build the business case per site

  • Set the commercial terms per site inside the frame agreement: KPI thresholds, scaling estimates, exit criteria and pricing.

  • Find the value beyond labour cost, such as pit design, shift patterns and production planning, and build the case the plant director takes to their board.

Run the relationship

  • Keep the stakeholder map current in every country, from the group executive sponsor to the site supervisor.

  • Run the governance: monthly with the customer's programme owner, quarterly with their executive sponsor, weekly with Hive's Delivery lead.

  • Hand each site over to Delivery once it is scoped, then move to the next.

Build the model

  • Carry customer requests into Product and Engineering, and push back on the ones that are not worth building.

  • Document how Hive runs a global account, and hand it to the person who takes the next one.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • You have run a multi-site or multi-country programme, either on the vendor side or as the customer's programme owner.

  • You have owned a number on an account: revenue, margin or a rollout target.

  • Experience building business cases and working with both executive teams and site operations.

  • Industrial context: construction, quarrying, mining, building materials, infrastructure or process industry.

  • Highly structured, and comfortable owning the details over a long programme.

  • You have told a customer no on scope, price or date, and kept the relationship.

  • A life situation that allows heavy travel in the UK and Europe.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Strongly Preferred

  • Operations or strategy consulting experience with industrial or infrastructure clients.

  • Experience from a large construction or building materials company.

  • French or German.

This Is Probably Not the Job for You If

  • You want to recommend and move on. Site 40 in year three is part of the job.

  • You need a delivery organisation that hits every date. Ours is young, and you will be the one explaining a slip to the customer.

  • You want a pure sales role. Landing new logos belongs to the Account Executives.

What Success Looks Like

  • The first sites are past pilot, in contract and running, and the next batch is commercially ready before Delivery gets there.

  • The customer's executive sponsor holds a written rollout plan with dates and KPIs, and treats it as theirs.

  • Every site that went live did so on terms that make money for Hive.

  • Hive has a documented way of running a global account, in use on the second one.

raw.title: Engineering Lead (Drivers & Delivery)
raw.description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for an Engineering Lead to head up HIVED's Driver Squad: the team that owns everything between a parcel leaving our depot and arriving at the customer's door.

We build the strongest possible driver population, identifying our best drivers, making performance transparent and helping our operations teams reward and retain them. raw.description:
Hi 👋 I’m Dom Allgood, Client Education Manager at hyperexponential. I joined four years ago as a Curriculum Developer and have spent the last couple of years growing Client Education into the (soon to be) five-person team it is today. Before hx I spent a decade teaching Computing in secondary schools. Outside of work most of my time goes to my two children, and what's left to running and, more recently, mountain biking - where I'm still very much a beginner.

Client Education exists to get our customers to value as quickly as possible, and to keep them there. We run instructor-led training, own hx Academy where all our self-paced learning content lives, own the certification programme, and run some of our customer events. We've also recently taken ownership of Developer+, and that's where this role comes in. Our first customers are working through the programme now, and as it grows it will need to evolve based on what we learn from them.

This isn't a typical Delivery Engineer role, you'll sit in Client Education rather than Delivery Engineering. You'll still work closely with the wider Delivery Engineering team, but your day to day is the customers on Developer+: delivering workshops, running drop-ins, reviewing their code, and shaping the programme around what you learn doing it. You'll partner with Product too, so customers can adopt new enhancements quickly and smoothly. There's no established playbook for this yet, so what matters most is the drive to build one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to own, I'd love to hear from you.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes, like whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We’re already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Delivery Engineering team

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that). We specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries.

What you'll be doing

  • Move customer teams from hx-led build to independent delivery, shifting effort from pairing toward review and advisory.

  • Keep every engagement moving to its prescribed path, sequencing services to each customer's build stage.

  • Deliver structured enablement sessions; architecture, coding best practice, testing and deployment, model lifecycles.

  • Run code review as a consistent, standards-anchored service, evolving hx's model development standards where reviews expose gaps.

  • Provide drop-in support shaped by each customer's build stage, resolving most issues in session rather than escalating.

  • Make Developer+ repeatable rather than personality-dependent, documenting delivery and using AI to scale capacity.

  • Convert delivery knowledge into hx Academy content, prioritised by what reviews and drop-ins actually surface.

  • Act as the technical voice of the customer into Product, feeding back recurring friction on a regular rhythm.

What you'll need to have done

  • Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments, including testing, deployment and model lifecycles.

  • Have excellent pricing and modelling judgement when working with customer’s - working with insurance & actuarial teams is a plus.

  • Developed strong technical enablement instincts, pitching sessions and documentation at the audience's real level.

  • Coached customer teams to work independently rather than solving problems for them.

  • Operated with high ownership and self-direction, building repeatable process where none exists.

  • Prioritised transparently across competing delivery, review and content demands.

  • Communicated with credibility and clarity across developers, actuaries, delivery partners and internal stakeholders.

How we build in an AI-forward company

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

raw.description:
Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Our Team's Vision:

Illumio’s Sales team is building the next chapter of cybersecurity by helping organizations contain breaches, stop lateral movement, and build cyber resilience across hybrid, cloud, endpoint, and critical environments. We partner with some of the world’s most complex enterprises to connect Illumio’s breach containment platform to measurable business outcomes—from ransomware containment and Zero Trust Segmentation to application visibility, cloud modernization, and resilience in the AI era.

By joining our high-growth Sales organization, you will work alongside driven, collaborative professionals who are passionate about helping customers reduce cyber risk and protect what matters most. Our team brings curiosity, accountability, and executive-level storytelling to every customer conversation, helping organizations understand their environments, prioritize risk, and take action before attacks become cyber disasters. If you are motivated by meaningful customer impact, continuous growth, and the opportunity to help define the future of breach containment, Illumio is the place to build your next chapter.

Your Impact:

  • Be responsible for partner relationship, management, education and execution of Illumio programs within defined GSIs partners across South EMEA.

  • Evaluate and manage new strategic business opportunities and initiatives within your partners to create compelling joint offerings.

  • Exceed your assigned quota across new licence subscriptions, support, subscription renewals and professional services, through both channel partners and Global Systems Integrators (GSIs).

  • Build a healthy pipeline of new and expansion opportunities through resellers, GSIs and consulting partners.

  • Own the full partner lifecycle within your territory across South EMEA: recruitment, onboarding, relationship management, education and running Illumio programmes.

  • Build and implement technical and sales readiness plans that enable partners to position, sell and deliver Illumio solutions.

  • Develop compelling joint offerings and services with GSI and consulting partners, and evaluate new strategic business opportunities, initiatives and alliances.

  • Lead the joint partner planning process to agree mutual performance objectives, financial targets and critical milestones.

  • Help set channel direction and plan and deliver territory business objectives.

  • Run programmes that keep partners and customers informed about upcoming events, campaigns, promotions and communications.

  • Assess, clarify and validate partner needs to keep partner satisfaction high.

  • Act as the first point of escalation for channel conflict and related business issues.

  • Carry out channel market analysis and monitor competitor activity across the territory.

Your Toolkit:

  • 8+ years' experience in channel or partner management, including work with GSIs and consulting partners.

  • Excellent knowledge of reseller, systems integrator and consulting ecosystems, and experience working within them.

  • Cyber security and/or network security experience.

  • A proven track record in sales and partner management.

  • Experience presenting to and engaging with people at all levels, including delivering enablement training.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth and rapidly changing environment.

  • A willingness to travel.

#LI-SL1 #LI-HYBRID

Our Commitment

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

raw.title: Backend Engineer - Acquisition Technology
raw.description:
Backend Engineer - Acquisition Tech - DE

Hybrid in London or remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer

You'll be the first engineer on the German side of Acquisition Tech, owning the customer acquisition systems that decide which small businesses iwoca reaches and how they convert.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Acquisition Tech team owns how iwoca reaches German small businesses – across paid advertising, SEO, social media, direct mail, and outbound sales – and how they become customers. The data and models behind every channel sit with the team.

You'll report to the engineering lead for iwoca's German market, based in London alongside the rest of the technical team. Day to day you'll work with a product manager and a data scientist in London, plus commercial strategy, marketing, and sales – some of whom sit in Germany.

You'll be the only engineer on the German side of acquisition, working in iwoca's UK Acquisition Tech team's codebase. You'll work with their engineers on code reviews and design decisions.

The role

You'll build the backend behind iwoca's German acquisition technology – building on what already runs in the UK, and creating what Germany needs of its own.

  • Ownership. You'll own the German side of the acquisition stack – from the lead-value signals iwoca sends to ad platforms, to the bidding and attribution built on them – and decide what to build from scratch.

  • Technical strategy. You'll help shape the long-term roadmap. The team sets commercial objectives; you’ll shape the architecture, scaling, and technical direction.

  • Funnel optimisation. You'll work with marketing and data science to target relevant businesses across paid search, direct mail, and outbound sales, and to convert more of them once they arrive. You'll integrate third-party APIs to minimise friction in sign-up and improve the lead data behind every channel.

  • Data engineering. You'll build the pipelines, databases, and REST APIs behind the acquisition stack, plus the HubSpot tooling the sales team use.

The team

The Ledger Platform team is rebuilding all of iwoca’s ledgers as one platform, starting with the ledger for the business credit card. Every card payment, loan repayment, and payout will end up there. Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets rely on that record, so it has to be right every time.

The team is small – a principal engineer who leads it, a staff engineer, another engineer, and you. It works closely with the product teams that build on its ledgers, and with Finance.

The role

You'll lead projects from design to production, and decide with product what the team builds and how. With the principal engineer, you'll design the platform's service boundaries and the APIs and event streams other teams build on. Most of the platform is still to be built, and you’ll own part of it yourself. It’s a hands-on individual contributor role with high ownership and no line management.

Every payment a small business makes with iwoca crosses several services and network hops before it reaches the ledger, and any of them can fail. You'll build services that record each one exactly once, with no single point of failure, safe timeouts and retries, and graceful degradation when a dependency is down. When something breaks in production, you'll fix it so it doesn't break again.

You’ll learn iwoca’s financial products in depth, so you can challenge requirements and explain technical trade-offs to Finance. When the answer isn’t obvious, you’ll scope and prototype, and use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem. You’ll influence which parts of a problem need solving now, which can wait, and which aren’t worth solving at all.

  • New ledgers. Building the ledgers for Flexi-Loan and iwocaPay.

  • Account migration. Moving existing loan accounts onto the new ledgers with zero downtime and no data lost.

  • Credit card ledger. Building new features for the credit card ledger, from real-time card holds to daily interest and monthly statements.

  • Funding facilities. Recording how loans move between iwoca’s funding facilities.

  • Distributed systems. You’ve built and run fault-tolerant services in production, and handled the hard parts: durable communication between services, idempotency, transactional correctness, and partial failure.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it.

  • Databases. You’ve worked in depth with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, and solved data integrity, concurrency, and performance problems in them.

  • Ownership. You’ve led projects involving several engineers end to end, and mentored the people around you.

  • Testing. You’ve tested for edge cases and failures as carefully as you designed for them.

  • AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • High volume. You’ve worked at a company where the volume of data or transactions shaped how you designed systems.

  • Migrations. You’ve moved live systems and data onto a new platform with zero downtime.

  • Python. You’ve used Python in production, with a web framework such as Django, FastAPI, or Flask. It’s the language the team works in.

Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place.
We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution.
Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures.

Why join us:
You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work.


About the role
We’re seeking a driven and commercially minded Account Executive to join our UK team. We're rebuilding our go-to-market around accountancy, financial institutions and corporates, and now we need someone exceptional to grow our customer base.

You'll be based in our London office, selling to professional services firms, financial institutions and large corporates across the UK and Europe. This role comes with real responsibility, real earning potential, and a team that is fully invested in helping you succeed.

About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

About the Role

A career-defining opportunity to be the founding Sales Leader for Juicebox’s London office, our second office and first in Europe, reporting directly to the VP of Sales.

This role will be responsible for overseeing and developing our growing London Account Executive team, driving new logo growth, and helping establish our sales presence in Europe. You’ll partner closely with GTM cross-functional peers, as well as the founders, to help scale Juicebox into its next chapter.

This is both a tactical and strategic role. You’ll work directly with reps on pipeline management, deal execution, forecasting, coaching, customer meetings, and sales strategy, while also helping build and adapt our GTM motion for the European market.

We’re looking for builders who are motivated to elevate the GTM craft within one of the fastest growing AI companies. As our first Sales Leader in Europe, you’ll have a meaningful role in shaping our London team, culture, and how we grow in the region.

You Will

  • Lead and develop our growing team of Account Executives in London

  • Own your Business: Pipeline Generation, Forecasting, Deal Execution, Team Performance

  • Set the Pace: Create a rhythm on your team complete with 1:1s, team meetings, deal reviews, coaching/development and more

  • Build the Business: Establish playbooks, sales motions, and systems/processes alongside key peers in Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Sales Development, Marketing and more. Play a key role in establishing the culture and operating standards of our first European office

  • Build in Europe: Help establish our sales motion in a new market, bringing what works from our US business while adapting where needed for European customers

  • Get Creative: We’re always looking for fresh perspectives to scale our business effectively, and fast!

You Have

  • 5–7+ years of experience in SaaS sales environments, 2–3+ in leadership

  • Comfortable scaling within early-stage or high-growth startup environments

  • Experience selling into the UK and/or European market

  • Low-ego: we have too much to do with too little time

  • Intellectually curious; you chase big questions and come up with unique solutions

  • High performance and people oriented

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-moving environments

  • AI fluent and enthusiasm for modern GTM tooling

  • A strong communicator who can motivate and develop high-performing teams

  • Are based in London or open to relocating (in-office 5 days/week)

Bonus Points If You…

  • Have helped launch or scale a new market, geography, or office

  • Have helped build a European sales team for a US-based technology company

  • Experience helping scale a company from Series B through later growth stages

  • Background at companies known for strong product-led or modern GTM cultures

  • Strong opinions around sales tooling, systems, and GTM infrastructure

Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees

  • Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

  • Daily meals provided: breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

For US Employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

  • $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • $300/month commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

For UK Employees:

  • Comprehensive private medical insurance with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.

  • £1,500 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being

  • £3,500/year commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

Reporting To: Client Support Lead

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

raw.description:
IAM Staff Engineer

Location: London, Bristol or Edinburgh

Level: PL1

Team: Security

Contract: Permanent

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

 

You’ll be joining the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, which sits within the Cyber Security squad in the Kaluza technology community, working hand-in-hand with security engineering as well as with Kaluza’s architecture team and technical leaders across our software engineering community. Your initial focus will be on our product IAM space, covering authentication & authorisation services that ensure the appropriate accesses are permitted on the Kaluza retail platform, whether that’s human or machine. The role will broaden over time to encompass our enterprise IAM and PAM solutions which protect us as a business, enabling us to better align these two aspects of IAM in use across Kaluza.

 

With millions of customers across multiple geographic regions, we naturally invest significant effort into availability, performance, security and observability, and the teams pride themselves on their ability to maintain a balance between rapid development of new services, iterative quality & feature enhancements alongside being highly responsive in incidents.

What will I be doing?

 

  • Collaborate with technical, product leadership to help shape and continuously improve our IAM technical strategy and solutions architecture

  • Lead the team hands-on in resolving complex technical issues, evaluating technical options, designing services and scoping engineering work

  • Work with client engineering teams to help them understand our IAM architecture and how to get the most out of our platform

  • Take the lead on evolving our identity and access best practices across engineering, proactively helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

  • Use your deep understanding of the IAM domain to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza as well as client teams

  • Mentoring and coaching engineers within the IAM space, helping them balance risk with speed and quality

  • Continuously improve quality across reliability, observability, functional and non-functional testing as well as development processes and documentation

  • Horizon scanning for emerging technologies and approaches to IAM, enabling Kaluza to continue to evolve, keeping us ahead of adversaries as well as cost-effective

What you will bring

 

  • Good experience of both mentoring engineers as well as developer collaboration (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Developing, testing, deploying and maintaining quality SaaS APIs in AWS

  • Working with (and continuous improvement of use with) fundamental DevSecOps engineering elements such as CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure As Code, Kubernetes containerization and platform health alerting & monitoring

  • Application of basic modern identity & access management techniques and standards, such as OAuth2.0 or SAML2.0

  • Integrating an IdP into services to enable SSO and/or federated identity

  • Use of encrypted JWTs as part of an OIDC-compliant user authentication flow and/or creating policies in an RBAC and ABAC environment

  • Experience of applying AI to your own work as well as enabling others to safely build it into their development ways of working

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent solutions, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Experience of applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex domain/environment

  • Experience of being a senior subject matter expert in operational incidents

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

Leadership, quality & delivery

You’ll be…

  • Proficient at applying your technical and commercial knowledge to a risk based approach, taking the lead on assessing current and future technology and designs

  • A pragmatic decision-maker who takes into account the technical & commercial costs and consequences of those decisions

  • Skilled at identifying new or improved ways of working and driving efficiencies

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements within the platform to balance meeting information security and commercial goals

  • Accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, using a mixture of communications skills

  • Skilled in bringing alignment, clarity of thought and direction to information security, product and engineering challenges

  • Able to establish a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and champion alignment to that vision across multiple teams.

  • Experienced in fostering a culture of learning and improvement, challenging engineering leadership to better support this

 

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a trusted technical contributor within our team, helping deliver impactful sales engagements through configuration and development in our demo environments. You’ll play a contributor role to larger deals, and often lead pre-sales activities for smaller or less complex opportunities. You are a key part of the commercial engine, helping us scale by ensuring our technical pre-sales efforts are thorough, accurate, and client-focused.

This role will report to the Head of Sales Engineering and you’ll be part of a team that works on sales to Kaluza’s largest clients globally. You will have broad expertise on Kaluza’s product suite and our value differentiators and will develop depth in particular areas of our products. You will have a good understanding of the challenges facing energy retailers from a client or user perspective and be able to show-case how our solutions solve them.. 

You will play a crucial role in building product demonstrations and collateral that evangelises the Kaluza platform.

  • Own and deliver demo activities for small to mid-size opportunities, especially during high team capacity periods. This includes configuring and delivering tailored product demonstrations and responding to client technical questions with clarity and confidence.

  • Support technical delivery on complex deals, working alongside senior team members to prepare solution configurations, contribute to discovery conversations, and ensure client requirements are well captured and translated.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to scope solutions, validate feasibility, and communicate trade-offs in a clear and client-friendly manner.

  • Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, ensuring they reflect client needs and demonstrate our platform’s ability to deliver measurable outcomes. Track PoC success criteria and highlight risks or gaps to the wider team.

  • Represent the Pre-Sales function in internal planning and alignment sessions, helping ensure technical accuracy, smooth handovers, and clear documentation for post-sale teams.

  • Document and share learnings from client engagements, including product feedback, recurring questions, and potential areas for improvement in our pre-sales approach or demo assets.


What you’ll bring 

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Software development experience in a regulated industry using TypeScript, with a track record of designing and building complex solutions to customer problems

  • Experience architecting solutions on AWS, knowing which technologies to use when and the trade-offs involved

  • Confidence working with and explaining event-driven architectures and asynchronous APIs

  • Experience in a commercial or client-facing technical role, ideally selling SaaS in a regulated industry, with examples of adapting a solution to meet a customer’s unique needs

  • The ability to distil complex concepts into clear, simple points, and to work through differing opinions with empathy

  • Comfort working autonomously across multiple opportunities, handling ambiguity and knowing which data to use to measure success

An interest in renewable energy and the challenges facing energy retailers will help you hit the ground running.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

● Location: UK Hybrid (London, Bristol, Edinburgh)

● Level: C3

● Team: Engineering Experience & AI Foundations

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll be joining the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation. As a collective we strive for engineering greatness and support others to deliver engineering best practice with every commit.

In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in architecting and evolving our Internal AI engineering platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll be building the infrastructure—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows supporting the ways users interact with LLMs — that empower our software teams to move faster and more securely.

Our tech stack is very fluid, but broadly you can find yourself working with: LLMs (Claude, GPT, etc.), writing & deploying custom tools (APIs, user-interfaces, custom agents, bots), AWS, Kubernetes, MCP servers, Typescript, Scala, Go,, and modern observability tools.

Key responsibilities include:

  • AI Foundations & Tooling: Design, plan, build and evolve our AI platform foundations and tooling. This includes the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC) and associated infra, AI Governance layer (MCP & LLM gateways), introducing and evolving shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards.

  • AI Tooling Eval & Deployment: Support the trials, evaluation and deployment of next-generation engineering tools keeping Kaluza at the forefront of new technologies in the fast moving AI space.

  • Agentic SDLC: Working with different stakeholders and disciplines to build and evolve the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework and get it into the hands of our Engineering teams helping everyone adopt the best practices of those at the forefront of agentic tooling. Taking learnings and feedback from engineers/ stakeholders, coupled with metrics and advances from industry and applying them to improve and scale our software development capabilities safely and securely.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Security & Usage Optimization: Partner with security and operations teams to ensure our AI usage reinforces our security safeguards and maximise our investments.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Systems Thinker: You possess a solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems and understand how to integrate third-party AI APIs (like Claude or OpenAI) without compromising system reliability or latency.

  • LLM know-how: You have extensive experience working with LLMs and kept pace with developments and trends in the space such as prompt, context and harness engineering as well as experience of multi-agent systems, evals / LLM-as-a-judge test suites.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance: You understand the risks of AI (data leakage, prompt injection) and can design approval processes and security guardrails that protect the business without slowing down innovation.

  • Data-Informed: Comfortable authoring and interpreting metrics to help guide work, inform priorities, measure success —like tracking AI-generated code volume or PR velocity—to prove the value of the tools you deploy.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity: The AI landscape changes weekly. You are motivated to continuously trial new tools and aren't afraid to pivot when a better solution emerges.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

  • Technical Direction & Architecture: Drive the architecture and technical roadmap for our EngEx & AI Platform Foundations team, including the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC), the AI governance layer (MCP and LLM gateways), and shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. Shape and document build-vs-buy decisions and balance fast-moving vendor capabilities against long-term platform stability.

  • Hands-On Delivery: Stay close to the implementation. Design, build and ship core platform components, set the engineering bar through your own code, and prototype new approaches to prove them before the team scales them.


  • Agentic SDLC (KASF) Adoption: Drive KASF from early adoption to all engineering teams during 2027. Oversee creation and evolution of reference architectures, standards and adoption playbooks, work with engineering leaders to embed KASF in how teams plan, build, review and ship, and use feedback and metrics to remove blockers.

  • AI Tooling Evaluation & Deployment: Lead structured, time-boxed trials of emerging engineering tools with clear success criteria and go/no-go recommendations. Keep Kaluza at the forefront of the AI space while retiring tools that don't earn their place.

  • Governance, Security & Risk: Act as the technical authority on AI risk for engineering. Work with Security, Legal and Data Protection to design approval processes and guardrails (data leakage, prompt injection, model access) that protect the business without slowing innovation.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Cost Optimisation: Partner with Finance and Security to keep AI usage secure and cost-efficient at scale, including guardrails and unit economics for model spend.

  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical standard of the team and the wider engineering community. Influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and build a network of AI champions in engineering teams. Pragmatic and open-minded and able to see things from different perspectives with both technical and non-technical cohorts.

About You

raw.description:
Location: Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: C1

Team: Client Support

Salary: £30,400 - £45,600 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Client Support Lead

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

 

You’ll work mainly on the Kaluza Energy Retail platform, a single-instance SaaS platform built for scale and technical quality. It’s the foundation for our customers’ decarbonisation work, and we’re now moving it to a multi-tenant, international-ready model so we can take on new challenges and external customers. This is a technical role, so you’ll need to pick up new and existing technologies quickly.

 

  • Triage and prioritise support tickets from retailers’ agents based on impact and urgency, using Jira as our service desk tool, and deliver first-time fixes for repeat issues.

  • Be the go-to person for impact assessments and root cause analysis. You’ll identify affected accounts or processes and recommend technical fixes through the Kaluza incident process.

  • Use sources such as Databricks, Jira and Google Data Studio to spot trends, measure the impact of issues and diagnose the root cause of client tickets.

  • Act quickly to stop incidents from getting worse, and support our Problem and Incident Managers throughout the lifecycle of an incident or problem.

  • Raise high-quality incidents and problem candidates for product teams, and work with them to get updates and solutions back to customers.

  • Manage internal and external stakeholders, setting clear expectations, giving timely updates and working to team KPIs.

  • Help define what a great Service Desk looks like at Kaluza.

 

This role includes a place on a 24/7 on-call rota, one week at a time.


What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

 

  • Experience in the energy industry in the UK, Belgium or France.

  • Experience investigating support issues and identifying root causes and affected accounts or processes.

 

Ideally, you’ll have:

 

  • Experience in a service desk, technical support or similar role, triaging and prioritising tickets using Jira or a similar tool.

  • Basic Python scripting skills and experience working with APIs.

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude in your day-to-day work.

  • Experience supporting incident and problem management processes (e.g. ITIL)

  • Experience analysing data with SQL, using tools such as Databricks.

Tech stack: Jira, Databricks, SQL, Python, Google Data Studio

 

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.
