raw.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
raw.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role:

  • We are looking for Mid-Market Account Executives.

  • This role is focused on selling into global mid-market businesses with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions.

  • Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works.

  • Our mid-market motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations.

  • You will be responsible for driving high six-figure opportunities and are confident that we will close the first 7 figure deals this year through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Our targets call for millions of additional ARR over the next year. You will play a major role in that.

Important to Know:

  • Hours - This will be an exciting but intense job. Kernel is growing extremely fast and hours can often be long. Many of our customers are on the West Coast, and meetings can be held late in the evening.

  • Working location - Minimum 4 days a week in the London office (most people do 5). There will be international travel involved for this role in visiting prospects.

Responsibilities:

  • You’ll manage complex sales cycles with some of the best mid-market businesses out there, from mid six-figure through to seven-figure+ deals.

  • Multi-thread within accounts and build executive-level relationships, including VP and C-level stakeholders.

  • Most opportunities will be sourced for you by the SDR team and Growth team, however sourcing additional pipeline is expected.

  • You’ll collaborate with the wider team on GTM strategy as we expand our ICP & experiment in other verticals.

  • You’ll help to create our sales processes as you build them.

  • You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining & pitching the product.

  • You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customer success, bringing in insights from across the company and performing an essential part of our product feedback loop.

Your Traits:

  • Entrepreneurial: creative, resourceful.

  • Executive presence: You are comfortable engaging VPs, CROs, CIOs, and senior RevOps leaders.

  • All-in: hard-working, excited to stretch yourself, willing to take out the trash.

  • Clear thinker, good writer: you can crisply articulate your ideas, goals, and plans and help our customers make sense of hairy consulting-like problems.

Essential Qualifications:

  • 2-5 years of experience.

  • At least 1 year consistently closing deals worth $50k+/year in a multi-stakeholder sales process, consistently hitting six- to seven-figure targets.

  • Ability to execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology (MEDDPICC).

  • Track record of consistent over-achievement in past sales roles.

  • Ability to discuss technical concepts with prospective customers and translate requirements into a demonstrable product.

  • Comfort negotiating and navigating contracts, security and legal discussions without support.

  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.

Nice-To-Have:

  • Startup/scale-up experience is a plus.

  • Experience selling to Revenue Operations, GTM and/or Sales teams.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £110k-£140k OTE + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

Interview Process

Stage 1 – 30-minute intro call with Talent Partner. You’ll discuss your sales experience and motivations.

Stage 2 – 1-hour interview with Head of Sales. You’ll deep dive into your experience, sales targets & achievements, and Mid-Market AE at Kernel.

Stage 3 – Discovery role play (≤ 2 hours prep).

Final Stage – Founders interview with Anders (CEO) for culture and values alignment.

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

raw.description:
DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit)

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (HFT), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge



The role
About Credit Desk

In our Credit & On-Chain Liquidity team, we design strategies and deploy capital across decentralized lending protocols, managed vaults, and credit facilities. Operating at the intersection of quantitative finance and smart contract technolgy, the Credit Desk is responsible for optimizing yield, evaluating counterparty and protocol risk, and deploying programmatic credit solutions across digital asset markets. As a Credit Desk DeFi Quant Trader Intern, you will work directly with quant traders and credit strategists to build quantitative risk models, automate yield harvesting, analyze on-chain liquidity pools, and evaluate DeFi protocol mechanics.

Key Responsibilities of a DeFi Quant Trader intern in this unit

  • On-Chain Risk & Credit Modeling: Develop and refine quantitative risk models to assess protocol health, collateralization ratios, liquidation risks, and smart contract vulnerability exposure across DeFi credit platforms.

  • Yield Optimization & Execution: Build Python-based tools and algorithmic models to analyze real-time yield curves, liquidity pool depth, and funding rate arbitrage across lending and borrowing protocols.

  • Data Analytics & Monitoring: Query on-chain data, EVM event logs, and lending protocol data using SQL, Subgraphs, and Python to generate actionable insights for credit positioning and risk allocation.

  • Protocol Due Diligence & Forensics: Perform quantitative forensics and stress testing on emerging lending primitives, liquid staking protocols, and structured credit products prior to capital deployment.

Who You Are/Key Requirements

  • Technical & Quantitative Skills: Strong code-first foundation in Python, familiarity with Rust with Solidity as a plus. Understanding of smart contract mechanics and DeFi primitive mathemtaics (including propAMMs, lending pool utilization curves, liquidation thresholds).

  • Quantitative & Trading Mindset: Rigorous background in a quantitative field (Math, Physics, CS, Finance, or Engineering) with a systematic/trading mindset. Ability to model yield dynamics, credit risk, backtesting strategies, and protocol insolvency scenarios.

  • DeFi “Skin in the Game”: Hands-on experience interacting with decentralized lending protocols (e.g., Aave, Morpho, Compound, Maker/Endgame), yield aggregators, or credit markets.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Familiarity with Rust, Solidity, Foundry, or specialized credit risk models and backtesting frameworks.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

https://keyrock.com/careers/

    • Hands-on design

  • Step into critical product or brand work to unblock the team or cover gaps.

    •  

    Must haves / Skills & Experience
  • 8+ years in design, with 3+ years leading designers, ideally across product and brand/marketing design.
  • Strong product design portfolio for complex B2B / data-heavy software; credible graphic design / brand sensibility.
  • Experience managing a distributed, multi-disciplinary team and working with freelancers.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders in Product, Tech and Marketing and to make decisions in ambiguity.
  • Fluent with Figma and design systems; comfortable with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Able to start in January 2027, with a handover period before the leave begins.

  • Experience in fintech, data, maritime, energy or commodities.
  • Experience designing a B2C mobile app.
  • Experience working through a brand refresh.
  • Accessibility knowledge (WCAG / VPAT).

raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

The Commodities Tribe builds the systems that turn fragmented maritime, cargo and market data into a real-time view of how commodities are moving around the world. Our platforms process complex and often incomplete data at scale, powering products, APIs and analytical workflows used by customers and internal experts to understand global trade. 

As a Engineering Manager, you will lead teams at the centre of this domain as we modernise a business-critical platform and move towards a more modular, scalable and AI-native architecture. You will be responsible for building a high-performing and sustainable engineering environment: developing people, improving delivery, strengthening operational ownership and enabling Technical Leads and senior engineers to make strong technical decisions. The role is well suited to either an existing Engineering Manager or an experienced Technical Lead or senior engineer ready to take their first formal step into management.


Your mission is to
  • Guide the teams through the platform transformation, helping engineers understand, influence and adopt the new direction.
  • Partner with Product and domain stakeholders to shape the roadmap around customer value, data quality and business outcomes.
  • Develop Technical Leads and senior engineers, delegating decisions to the people with the strongest context while keeping accountability clear.
  • Maintain enough technical depth to lead credibly, challenge assumptions and support sound decision-making without becoming the default technical owner.
  • Set clear goals, milestones and delivery rhythms with the teams, balancing roadmap commitments with technical debt and platform health.
  • Build strong end-to-end operational ownership, including on-call, runbooks, incident response and follow-up actions.
  • Improve reliability and observability across the cargo data platform, addressing gaps in monitoring, alerting and data integrity.
  • Lead significant incidents affecting the domain and ensure contributing factors are understood and acted on.
  • Shape and grow your team through effective hiring, capability planning and interviewer development.
  • Develop and retain engineers through coaching, actionable feedback, meaningful goals and fair performance management.

    • You could be a match if you have
  • Experience leading a software engineering team, whether as an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, acting manager or senior engineer with meaningful responsibility for delivery and the development of others.
  • Strong technical foundations in backend, data or distributed systems, with enough depth to review designs, challenge assumptions and coach engineers through complex technical decisions.
  • Ability to work effectively with Product, engineering and domain stakeholders to translate business priorities into clear technical and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience contributing to the operation of production systems, including on-call practices, incident response, monitoring and follow-up improvements.
  • A strong belief in end-to-end engineering ownership, including the reliability, maintainability and operational impact of the systems a team builds.

raw.description:
Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + share options
Location: London/Hybrid, 2 days per week onsite

About Lawhive

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.

We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter.

We most recently raised a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.

Data at Lawhive

The Data team partners across Product, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, Operations and AI to build an analytics foundation and help Lawhive make better, data-informed decisions.

Over the next 12 months, we're focused on:

  • Owning and scaling our data platform

  • Supporting acquisitions with reliable data and insights

  • Expanding our reporting, including using AI agents in analytics workflows

  • Building a measurement framework for product and AI

About This Role

We're growing fast and looking for a Data Analyst to help us build world-class products through rigorous data analysis and experimentation. You will be a key member of our data and analytics team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to understand how users interact with our platform and drive measurable improvements to the customer experience.

You will have ownership over product analytics, working with our modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Hex) to build data models, design experiments, and surface insights that shape our product roadmap. Your work will directly influence what we build, how we prioritise, and how we measure success.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who loves digging into user behaviour, designing rigorous A/B tests, and translating findings into actionable product recommendations. You will be joining a small but growing data and analytics team that values creativity, continuous improvement, and the autonomy to explore new approaches to making the most of our data.

  • Work with everyone on the product squads to define success metrics and drive a measurement framework, measuring how a lawyer's workflow is impacted by the product: UX, UI and Lawrence.

  • Analyse user behaviour to understand engagement, feature adoption, retention and friction points, and use it to size opportunities and shape the product roadmap.

  • Design and analyse A/B tests with statistical rigour, and help teams build a culture of experimentation.

  • Build dashboards and self-serve reporting, backed by core dbt models that act as a single source of truth for product metrics.

  • Partner with Engineering on event tracking and data quality, working across tools like PostHog and Google Tag Manager.

  • Measure how our AI features perform, including LLM-based tools, to understand adoption, identify failure modes and measure impact.

  • Work with the AI team to define evaluation metrics and test AI feature variants, prompts and model changes.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in a product analytics, data analytics, or data science role, ideally within a product-led organisation.

  • Strong proficiency with SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment design, sample size calculations, statistical significance, and common pitfalls.

  • Experience working with event-based product analytics data and familiarity with tools like PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and rigour in how you approach analysis and data validation.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to distil complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to structure analytical problems independently. Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can shift.

Interview process

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • 1:1 with your hiring manager

  • Technical assessment interview

  • Values interview with one of our Founders and our CTO

💰 Meaningful early-stage equity at one of Europe’s fastest growing startups

✈️ 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays, and an extra day for your birthday, moving day and wedding day, with the opportunity to earn up to 5 more days with tenure!

🩺 Private Medical Insurance via Bupa (including subsidised gym membership)

🚲 Cycle to work scheme

🍼 Nursery benefits

💰 Pension contribution via Nest

🌍 Work from anywhere for a month

💻 Top-spec Macbook

⛳️ Regular team building activities and socials!

Diversity at Lawhive

At Lawhive we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. We're always working to build a diverse, inclusive team. We're not yet where we want to be, but as we scale we'll only increase our focus on this.

The Role

We’re rapidly acquiring law firms and bringing them onto our platform. Every one comes with its own case management system, its own reporting and its own messy data, and how quickly we bring it together shapes how fast Lawhive can grow.

As our Senior Data Engineer, you’ll own our data engineering, including the hands-on work behind every migration. Working with our Head of Data, you’ll make each migration faster than the last.

You’ll sit at the foundation of a small, AI-native data team, building the pipelines our Analytics Engineer and product analytics rely on, so data actually improves the product. You’ll work alongside our staff engineers and bring the DevOps, infrastructure, security and governance know-how to run your own platform.

raw.title: Biosensor Research Scientist (Electrochemical sensors)
raw.description:
About Level Zero
 
Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024—and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First—we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.
 
Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.
 
We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world—dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.
 
 
About the Role
 
We are excited to welcome a biosensor scientist with a strong background in electrochemical biosensor R&D and experience in working with aptamers to join our rapidly growing start-up. The ideal candidate is expected to be proficient in bench and wet chemistry techniques. Moreover, they should have sound knowledge and experience in assay development, small molecule detection, and electrode surface modifications. It is essential for the candidate to have extensive experience in aptamer-based electrochemical biosensor R&D, including the designs, operation principles, troubleshooting, and analysis.
 
This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London.
 
Some examples of what you might do:
 
- Design, prototype, and optimize electrochemical biosensor systems, focusing on small molecule analytes and aptamer-based recognition.
- Apply surface chemistry and electrode modification strategies to improve sensitivity, selectivity, stability, and biosensor performance in complex biological samples.
- Translate bio-element–target interactions into measurable and reproducible sensor outputs through novel assay design.
- Apply a range of electrochemical methods (voltammetry, impedimetry, chronoamperometry, etc.) to characterize and evaluate biosensor function.
- Apply data-driven approaches including Python-based analysis and Design of Experiments (DoE) to streamline workflows.
- Troubleshoot technical and conceptual challenges systematically and propose innovative solutions to improve performance.
- Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensure experimental reproducibility and compliance with quality standards.
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (chemists, biologists, engineers, and data scientists) to advance biosensor prototypes from concept to application.
- Present results clearly through written reports, oral presentations, and scientific publications.
- Attend R&D-related trainings and seminars for continuous updates on the latest trend in hormone sensing technologies.
 

What You Bring
  • A Ph. D. degree in Electrochemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical/Materials Engineering or related discipline, with a focus in aptamer biosensors. Post doctoral experience will be a plus for this role.
    •  
    The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas:
     
  • Proven hands-on experience in biosensor design, electrochemical techniques, and surface chemistry optimisation.
  • Proficiency in operating electrochemical instrumentation and analyzing experimental data.
  • Demonstrated expertise with biorecognition elements, particularly aptamers, for biosensor applications.
  • Strong knowledge of small molecule detection in biological and/or environmental samples.
  • Practical experience in handling and analyzing biofluids.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Creative and open mindset with the ability to explore and implement novel approaches.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working in multidisciplinary teams.
    •  
    Nice to have:
     
  • Experience with Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR), molecular docking, or structural modeling.
  • Familiarity with automation, Python scripting, and statistical design approaches (DoE).
  • Track record of peer-reviewed publications, patents, or industry-led biosensor projects.

    • Who You Are
  • We value culture as much as we value technical expertise, creating an environment that’s equal parts collaboration, curiosity, and fun.
    • We’re a fast-paced, mission-driven young team on a quest to make a lasting impact, fueled by uncompromising integrity, unwavering support for one another, and the thrill of exploring uncharted territories. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future.
     
    If our vision excites you, here are the qualities we look for:
  • You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency.
  • You’re a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results.
  • You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment.
  • You’re motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health.
  • You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in.
  • You’re confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions.
  • You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn.

    • What We Offer
  • A full-time role with a competitive salary and equity options, reflecting our value in your expertise and potential.
  • An environment where you’ll collaborate directly with the founding team at a leading biosensor startup, gaining access to industry experts and thought leaders.
  • The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration.
  • Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes.

raw.title: Lead Biosensor Scientist - Continuous Monitoring
raw.description:
About Level Zero
Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.

Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.

We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.
 

About the Role

We are seeking a lead biosensor scientist to drive the development and commercialisation of our continuous aptamer sensor platform. The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in developing continuous monitoring devices for regulated healthcare applications, demonstrated experience transitioning research-stage sensors into manufacturing-ready products, and a track record working with in vivo validation studies and large-scale analytical verification programs.

This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London.


What you'll do
  • Lead the development and optimisation of electrochemical continuous sensor systems from bench concept through manufacturing readiness.
  • Design and execute large-scale analytical verification studies, including multi-parameter performance characterisation, stability assessments, and biocompatibility validation.
  • Oversee in vivo validation studies in human subjects and troubleshoot sensor performance in clinical settings.
  • Define manufacturing processes, material specifications, and quality control parameters aligned with regulatory expectations and QMS frameworks.
  • Engage directly with regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) to define performance specifications and shape submission strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts with electrochemistry, microfabrication, and manufacturing to translate designs into scalable production.
  • Develop technical documentation packages (CMC, analytical performance dossiers) for regulatory submissions and investor communications.
  • Mentor junior scientists and technicians in sensor characterisation and assay validation methodologies.

    • What You Bring
  • A Ph.D. degree in electrochemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or related discipline, with specific focus on electrochemical biosensors. Minimum 4 years of industry experience commercialising continuous monitoring or diagnostic sensor technologies.

    • The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas:

  • Deep experience in electrochemical sensor development-particularly amperometric, potentiometric, or impedance-based platforms-with demonstrated progression from research concept to clinical or commercial application.
  • Proven track record managing regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking) for continuous monitoring devices.
  • Strong experience designing and executing large-scale analytical verification studies including stability, accuracy, precision, and matrix interference assessments.
  • Demonstrated experience working with in vivo validation studies, including study design, data interpretation, and regulatory reporting.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing readiness, scale-up strategy, and GMP-compatible processes.
  • Proven ability to operate in QMS-ready environments with familiarity of ISO 13485, design controls, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Understanding of biocompatibility, sterility, and shelf-life requirements for implantable or skin-worn continuous devices.
  • Proficiency in surface chemistry, material selection, and biointerface optimisation.
  • Expertise in aptamer-based biorecognition elements and aptamer optimisation for continuous monitoring applications.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with microneedle or transdermal ISF technologies.
  • Familiarity with SELEX or aptamer discovery workflows.
  • Experience with MEMS & electrode microfabrication processes.

raw.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
raw.description:
LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a commercially minded, relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to join our UK Brands team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on building relationships, understands the advertising and media landscape, and is passionate about helping clients succeed and grow.

You’ll take ownership of a portfolio of established brand and agency relationships, becoming a trusted strategic partner to some of the UK’s leading advertisers. Your role will go beyond traditional account management: you’ll proactively engage clients, uncover new business opportunities, expand relationships and drive long-term commercial growth.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys being out in the market, meeting clients face-to-face, understanding their businesses and identifying where LiveRamp can deliver even greater value.

You’ll combine commercial instinct with strategic thinking, working closely with our Sales, Product and Solutions teams to turn client needs into opportunities.

If you’re naturally curious, commercially ambitious and energised by building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Build and Develop Strategic Client Relationships

  • Own and develop relationships across a portfolio of established brand and agency clients, acting as their primary commercial and strategic partner.

  • Proactively build meaningful, long-term relationships through regular face-to-face meetings, client visits, industry events and strategic business reviews.

  • Develop strong relationships at multiple levels within client organisations, from day-to-day stakeholders to senior decision-makers and budget holders.

  • Build a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses, commercial priorities, media strategies and challenges to identify where LiveRamp can add value.

  • Become a trusted adviser, bringing clients new ideas, industry insights and opportunities rather than simply responding to requests.

  • Build relationships across the wider advertising ecosystem, including media agencies, technology partners and data providers.

Drive Account Growth and Commercial Opportunities

  • Take commercial ownership of your portfolio, with a clear focus on customer retention, revenue growth and account expansion.

  • Proactively identify and develop upsell, cross-sell and new use-case opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Build and execute strategic account growth plans, identifying key stakeholders, commercial opportunities and opportunities to deepen client partnerships.

  • Spot opportunities through client conversations, market developments and an understanding of evolving advertising and data strategies.

  • Work closely with the Sales team to develop and convert expansion opportunities, ensuring a joined-up approach to growing existing relationships.

  • Lead commercial conversations, renewals and negotiations, protecting existing revenue while maximising long-term account potential.

  • Maintain clear visibility of account health, revenue forecasts, growth opportunities and commercial risks.

Deliver Exceptional Customer Success

  • Ensure clients realise measurable business value from their investment in LiveRamp’s solutions.

  • Develop and execute strategic customer success plans aligned with each client’s business objectives and KPIs.

  • Drive adoption, engagement and utilisation of LiveRamp solutions, identifying opportunities to extend their impact.

  • Lead engaging, commercially focused quarterly business reviews that demonstrate results, share strategic recommendations and identify future opportunities.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling business outcomes for clients.

  • Proactively identify and resolve challenges, coordinating internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

  • Monitor customer performance, product adoption and usage to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.

Collaborate Across LiveRamp

  • Partner closely with Commercial Leads to ensure a seamless transition from new business acquisition into long-term account development.

  • Work with Product, Solutions, Engineering and Support teams to deliver successful client outcomes.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, sharing market intelligence, feedback and opportunities that can shape our offering.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across the UK and wider business to identify opportunities for innovation and growth.

About You

We’re looking for someone who combines strong relationship-building skills with commercial ambition and a genuine passion for the advertising industry.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • 5+ years’ experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Partnerships or a similar commercially focused, client-facing role.

  • A strong understanding of the advertising and media landscape, ideally gained within AdTech, MarTech, media agencies, media owners, data businesses or enterprise SaaS.

  • A proven track record of building and growing client relationships, identifying commercial opportunities and delivering revenue growth.

  • A genuine passion for meeting clients, developing relationships and being actively involved in the industry.

  • The confidence and credibility to engage senior stakeholders and lead strategic, commercially focused conversations.

  • A proactive, opportunity-led mindset, with the curiosity to understand client challenges and the initiative to propose solutions.

  • Experience managing commercial renewals, negotiations and account expansion opportunities.

  • Excellent presentation, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to simplify complex solutions and articulate business value.

  • Strong organisational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and commercial opportunities.

  • A collaborative, self-starting approach and the ability to take ownership of your portfolio.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with major advertisers, holding companies or media agencies.

  • Knowledge of first-party data, digital advertising, identity, data collaboration, measurement or commerce media.

  • Experience managing enterprise-level client relationships and complex stakeholder environments.

  • A track record of meeting or exceeding retention, expansion or revenue targets.

  • Experience developing strategic account plans and delivering executive-level business reviews.

  • Familiarity with LiveRamp’s solutions and the wider data and advertising technology ecosystem.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than satisfied customers. It means building strong, lasting partnerships that deliver measurable value and create opportunities for continued growth.

You’ll be someone who:

  • Is regularly in front of clients, developing meaningful relationships and opening new conversations.

  • Has strong visibility and influence across their client organisations.

  • Consistently identifies and progresses opportunities to expand existing accounts.

  • Delivers strong retention, customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

  • Is recognised by clients as a proactive, knowledgeable and commercially valuable partner.

  • Works collaboratively across LiveRamp to turn great client relationships into long-term business success.

We use automated decision systems (ADS) as part of our recruitment and hiring process. If you require an accommodation or believe that the use of an ADS may create a barrier to your application or participation in the hiring process due to a disability or other protected characteristic, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and ensuring an equitable hiring experience for all candidates.

To all recruitment agencies: LiveRamp does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, LiveRamp employees or any other company location. LiveRamp is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We’re the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals’ health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe’s top 100 AI startups with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 2.5M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of Lupa clients as their primary point of contact and relationship holder

  • Drive retention by proactively ensuring every client understands and realises the full value of the platform

  • Manage the renewal cycle for your accounts, forecasting accurately and closing on time

  • Identify and pursue upsell opportunities through strong relationships and deep product knowledge

  • Triage client issues effectively, working with Support and Product to resolve them quickly and communicate clearly throughout

  • Track account health metrics and intervene early when you spot signs of disengagement or risk

  • Represent client feedback internally, contributing to product roadmap discussions with clear, evidence-based insights

 

Your background looks something like:

  • Solid experience in a customer success or account management role, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment

  • Commercial confidence and the ability to manage a portfolio with accountability for retention and revenue growth

  • Strong communication skills, written and verbal with the ability to simplify complex product concepts for non-technical users

  • A proactive approach to risk: you identify problems before they escalate and act without being prompted

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS company known for high-quality customer success (nice to have)

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or Intercom (nice to have)

  • Background at a high-growth Series B+ startup where you’ve had to adapt quickly as the business scaled (nice to have)

 

As a person, you:

  • Build real relationships, not transactional ones, clients are genuinely glad to have you as their contact

  • Are commercially sharp and accountable for the numbers in your book of business

  • Work cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment without losing track of your own priorities

  • Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ

  • Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

 

What does success look like in 6 months?

  • You’ve taken full ownership of your client base and know the product inside out

  • You’re closing renewals and upsells independently with confidence

  • Your accounts are among the healthiest in the portfolio

raw.description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of over 80 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.

AI is not a side project here. Jerry, our AI teammate for vets, launches this month with clinical decision support, a listening mode for live consults, and hands-free voice next. You will ship weekly to real clinics and see the impact directly.

In this role, you will:

  • Build Jerry's clinical guideline library: RAG over vet-approved guidelines using hybrid vector and keyword search in Postgres, so Jerry answers clinical questions only from approved sources and cites the exact lines it used

  • Build Jerry's listening mode: a fast classifier that watches live consult transcripts and triggers Jerry to surface missed charges, tests, or risks in real time

  • Build Jerry's voice mode: a hands-free, voice-first experience for ambulatory vets on the road, where everything is spoken and any change waits for the vet's approval

  • Build long-running and scheduled Jerry tasks: turns that keep running after the vet closes the tab, and scheduled jobs that prepare drafts for the vet to approve

  • Own what you build in production across the TypeScript server and Python AI service: deploys, monitoring, fixes, weekly releases, and a share of on-call

  • Be a trusted reviewer on AI pull requests and write the design docs for new AI features

Your background looks something like:

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering, including at least a year shipping LLM features to real users in production

  • TypeScript in production (Node.js backend and React) and Python in production (FastAPI or similar)

  • Has built with LLM APIs in production: tool calling and agent loops, structured output, prompt and model iteration

  • Deploys and owns code in production: CI/CD, Docker, a cloud platform (AWS ideally), monitoring and fixing live issues

  • SQL and Postgres, with git fluency across branches, rebasing, pull requests, and code review

  • RAG experience: embeddings, hybrid vector and keyword search (pgvector), reranking, citations (nice to have · the first project)

  • Voice AI experience: real-time voice agents, speech-to-text, telephony integration (nice to have)

  • Works well with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and reviews their output critically

As a person, you:

  • Are a product engineer first · you care about what ships and how it performs in front of real users, not just whether it works in a test environment

  • Own your code end to end, from design doc to production, and do not consider a feature done until it is monitored and stable

  • Can explain the code you wrote, including the code your AI tools wrote for you

  • Are comfortable in a small team with a big scope, working directly alongside vets, product, and the wider engineering org

  • Are excited to work from our London WeWork office most of the week

  • Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

  • Shipping to production every week and contributing to on-call

  • Jerry's guideline library v1 is live for pilot clinics: it answers only from approved guidelines, cites exact lines, and passes the clinical team's test questions

  • Listening mode is piloted with at least one clinic, with every suggestion tracked to show the revenue it recovers

  • Long-running and scheduled tasks are in production and a voice-first Jerry has been tested with an ambulatory clinic

The Impact

Your engineering will keep a pan-African fintech running across five offices, four warehouses, 100+ retail sites and 10 call centres in six countries. We’ve now served 10 million customers, unlocked $2+ billion in credit and created income for 35,000+ agents. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every device provisioned, access request automated and call-centre line kept up helps the people serving our customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Run the corporate Azure and Microsoft estate as code, deployed through CI/CD

  • Automate joiner/mover/leaver, device provisioning, licensing and access requests, driven from the HR system of record

  • Own identity, end-user devices, networks across all our sites, and contact-centre telephony across ~10 call centres

  • Own IT security hygiene, business continuity and compliance, with audit evidence generated from systems

  • Microsoft and cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Intune, M365

  • Infrastructure as code: Bicep and/or Terraform, Git, pull requests, CI/CD

  • Scripting: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript or similar

  • Integrations: APIs and workflow tooling across HR, identity, ITSM and finance systems

This role covers internal IT. The infrastructure behind our customer-facing products sits with Engineering.

Our Approach 🚀

  • Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

  • Data over anecdote

  • A team that builds rather than firefights

  • Product mindset: start from the user and the business outcome, not the tool

  • A strong engineering background: you write code regularly and are comfortable with Git, pull requests and CI/CD

  • Deep Azure and Microsoft experience: Entra ID, Intune, M365, Azure networking and core services

  • Hands-on infrastructure as code with Bicep and/or Terraform in production

  • A track record of automating IT operations at scale, with the before and after to show for it

Ready to build the systems that keep a pan-African fintech running, while advancing your career in IT engineering? Apply now!

raw.description:
About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

 

Role and purpose mandate

ManyPets is continuing to evolve as it scales, with increasing organisational complexity and a need for strong People partnership that enables leaders to build high-performing, engaged and effective teams.

The Senior People Advisor plays a critical role in aligning people priorities with business goals, partnering with senior leaders to shape organisational capability, improve performance, strengthen manager capability and support sustainable growth.

This role combines advisory partnership with practical delivery across organisational effectiveness, employee relations, workforce planning, leadership capability, engagement, wellbeing and data-led decision making.

You will partner closely with designated senior leaders and management teams to deliver effective people plans and solutions, ensuring they land well, are embedded within the teams you support, and contribute directly to business performance, employee experience and our values-led culture.

A day in the life

  • Accountable for providing employee relations advise to designated business areas, supporting leaders with organisational design, workforce planning, performance, engagement and complex people matters.
  • Provide hands-on support, coaching leaders through ambiguity and ensuring People activity is commercially grounded, legally sound and aligned to company priorities.
  • Support People Advisors, ensuring consistent, high-quality advice and operational delivery across the employee lifecycle.

Your responsibilities

People Partnership

  • Partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into clear, practical and measurable people plans.
  • Provide trusted advice on organisational change, leadership effectiveness, team health, engagement, performance and culture.
  • Use people data, engagement insight and employee relations trends to identify risks, opportunities and areas for action.
  • Coach leaders to make balanced, inclusive and commercially grounded people decisions.
  • Ensure a values-led People experience is felt by teams and delivered in line with business priorities.

 

Change Management & Engagement

  • Diagnose and lead the People elements of change projects that improve business performance and align with strategic goals.
  • Partner with leaders and managers to ensure change is understood, communicated effectively and embedded well.
  • Support change initiatives including organisational design, redeployment, ways-of-working changes and team restructures, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated.
  • Work with senior leaders on timely communication and engagement plans for upcoming change.
  • Help managers and teams understand engagement results, identify themes and agree practical actions to improve future engagement.

 

Employee Relations, Risk & Performance

  • Lead on complex employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, legally sound and values-led outcomes.
  • Advise on performance, conduct, absence, grievance, disciplinary and change-related matters.
  • Identify people risk and escalate appropriately, balancing employee experience, policy, legal requirements and business need.
  • Build manager capability to handle people matters confidently, consistently and with awareness of the impact on individuals, teams and the business.
  • Maintain a proactive focus on wellbeing risks, including mental health, and ensure inclusion and wellbeing principles are considered across the employee journey.
  • Support positive employee relations, helping to maintain a healthy working environment, morale and regrettable turnover.

 

Data, Reward & Governance

  • Draw insight from people metrics to inform and advise stakeholders.
  • Use data-driven insight to continuously improve people strategies, processes and interventions.
  • Provide insight and support on reward processes, including benchmarking where required.
  • Ensure people data, reward activity and related processes are accurate, well managed and compliant.
  • Maintain awareness of GDPR, data protection requirements and relevant internal policies and procedures.
  • Support a regulated business environment by balancing innovation, fairness, employee experience and appropriate governance.

 

People Advisor Support & Operational Excellence

  • Support People Advisors, providing direction, coaching and development.
  • Oversee the quality and consistency of advice provided to managers and employees.
  • Prioritise and allocate casework, ensuring effective workload management and timely resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve people processes, guidance, templates and manager self-service.
  • Ensure People activity is delivered consistently, accurately and in line with policy, employment law and company values.

Measures of success

  • Business leaders receive proactive, commercially grounded and trusted people partnership.
  • People plans support organisational priorities, performance and capability needs.
  • Change activity lands well, is clearly communicated and is embedded effectively.
  • Employee relations matters are managed fairly, consistently and with appropriate risk mitigation.
  • Manager capability improves, particularly in performance, engagement, change and employee relations.
  • People risks and wellbeing themes are identified early and addressed pragmatically.
  • People Advisors are well supported, effective and delivering high-quality advice.
  • People data and insight are used to inform better decisions and improve outcomes.

Why this role matters

  • Strengthens the connection between business strategy and people priorities, helping leaders build effective teams and make better people decisions.
  • Improves organisational effectiveness, manager capability and employee experience through consistent, high-quality People partnership.

About you

  • Proven experience as a People Advisor, ideally in a fast-paced, scaling, operational or customer-service-led environment.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and managers through periods of change, transformation or organisational complexity.
  • Strong employee relations expertise and a deep understanding of UK employment law and best practice.
  • Commercially minded, delivery-focused and able to balance business priorities with fairness, empathy and sound judgement.
  • Confident using people data and insight to diagnose issues, influence decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Comfortable working with reporting, Excel and larger data sets.
  • Able to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and coach leaders effectively.
  • Experience managing, coaching or developing People Advisors or HR colleagues.
  • Strong attention to detail, high standards of accuracy and a commitment to quality.
  • Curious, pragmatic and able to translate complex people matters into clear, practical advice.

raw.title: Key Account Executive - UK
raw.description:
As Marqeta’s Key Account Executive based in London, you will be passionate about scaling the success of our business in Europe. This exciting role is ideal for individuals seeking to go deep in all aspects of complex business and technical engagements and will span multiple areas of development:

(1) Cultivating and managing relationships with executives seeking to innovate and disrupt B2B & consumer payments;

(2) Working closely with internal stakeholders in Product, Legal, Compliance and Delivery to define solutions that will empower our customers; and

(3) Originating new customer opportunities, responding to inbound opportunities, and shepherding deals from opening through to contract and closing stage.  

The team at Marqeta focuses on the largest and most impactful commercial opportunities in Marqeta’s evolving business. These customers include established brands, fintech innovators and labour / retail marketplaces, all looking for solutions to launch, scale and continuously evolve their financial products and services.  Key to this role is an ability to understand Marqeta's technology and how it brings value to the market, expertly communicate its benefits, and win the trust of the key stakeholders across revenue growth, product and technology teams of our potential partners.

We're looking for a self-motivated, experienced solution seller, who is eager to further deepen their knowledge of embedded finance and possesses the business judgment and sales acumen to vet opportunities and close deals. In this role you will spend the first 3 months learning the ins and outs of Marqeta and our customers and our programme management capabilities, supporting Team Leads on strategic projects, and building a sales pipeline. Additionally, you will need to understand the process of selling a complex platform technology and be able to communicate technical and product benefits to both sophisticated and unsophisticated buyers.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

This role is about generating and closing new opportunities while playing a key role supporting the Sales Director in setting the strategic vision for the business - here are a few key expectations:

  • Closing and launching enterprise customers: Work alongside the team Director in identifying, closing and onboarding new customers. Manage the back end of the process including Salesforce rigour and reporting, financial modeling, and garnering internal approvals. 

  • Qualify leads and prioritize the right opportunities: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects by identifying their needs and requirements, responding to requests for information and proposals, and vetting them against our current and future product offering.

  • Run a Sales Process end to end: Manage real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to scoping to final contract negotiations. At any given time, you will be responsible for partnering with the team to grow and renew existing accounts and working opportunities in various stages of that process in Salesforce.

  • Contracting: Work with our Legal team as required to shepherd opportunities through the contracting process, including negotiation and execution.

  • Know the Tech: Quickly get up to speed on Marqeta's technical and programme management capabilities, the unique features and customer benefits our platform offers and how to speak with confidence, knowledge and credibility about what we bring to our customers and prospects.

  • Sell the partnership vision: Work with internal SMEs to identify and develop solutions for prospects who are trying to understand what makes Marqeta’s platform and service offering so exceptional and differentiated.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in sales and/or strategic business development roles; payments, investment banking and strategic consulting backgrounds preferred but not required. Bachelor’s Degree or comparable experience required.

  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and card issuing is crucial, with bonus points for having worked in a regulated programme manager offering full stack solutions to customers.

  • Strong familiarity and ease with the fintech ecosystem, B2B technology applications and how technology platforms serve customer businesses.

  • Financial Acumen. The payments business and caliber of customer relationships necessitates complex deal structures and financial modelling. We’re looking for an individual who is comfortable and capable of evaluating and modeling customer proposals and resulting contract financial models. 

  • Confidence in serving as the face of Marqeta for prospective customers and partners who may comprise C-suite executives and senior leadership members.

  • Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously; highly motivated and able to work against aggressive schedules.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally to deliver on the customer’s needs.

  • Superior communication skills (interpersonal, verbal, email, and presentation) with the ability to successfully orchestrate the sales process by managing the time and resources of the team and specialist partners.

  • Positive attitude, team player, adaptable, resourceful, and self-starter who is able to work independently.

Recruiter for this role

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 2 x 45 min calls

  • Presentation Round to team

  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more…

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Marqeta endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please submit this form with your specific accommodation request.

Marqeta cares about your privacy. Personal data that is provided as part of the application and recruitment process is processed in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Notice. Additional information for California residents can be found here.

To keep our interview process fair and consistent, we ask that all candidates join video interviews with their camera on.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in our recruitment processing consistent with the requirements of applicable laws. For more information, review our AI notice here.

raw.title: Account Executive, Digital Natives
raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across France and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and French

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

You will troubleshoot complex issues, manage equipment and user accounts, and maintain accurate records of incidents and inventory. You will also guide and train users on best practices, contribute to improving internal IT processes, and help keep our technology environment secure, efficient, and scalable.

📍 Location: London

What You Will Do

User Support and Issue Resolution

  • Provide high-quality technical assistance through email, messaging tools, and in-person interactions.

  • Investigate and resolve hardware and software issues across operating systems, applications, and devices while keeping users informed at every step.

  • Log incidents in our ticketing system, ensure timely follow-ups, and deliver an exceptional support experience.

  • Deliver in-person IT onboarding sessions to ensure employees are fully equipped and ready from day one.

Equipment Setup and Technology Operations

  • Install, configure, and update computers, IT equipment, and videoconferencing systems.

  • Manage device shipments and returns locally and internationally, maintaining accurate stock and inventory records.

  • Ensure that every team member has the right tools from day one and that our equipment lifecycle remains efficient and organized.

  • Support office openings, moves, and expansions across EMEA and APAC.

Account and License Management

  • Oversee user accounts and application licenses with precision.

  • Ensure proper access management and the consistent application of security policies across all workstations, reinforcing a safe and compliant environment for all users.

Training and Continuous Improvement

  • Train and guide users on applications, hardware, and best practices.

  • Evaluate business needs, propose improvements to IT processes, and contribute to building a smoother and more scalable internal technology ecosystem.

What We're Looking For

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related IT field.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Hands-on experience with Google Workspace administration.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across both macOS and Windows environments.

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including Ethernet and WiFi protocols, TCP/IP, and basic corporate infrastructure troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with videoconferencing equipment and associated services.

  • Ability to lift and handle standard IT equipment such as monitors and network devices.

  • Proven experience in a similar IT support role within a fast-paced, global organization.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA and APAC and work flexibly to support timezone-aligned onboarding.

  • Experience with MDM solutions such as Kandji (Iru) or Jamf.
