raw.title: Senior IT Support Analyst
raw.description:
Senior IT Support Analyst

 

➡️ An experienced IT professional who thrives on taking ownership, solving problems independently and delivering exceptional employee support?

➡️ Confident administering Microsoft 365, managing workplace technology and troubleshooting complex IT issues without relying on constant supervision?

➡️ Enjoy being the go-to person for IT, combining strong technical expertise with excellent people skills and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset?

➡️ Excited by the opportunity to take ownership of IT support for our London office and help shape how a growing, AI-first business operates?

If this sounds like your next move, we'd love to hear from you!

 

Role Summary:

We're looking for an experienced, proactive and technically confident Senior IT Support Analyst to take ownership of day-to-day IT support and operations for our London office.

Supporting approximately 150 employees in London, alongside remote colleagues across the UK, Europe and parts of APAC, you'll be our primary onsite IT specialist, ensuring our people, systems and workplace technology run smoothly.

This is a high-autonomy, hands-on position suited to someone who has already developed strong technical foundations and is confident working independently. You'll be responsible for resolving technical issues, administering our Microsoft 365 environment, managing employee IT onboarding and offboarding, maintaining office infrastructure and supporting IT security and compliance.

We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. Someone who doesn't need constant direction, takes ownership of challenges through to resolution and can confidently make decisions, manage priorities and identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

Just as importantly, we're looking for a genuine people person. Someone approachable, patient and professional, who understands that great IT support isn't simply about fixing technology; it's about ensuring colleagues feel supported and can do their best work.

As Patsnap continues its transformation into an AI-first organisation, you'll also play a role in supporting the secure adoption of enterprise AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude Enterprise.

This is a predominantly office-based role in our Farringdon office, with onsite attendance currently expected Monday to Thursday and occasional flexibility to work remotely depending on business needs.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead. 

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.   

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Act as the primary onsite IT contact for the London office, providing visible, hands-on first and second-line support for hardware, software, Microsoft 365 and connectivity issues, and remote support for colleagues across the UK, Europe and parts of APAC.

  • Deliver a seamless onboarding and offboarding experience by setting up user accounts, provisioning devices, managing application access, and ensuring secure deprovisioning.

  • Manage user provisioning and permissions across Microsoft 365, Salesforce and other business SaaS platforms, applying role-based access principles.

  • Configure and maintain Windows and macOS devices through Microsoft Intune, and manage IT assets and inventory for the region.

  • Own the office IT infrastructure, including video conferencing and meeting room technology, door access, printers and the communications room, and coordinate with our outsourced network provider on connectivity and access point issues.

  • Take on practical, hands-on tasks such as cabling, equipment setup and desk moves

  • Work closely with the UK Office Manager, providing practical support with day-to-day office needs and shared projects.

  • Support our security and compliance programs by assisting with access reviews, audit evidence, and IT controls for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 using Vanta.

  • Administer and support enterprise AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, and Microsoft Copilot, promote secure adoption and best practices, and actively look for ways to apply AI to improve IT support and everyday workflows.

  • Prioritise competing requests based on business impact, proactively identify improvements, and take issues through to resolution.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across our global IT team on projects, escalations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technologies You'll Work With

  • Microsoft 365: Teams, Outlook, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID and Intune.

  • Enterprise AI: ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot.

  • Security & Compliance: Vanta, ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

  • Office Technology: Video conferencing, meeting room systems, networking and door access.

  • Business SaaS: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, ZoomInfo and Lusha.

And plenty more! We're continually evolving our technology, so there'll be opportunities to learn and work with new tools as we grow.


What We'd Love From You:

Above all, we're looking for someone who combines strong hands-on technical expertise, proven independence and a genuine passion for helping people. You'll be comfortable being the go-to IT specialist in an office, confident making decisions and resolving issues without constant supervision, while remaining approachable, collaborative and focused on delivering an exceptional employee experience.

  • Relevant IT Support Experience: A minimum of 3 years' professional experience in IT support, desktop support, IT operations or a similar hands-on technical role. Ideally, you've worked in a standalone, primary onsite IT support or similarly autonomous position, taking responsibility for a broad range of technical requirements.

  • Strong Microsoft 365 Administration: Demonstrable hands-on experience independently administering Microsoft 365, particularly Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online and SharePoint, including user management, identity and access controls, licensing and device administration.

  • Technical Independence & Troubleshooting: Proven ability to independently diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system and connectivity issues across Windows and macOS. Comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems and knowing when to escalate appropriately.

  • SaaS & Access Management: Experience administering cloud-based business applications, managing user provisioning, permissions and secure access, alongside employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

  • IT Security & Compliance: Practical experience supporting IT security controls, access reviews, device compliance or audit activities relating to frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

  • Ownership & Accountability: A self-sufficient, dependable professional who takes responsibility for IT issues, follows through to resolution and proactively identifies opportunities to improve systems and processes.

  • Prioritisation & Judgement: Confident managing competing priorities, responding calmly to unexpected challenges and making sound decisions based on business impact, without requiring day-to-day supervision.

  • Excellent People Skills: Approachable, patient and an excellent communicator, with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and making technology accessible to employees of all technical abilities.

  • A Practical, Hands-On Mindset: Comfortable taking responsibility for onsite IT needs, from device configuration and meeting room technology to hardware troubleshooting, cabling and equipment setup.

  • Adaptability & Continuous Improvement: Curious, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-moving technology environment, with an interest in AI, automation and emerging workplace technologies.

Even better if you have:

  • Previous experience as the primary IT contact for an office or supporting multiple locations with limited onsite technical assistance.

  • Experience working in a growing SaaS, technology or internationally distributed business.

  • Experience with Vanta or direct involvement in ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot or other enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, MS-900 or Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator.

  • Experience supporting or mentoring less experienced IT colleagues.

  • Mandarin or Cantonese language skills, which would be helpful when collaborating with colleagues in our East region.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

Patsnap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer (EOE) that champions diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

 

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, we encourage you to apply and tell us why you’d be a great fit for this role! If you require any accommodations during the interview process, please email us at ----- so we can best support you.

raw.title: Agent Product Manager
raw.description:
Competencies

You're part product manager, part builder, part engagement lead. You take a messy customer process and re-design for Pi to handle autonomously. You're technical enough to own the configuration yourself: you understand APIs, data flows, retrieval and authentication, and you use AI coding tools to extend what Pi does, with the judgement to know when a change makes sense and the discipline to test it before it ships. You're as comfortable running a requirements workshop with a commercial leadership team as you are debugging why Pi made a decision, and you care deeply about the outcome Pi delivers.

More specifically, the people who do this well bring:

  • You turn customer requirements into precise Pi configuration: instructions, data, guardrails and escalation paths

  • You configure and fix things yourself, using AI tools to handle technical changes without waiting on engineering

  • You test like it matters: you design the scenarios and simulations that define what good looks like, and you don't launch until Pi meets them

  • You run engagements with energy and structure, keeping customers, timelines and stakeholders moving toward go-live

  • You own the number: adoption, time saved, revenue retained, whatever the customer deployed Pi to deliver

  • You are Product's voice from the field, turning what you see across customers into clear, prioritised feedback that makes Pi better

You likely have at least 3 to 4 years of experience, and you're technically competent enough to configure, test and debug an AI agent yourself. That might come from:

  • A recent role as a forward-deployed product manager or forward-deployed engineer

  • Product management on a technical product

  • Founding a company, or building hands-on with AI in a way you can show us

More than your title, we care about curiosity, rigour and a bias to action.

Trajectory

Pi is Planhat's customer agent: a single agent that can be configured to take on processes across the commercial lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption to renewal and expansion.

Agent Product Managers are the people who make Pi real for each customer. You join once the customer has signed, work directly with them to shape how Pi is configured for their processes, and extend it to new processes and teams. You run a small portfolio of customers, own a specialty commercial area and help shape how the team works.

Everything you learn feeds straight back to Product, so Pi gets better for every customer, and you work closely with Sales, CS, Product and Engineering so no context or momentum is lost.

Imagine:

  • Taking Pi live on a customer's renewals process in weeks, from the first requirements session through testing to launch

  • Setting Pi up to run account management for a customer's long-tail accounts: monitoring health, preparing renewals and handling the outreach no human team has time for

  • Reviewing a week of Pi's work for a customer, spotting where it falls short, and shipping the fix the same afternoon

  • Extending Pi from one process to the next for the same customer, until it runs across their commercial lifecycle

  • Turning a pattern you've seen across five customers into a capability Product builds into Pi for everyone

In this role you will:

  • Run Pi deployments for a portfolio of customers, from kickoff to live and beyond

  • Agree success metrics with each customer and report on the impact

  • Help customer leaders decide where Pi goes next

  • Train the teams who work alongside Pi so they use it and trust it

  • Build the playbooks and templates that make each deployment faster

Definition of Success

  • Success in this role is measured by what Pi delivers for your customers, and how much better it gets because of you.

    • Your customers hit the targets they deployed Pi for

    • Their leaders come back to you for what's next, and Pi expands into new processes and teams

    • Product ships improvements to Pi that started with you

Compensation

The OTE salary range for this position is $130,000 - $150,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

raw.title: GTM Engineer
raw.description:
Competencies

You are an applied AI engineer whose product is the revenue engine. You find where the customer lifecycle can work better and ship production-grade agentic workflow, LLM pipelines and integrations that make each process best in class for reps, CSMs and marketers. You operate independently and own each build end to end: architecture, prototype, evals, deployment and observability. You spar on solution design with the team, then ship.

We care more about what you have shipped than where you studied. If you have built something real, show us.

Must-haves

  • You have shipped AI systems GTM teams use daily. Agents, workflows or integrations used by sales, CS or marketing that moved a number.

  • Strong integration skills in JavaScript or TypeScript. You’re comfortable building and running integration services. Working with APIs and webhooks, handling auth, rate limits and errors, and shipping tested code.

  • Hands-on Salesforce or equivalent, declarative and code. Declarative: object model, Flows, validation rules, permission sets, record types. Code: Apex triggers and classes, SOQL and SOSL, Lightning Web Components, Platform Events and Change Data Capture, REST and Bulk APIs, SFDX deployments.

  • Applied AI engineering. You build with LLM APIs, not just chat interfaces, and can show the skills listed below in real work.

  • You understand the revenue engine. Experience in RevOps, GTM Systems, growth or a GTM engineering agency in B2B SaaS. You know how pipeline, renewals and expansion actually work.

  • Data quality fundamentals. SQL, CRM data models, deduplication, enrichment waterfalls and data quality at scale.

  • GTM data stack. Clay, n8n, Make + warehouse and reverse ETL experience.

  • Production mindset. You ship fast and build things others can maintain: logged, monitored, documented.

  • Clear communicator. You can sit with a top rep, find the work that shouldn't exist, and explain the fix in plain words.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with a customer platform or CSM tool (Planhat, Gainsight, ChurnZero), or HubSpot alongside Salesforce.

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I or II, or Platform App Builder.

  • Side projects, open-source tools, public write-ups or a GitHub that shows you build for fun.

  • Founder, agency or early-stage startup experience.

Trajectory

You’ll own each build end to end, from architecture and prototype through evals, deployment and observability. Here’s what that looks like:

  • Agentic GTM workflows: Design and ship AI agents and workflows that optimise productivity: account research, signal detection, enrichment, call and email analysis, personalised outreach, renewal and expansion plays.

  • Planhat on Planhat: Run our own GTM on our own platform. Build with Planhat's AI, automations and APIs, and feed what you learn straight back to Product as a power user.

  • Signals and data: Turn product usage, intent, firmographic and conversation data into scores and triggers that route the right account to the right person at the right time.

  • Integrations: Connect tools that don't talk natively. Build the webhooks, MCP connection and transformations that keep data clean across the stack.

  • Build vs buy: Run tight pilots on new GTM and AI tools, measure fit and ROI, and make a clear call.

  • Enablement: Document what you build, teach teams to use it with confidence, and raise how the whole company builds with AI.

Definition of Success

Success is measured in outcomes: productivity gains, pipeline acceleration, data quality and adoption of what you ship.

raw.description:
About Plentific

Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our platform connects property owners, operators, service providers and residents, and covers more than 1.7 million properties and 5,000+ service providers. We believe property repairs, maintenance and management can and should work better for everyone. That means giving landlords more control, supporting trade professionals and strengthening the communities they serve.

The Role

Our clients, mainly social housing providers and local authorities, rely on Plentific's contractor network to deliver their repairs and maintenance works on time and to standard.

We're looking for a Head of Supply Chain Delivery to lead that team. You'll be responsible and accountable for how we deliver supply chain mobilisation for social landlord's supply chain needs, and for contractor performance and delivery. You'll lead a team of three account managers who manage our top contractors like key accounts, and you'll also run account management yourself for our key strategic contractor partners.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone with a repairs and maintenance contractor background in the social housing sector, ideally at or alongside a Tier 1 contractor. You'll know how contractors run their businesses, and be comfortable making decisions from data.

What you'll do

Design the delivery solution for every new mobilisation

  • Take the client's requirements from Sales and put forward the delivery solution for each mobilisation proposal.

  • Make these decisions using the data including pricing rate benchmarks, contractor capacity and workload by trade and region.

  • Agree rates and SLAs with the contractors and negotiate on deliverables and pricing.

  • Oversee the contractor mobilisation through to delivery, stepping in on escalations.

Own contractor performance across the network

  • Own SLA attainment, aged WIP and escalations across our contractor network.

  • Accountable for contractor's performance per client against baseline KPIs, so every contractor is held to account for how they perform for each client.

  • Put improvement plans in place for under-performers, and route more work, projects and works packages to the contractors who perform well.

Lead the contractor account management team

  • Accountable for contractor monthly account management calls covering KPIs, aged WIP plans, pricing and quote health, capacity and growth, and platform adoption.

  • Set clear goals, KPIs for the team and review progress against them regularly.

Build strategic contractor relationships

  • Hold director-level relationships with our strategic Tier 1 contractors and join their monthly account calls.

  • Understand each strategic contractor's capacity, growth plans and interest in new regions or trades, and turn that into more work through Plentific.

  • Share what you hear from contractors so we keep improving our platform and our way of working.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in repairs and maintenance, construction or facilities management, including time at or alongside a Tier 1 contractor. You understand how contractors run their businesses: operatives, scheduling, pricing and margins.

  • Experience leading and developing a team, with clear goals and regular performance conversations.

  • Commercial confidence: you can price work against a schedule of rates and negotiate rates and SLAs with contractors.

  • Data literate. You're comfortable working with dashboards and KPIs, and you make decisions from data rather than relationships alone.

  • You build trusted relationships with contractor directors and senior stakeholders.

  • Highly organised, able to run several mobilisations at once against tight deadlines.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and keen to find new ways they can save time.

  • Understanding of public procurement regulations and how frameworks operate within housing repairs

  • Experience with FSM or work order management tools

  • Experience in running competitive tenders and structuring contracts with subcontractors

raw.description:
About Us

At Plentific, we’re redefining property management in real time. Our mission is to lead real estate through the transformative journey into "The World of Now," enabling us to empower property professionals through our innovative, cloud-based platform.

We harness cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to streamline operations for landlords, letting agents, and property managers, enabling them to optimize maintenance, manage repairs, and make informed decisions instantly. Our platform is designed to create seamless, real-time workflows that transform traditional property management into a dynamic, digital experience.

Backed by a world-class group of investors, including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfields, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global, Plentific is at the forefront of the proptech revolution. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we’re continually expanding our reach and impact.

We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.

 

The Role

Plentific Services is Plentific’s own delivery arm. Rather than only connecting a housing provider with a contractor, we take end-to-end ownership of the work order: we agree the service and the fees with the client, source and vet the subcontractors who do the work, manage delivery through the Plentific platform, quality-check the output before the client sees it, and invoice at pre-agreed fees. Inspections and surveys are the first service line, and the business is moving from single programmes to several client contracts running side by side.

As Supply Chain Specialist you will be the operational point of contact for both clients and contractors, working across several client contracts and several contractors at the same time. This is a hands-on delivery role in a service that is still being built, so you will help shape how it runs as volumes grow. Commercial decisions on client fees, subcontractor rates and contractor vetting sit with the Head of Property Operations, and you will feed into them.

Responsibilities

  • Own the day to day delivery of all Plentific Services work orders, taking whatever action is needed on and off the platform to keep each job moving to completion.

  • Accept incoming job leads from clients, making sure the information and documents we need are in place before work starts and raising anything missing back to the client.

  • Set each work order up correctly on the platform so it reaches the right subcontractor ready to be delivered.

  • Manage delivery against the agreed service levels, tracking booking and completion times and escalating jobs at risk while there is still time to recover them

  • Resolve day to day issues with clients and contractors, from access and contact problems through to queries on the quality of what has been delivered, seeing each one through to closure

  • Report on work order status daily, weekly and monthly, and flag the trends worth acting on

  • Support the commercial cycle, tracking client invoicing on completed work and raising the requests that trigger contractor payment

  • Act as the operational point of contact for clients and contractors, working with the named contacts on both sides to answer enquiries and keep relationships strong

  • Manage all the above across multiple clients and multiple contractors at the same time

  • Help improve how the service runs as volumes grow, so delivery scales beyond manual follow-up

 

Requirements

Skills

  • Organised under volume, able to hold a large queue of live jobs and know which ones matter today

  • Confident and persistent in chasing clients and contractors without damaging the relationship

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, written and spoken

  • Comfortable in a job management or field service platform, and quick to learn a new one

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly where an error would reach the client

  • Ability to analyse data and make data-driven decisions

  • Resilient and able to cope with a fast growing, scale up culture where every day is different

  • Works with a high degree of autonomy and copes well under pressure

  • Able to deal with a client and contractor base, understanding different working practices on both sides

  • Great team spirit, a can do attitude and the ability to turn a challenge into an opportunity

 

Experience and Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience in a repairs, voids, compliance or contractor operations role, gained at a housing association, a local authority, an ALMO or a contractor delivering to them

  • Proven experience of working to service levels on live jobs, and first-hand knowledge of what goes wrong in the field

  • Experience of managing work orders through a job management, field service or contractor management platform

  • Some experience of dealing with contractors and trade industry knowledge

  • Desirable: experience of inspections or surveys, for example stock condition, void checks, damp and mould, post-disrepair or fire risk

  • Desirable: exposure to contractor invoicing, payment approvals or purchase orders

  • Desirable: an understanding of the regulatory pressure our clients are under, including Awaab’s Law and the Building Safety Act

 

Benefits

We offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Flexible working environment, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer
raw.description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.
We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers.


Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. The systems handle complex permissions, legacy integrations, high transaction volumes, and business processes where reliability and data correctness matter.


AI-assisted, spec-driven development is part of normal engineering practice at Plentific. The Senior Backend Engineer turns product requirements into implementation-ready specifications, uses agentic coding tools across implementation, testing, review, and documentation, and remains accountable for the resulting software. AI-generated output is held to the same standard as human-written code. Success means delivering reliable services, improving the codebase and engineering practice around the role, and enabling the wider team to ship confidently at pace.

Key Responsibilities

raw.description:

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Plentific's product engineering organisation. You will manage the team leads of multiple engineering teams covering the core domains of our platform, with full accountability for the engineers across every discipline frontend, backend, mobile, and quality. You will report to the VP of Engineering.


You bring deep technical knowledge and a strong appetite for learning especially around agentic AI and how it is reshaping the way software is built. Your hands-on coding focuses on the engineering organisation itself: improving the agentic tooling, the SDD framework, and the developer experience that makes every engineer faster and better. You stay close to the codebase, contribute code where it unblocks progress or moves the agentic SDLC forward, and review pull requests in enough depth to assess code quality, the maturity of our agentic practice, and individual engineer performance. You are equally comfortable in a 1:1 with a struggling engineer, in a roadmap conversation with a product manager, and in a design review with a staff engineer.


Plentific's agentic software development transformation is already under way and producing results. We need a leader who can keep the momentum, expand it across every team, and partner with our engineering guild to refine the spec-driven development (SDD) framework, the agentic tooling, and the practices that have got us this far. You will help roll out SDD across the engineering organisation, drive adoption, and track the outcomes.


Success looks like a team that is continuously getting stronger: accelerating delivery cadence against business commitments, rising engineering standards, and an agentic development practice that compounds month on month.

Key Responsibilities

 

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead the product engineering organisation through its team leads, owning delivery, technical quality, and people outcomes across frontend, backend, mobile, and quality engineering.

  • Contribute code that improves the agentic tooling, the SDD framework, or the developer experience that supports every team. Review pull requests in enough depth to assess code quality, the maturity of our agentic SDLC, and individual engineer performance.

  • Set and enforce a high bar for engineering standards code review, testing, observability, and architectural review and hold every team to it.

 

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Champion agentic and spec-driven development practices across every team. Roll out our SDD framework, drive adoption, track its impact on delivery throughput and engineering quality, and feed learnings back into the practice.

  • Participate actively in Plentific's engineering guild, partnering with other technical leaders to improve the SDD framework and the agentic tooling the guild produces. Treat the framework and tooling as a product whose customers are the product managers, designers, and engineers running our product development.

 

Team Performance and Growth

  • Recruit, close, and retain exceptional engineers. Set the bar high enough that every hire strengthens the team, and never compromise on quality to fill seats.

  • Own and continuously improve our technical and behavioural interview methods. Design and iterate on live coding exercises, take-home challenges, and structured assessments so we evaluate candidate skills accurately, fairly, and at hiring scale.

  • Own performance management and career development across engineering. Define what good looks like, coach every engineer toward that standard, and help them exceed it. Give direct, honest feedback.

  • Build and develop the team leads, growing them into stronger managers through coaching, feedback, and clear expectations.

 

Delivery and Partnership

  • Partner with product managers to size and resource the roadmap accurately. Flag delivery risks early, make trade-offs explicit, and own on-time delivery against business commitments.

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm across engineering planning, delivery review, and post-mortem that gives engineers predictable cadence and the wider organisation visibility into progress.

  • Translate technical context for non-engineering stakeholders product, design, commercial, and the executive team and bring business context back into engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives alongside other engineering leaders, on topics from career frameworks to platform investment to cross-team standards.

 

Requirements

  • Demonstrable track record managing engineering managers and team leads across multiple teams, with full ownership of delivery and people outcomes.

  • Deep technical knowledge across modern software engineering, with the credibility to make architecture calls and the hands-on coding ability to contribute meaningfully when it improves the developer experience, the agentic SDLC, or unblocks teams.

  • Working fluency in Python and TypeScript, with practical production experience in both.

  • Practical experience integrating, evaluating, or productionising machine learning systems not necessarily as a researcher, but as someone who has shipped ML-powered features.

  • Active, current hands-on experience with agentic development tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent used as a daily part of your own engineering practice.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping software engineering, with a habit of staying ahead of new tooling and practices and bringing the best of them back to the team.

  • Track record of recruiting, closing, and retaining senior engineers and engineering managers, with a high-bar hiring philosophy.

  • Track record of designing and improving technical interview methods live coding, take-home challenges, structured behavioural interviews that assess candidate skills accurately at hiring scale.

  • Demonstrable experience addressing under-performance directly setting expectations early, coaching engineers to improve, and giving honest, timely feedback so nothing is a surprise.

  • Commercial pragmatism: you optimise for the business outcome, you can explain trade-offs to product and executive stakeholders without losing engineering credibility, and you are not afraid to make decisions that are right for the business but unpopular in the moment.

 

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, of which at least 4 years in engineering management.

  • 2+ years managing other engineering managers or team leads across multiple teams.

  • Experience working in cross-functional product engineering teams alongside product managers, designers, and data scientists.

  • London-based, with the ability to work from our London office on a hybrid basis (typically two to three days per week, adjusted to team rhythm).

  • Bonus: domain experience in any of marketplace or two-sided platforms (on-demand services, field services, logistics, gig economy), B2B fintech and payments, vertical SaaS for operations-heavy or compliance-driven industries (construction, supply chain, insurance), or workflow and project-management tooling.

 

Benefits

As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of property management across the globe. Here’s what we offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday + 1 additional day for every year served up to 3 years.

  • Flexible working environment including the option to work abroad

  • Private health care for you and immediate family members with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance (4x salary)

  • Employee assistance program

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme

You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts.


Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability.


The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment.


Success in this role means shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and well-tested, raising the standard of the frontend codebase around you, and leaving the engineers you work with better than you found them.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering

  • Build and maintain product interfaces in TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, React Router, MaterialUI and BaseUI across our web applications.

  • Translate product requirements and design concepts into technical documents that set out scope, system behaviour, edge cases, and high-level technical analysis.

  • Design component APIs, state management, and data-fetching patterns that stay readable and extendable as the codebase grows.

  • Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it meets the requirements of improved or new features.

  • Review and improve our development workflows, continuous integration checks, deployment pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Keep up to date with technology and bring in new standards and practices for improved user or developer experience

Performance, Quality, and Reliability

  • Diagnose and resolve page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that give the team confidence to ship frequently.

  • Instrument frontend observability with tools such as Sentry, Grafana Logs or New Relic, and act on what they show.

  • Debug and fix production issues across our applications, including the integration points where frontend and backend behaviour diverge.

  • Design against common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into implementation-ready specs, including user flows, component behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and test expectations.

  • Prototype interfaces and interaction quickly, using working software to test feasibility and product value before committing to larger delivery.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, and review code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, accessibility, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable prompt patterns, review checklists, examples, and lightweight documentation.

Collaboration and Craft

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers from problem framing through release, applying engineering judgement to improve the user experience before implementation starts.

  • Collaborate with other engineers through code review and pair programming.

  • Define and communicate frontend standards and best practices, and hold the team to them in review.

  • Write concise technical documentation covering components, algorithms, APIs, and operational handover.

  • Articulate technical trade-offs in plain English to technical and non-technical colleagues, including when scope, quality, or delivery timing needs to change.

Requirements

  • Expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of React and the patterns around it, including data fetching, routing, and component libraries.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, testing, debugging, and code that stays readable and extendable at scale.

We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts.


Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability.


The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment.

Frontend Engineering

raw.title: Senior Product Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale.

The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.
We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. Our investors include Highland Europe, Brookfield, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

 

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core product surface on our platform. This spans diagnostics, intake, scheduling, status updates, and communications across web, mobile, messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, chatbot, and voice channels, together with the hand-offs into the operational workflows behind them.


You will sit in the Product team and report to the Head of Product. You will work closely with design, engineering, data, operations, customer teams, and AI specialists to build product experiences that are simple, reliable, and practical to operate.


This is an AI-native product role. We expect you to use agentic prototyping and spec-driven product development as part of your normal workflow, and to judge which models fit a given problem: when a hosted commercial model is the right call, and when privacy, GDPR, or data-residency constraints mean an open-source model in our own cloud environment is better. You do not need to build these systems yourself, but you do need the technical understanding to navigate the trade-offs and direct the work. You will turn user problems into clear specs, define quality gates for AI-powered experiences, and decide when automation is ready for production.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy, Discovery, and Delivery

  • Identify and model the jobs-to-be-done and workflows for users, providers, and operational teams, weighing operational constraints and commercial outcomes, and capture them as clear specs that engineering and design can act on.

  • Prioritise work using product analytics, operational data, support contact drivers, customer commitments, and AI-readiness risk.

  • Own the roadmap for the product suite, spanning diagnostics, scheduling, communications, chatbot, voice-agent, and self-service surfaces.

  • Lead discovery with users, housing providers, customer teams, operations, and internal users.

  • Translate ambiguous service problems into sequenced bets, measurable outcomes, and crisp trade-offs for senior stakeholders.

  • Own go-to-market for customer-facing launches: launch readiness, release sequencing, enablement, and internal and external launch communications with product marketing, customer, and operations teams.

  • Align product, engineering, design, data, operations, customer success, implementation, and support teams around scope, launch readiness, and adoption.

  • Improve user journeys that cross multiple operational systems, including issue classification, contractor availability, scheduling changes, notifications, and case escalation.

  • Measure product outcomes through experiments, cohort analysis, operational metrics, qualitative research, and post-launch reviews.

 

AI-Native Product Development

  • Use agentic prototyping tools to test interaction patterns, conversation flows, scheduling logic, and multimodal diagnostics before committing engineering capacity, deciding whether a problem calls for straightforward automation, a copilot feature, a fully agentic workflow, or a mixture.

  • Define specifications, acceptance criteria, and launch criteria for AI-powered product experiences.

  • Build and own evals for these experiences: define what good output looks like, assemble eval sets that check outputs against the required format and quality, and use the results to improve the solution.

  • Partner with engineering and AI specialists on LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, context management, prompt iteration, model selection, and cost-performance trade-offs.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls for cases where AI confidence, safety risk, or operational complexity requires escalation.

  • Establish quality metrics for chatbots and voice agents, including task completion, containment, hand-off success, latency, retrieval precision, and hallucination rate, and account for how voice agents integrate with telephony and contact-centre tooling.

  • Define the privacy, consent, auditability, and data-handling requirements for customer-facing AI features, especially where personal or sensitive data is involved.

  • Work with Security, Legal, Privacy, and customer stakeholders to agree guardrails for automated decisions, user communications, and autonomous workflows.

 

Requirements

  • Product management experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, workflow, healthtech, proptech, fintech, or another regulated or operational domain.

  • Demonstrable experience building native mobile app products, including ownership of a native iOS or Android app from discovery through release and ongoing iteration.

  • Demonstrable experience shipping AI-powered product features from prototype to production, including controlled rollout and post-launch iteration, ideally across conversational AI, voice agents and telephony, workflow automation, decision support, diagnostics, or intelligent self-service.

  • Strong working knowledge of multimodal models, LLM capabilities and limitations, prompt engineering, tool calling, embeddings, RAG, and AI observability.

  • Fluency with evals: defining what good output looks like, building eval sets to check that outputs meet the required format and quality, and using the results to improve the solution.

  • Hands-on fluency with agentic prototyping and AI-assisted product development tools, such as agentic IDEs and prompt-driven prototyping environments, used to produce testable prototypes.

  • Working knowledge of low-code automation platforms such as n8n, Tray.io, Workato, or Zapier, enough to prototype workflows, scope feasibility, and direct engineering, without owning production builds yourself.

  • Sound understanding of AI risk in production, including hallucination, retrieval failure, automation bias, latency, cost, drift, privacy, and human escalation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication across technical, non-technical, and senior stakeholders.

  • High ambition and a strong bias for action, with the drive to deliver a large roadmap at pace and a positive, can-do attitude.

 

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including ownership of customer-facing product surfaces from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Experience working closely with engineering, design, data, operations, customer success, and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with products that involve scheduling, logistics, case management, customer support, field operations, regulated workflows, or high-volume service journeys.

  • Located in London and able to work from our London office on a hybrid basis.

  • Right to work in the United Kingdom.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Flexible working environment, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners, and social gatherings

  • Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks, fruit, and breakfast cereals

We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

The opportunity.

AI is changing the engineering industry, and we see it as a huge opportunity to deliver more value to our customers, at unprecedented scale and pace, and to a higher standard than ever before. We want to be at the forefront of this change as we become an AI-native engineering organisation.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join us and help shape the next generation of products that transform how organisations use data. You'll join our R&D department, over 200 people across London, Ireland and Malaga, working in cross-functional teams helping to build the Quantexa Platform, our core Contextual Decision Intelligence offering. Our technology helps customers tackle complex challenges across fraud detection, financial crime, data management and more.

What you'll be doing.

  • Work as part of a team to design, build, test and deliver new components and features of the Quantexa Platform, ensuring that they meet our high-quality bar

  • Build clean, well-tested and maintainable software, primarily in Scala, working with agentic tools to accelerate delivery and taking ownership of the quality of everything you ship

  • Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from design, implementation and testing through to deployment and support

  • Work closely with experienced engineers across the business, continuing to develop your technical skills and expertise

  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Designers to understand requirements and help break down upcoming features

Tech Stack.

Agentic tooling and automated workflows are embedded across our software development lifecycle, from design and coding through to testing, review and release, and we are building our own software factory, using services such as Claude to automate and accelerate how our engineers work.

On the back end, we build highly scalable, performant distributed services in Scala, capable of processing huge volumes of data. Our services are built on the Typelevel ecosystem (Cats, Cats Effect and fs2) and Apache Pekko, and we apply techniques such as event sourcing and CQRS in our persistence layer, giving us scalable datastores, flexible enough to meet the varied requirements of our customers.

Our front end is built with Angular, TypeScript and Signals and is designed to be highly extensible, with AI agents accelerating how we build UI components and Playwright underpinning our component and integration testing. We also use Python for our client SDKs, enabling data scientists and engineers to work with the Platform from notebooks and data science environments.

What you'll bring.

  • Are familiar with agentic tools (such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor) and use them as part of their day-to-day development workflow

  • Have commercial experience developing scalable backend applications using JVM languages such as Scala or Java

  • Have a strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, maintainability and performance, and bring rigour and high standards to code review

  • Have an appreciation of functional programming and strongly typed systems, ideally in Scala

  • Understand, or are keen to learn, distributed system architecture, including event-driven design, event sourcing and CQRS

  • Are comfortable with modern delivery practices, ideally with exposure to Infra-as-Code, containerisation, Kubernetes and CI/CD

  • Bring strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning, working collaboratively as part of an engineering team in a fast-paced and rapidly evolving environment

raw.title: Director, Strategic Intelligence - 1066
raw.description:
We are seeking a Director, Strategic Intelligence. In this role you will lead Quantinuum's strategic intelligence function, providing forward-looking insights on markets, competitors, customers, technology developments, government policy, investment activity, and broader industry dynamics. 

The Director, Strategic Intelligence is responsible for building and operating an enterprise intelligence capability that enables executives to make informed strategic decisions, anticipate market shifts, identify growth opportunities, mitigate external risks, and strengthen Quantinuum's competitive position. The role serves as the central hub for market intelligence, competitive intelligence, technology monitoring, customer insights, and strategic analysis across hardware, software, cybersecurity, AI, quantum applications, and adjacent markets. 

Key responsibilities 

  • Strategic Intelligence Leadership: Own Quantinuum's enterprise strategic intelligence capability and be accountable for delivering actionable market, competitor, customer, technology, policy, and ecosystem insights that inform executive decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and long-term growth priorities. 

  • Competitive Intelligence: Own the continuous assessment of competitor strategies, product developments, customer activity, partnerships, acquisitions, investments, and market positioning and be accountable for providing executives and business leaders with timely intelligence that strengthens Quantinuum's competitive advantage. 

  • Market & Industry Analysis: Own the analysis of market dynamics, customer adoption trends, growth segments, and emerging opportunities and be accountable for producing data-driven recommendations that influence business strategy, investment priorities, and commercial focus areas. 

  • Technology & Innovation Intelligence: Own the monitoring and assessment of developments across quantum computing, AI, cybersecurity, networking, advanced computing, and adjacent technology sectors and be accountable for identifying opportunities, threats, and strategic implications for Quantinuum's technology roadmap and market position. 

  • Government, Policy & Geopolitical Intelligence: Monitor the evaluation of government policy, regulatory developments, national quantum initiatives, public funding activity, export controls, and geopolitical trends and be accountable for ensuring business leaders understand the strategic implications for growth, partnerships, market access, and risk. 

  • Customer & Ecosystem Insights: Own the development of a structured voice-of-market capability and be accountable for synthesising customer, prospect, partner, investor, analyst, and ecosystem feedback into insights that improve strategic decision-making and market responsiveness. 

  • Executive & Board Decision Support: Own the development of strategic briefings, market assessments, scenario analyses, and executive recommendations and be accountable for providing fact-based intelligence that supports high-quality decision-making by the Executive Team and Board. 

  • Strategic Planning Support: Own the integration of market, competitive, customer, and technology intelligence into strategic planning processes and be accountable for ensuring that annual and long-range plans are informed by robust external insight and evidence. 

  • Strategic Opportunity & Risk Identification: Own the identification and assessment of emerging opportunities, disruptions, threats, and competitive risks and be accountable for ensuring executive leaders are equipped to act proactively rather than reactively to market developments. 

Must Haves 

  • Strategic Intelligence Leadership (10+ years),  Proven experience leading market intelligence, competitive intelligence, strategic planning, corporate strategy, consulting, research, or business intelligence functions in technology, deep-tech, cybersecurity, software, AI, semiconductor, or adjacent industries. 

 

We Value 

  • Competitive & Market Analysis Expertise:  Strong capability in competitor assessment, market analysis, strategic research, industry forecasting, and synthesis of complex external information into actionable business insights. 

  • Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to distil large volumes of technical, commercial, and market information into concise executive-level recommendations and decision-support materials. 

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:  Demonstrated experience conducting structured analysis, scenario planning, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and strategic assessments. 

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Track record of influencing senior leaders and shaping strategic decisions without direct authority. 

  • Experience in quantum computing, advanced computing, AI, cybersecurity, telecommunications, semiconductors, or other frontier technologies.  

  • Experience within a top-tier strategy consulting firm or a high-growth technology company.  

  • Experience supporting executive leadership teams, CEO staff functions, or Boards.  

  • Exposure to government markets, national security environments, and public-sector technology ecosystems.  

  • Familiarity with M&A strategy, venture capital activity, and technology investment landscapes.  

  • Strong data analytics and intelligence tooling capability. 

 

Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. 

Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. 

By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

Visit our news pages to learn more about Quantinuum and our scientific breakthroughs and achievements:  https://www.quantinuum.com/news
Quantinuum Intro Video: The Future of Quantum Computing

What’s in it for you?

We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

  • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology
  • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance
  • 28 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
  • 4% employer pension contributions
  • Life Insurance
  • Private medical insurance through Bupa
  • Dental Insurance through Bupa
  • Income Protection
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Contribution to eye care
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quantinuum is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, ancestry, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. For more information about Quantinuum, please visit our website. 

We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know use the Lets talk contact form.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, there is no application deadline for this position.

raw.description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, Spotify and Puma are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

We're looking for a German speaker who's built and closed net-new enterprise deals in complex technical products, who blows past growth targets more often than they hit them, and who can turn what they learn about a customer into an account plan the whole team can act on. We care less about a perfect résumé match than clear communication, an entrepreneurial streak, and real curiosity about where your customers' industries are headed.

What you would do

  • Grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, mostly through net-new business: new teams, new use cases, business units that haven't bought Sanity yet.

  • Build your own pipeline instead of waiting for one, and be the advisor customers call before they've even decided to make a move.

  • Run consultative sales cycles start to finish and create expansion inside accounts you already own.

  • Treat renewals as one chapter in a bigger growth story, not the finish line.

  • Prove ROI to the exec who signs the contract and to the editor who lives in Studio every day.

  • Keep account plans current, with next steps tied to what the customer and the company actually need.

  • Partner with Product and other teams to surface opportunities and kill problems before they escalate.

  • Watch customer health and usage data, and act on it early, not at renewal time.

  • Follow your customers' industries closely enough to have a real point of view.

About you

  • Sold net-new into enterprise organizations where a deal means procurement, security review, and half a dozen people who all need convincing, and built that pipeline yourself.

  • Can point to real numbers on revenue, expansion, and account growth.

  • Know how to find the actual decision-maker, earn executive buy-in, and build relationships that outlast any single deal.

  • Consultative, not pushy: read usage data and turn it into a business conversation, talking architecture with a technical lead in one meeting and ROI with a CFO in the next.

  • Ideally some CMS background, or experience selling API-based products in SaaS, CPaaS, or PaaS.

  • Clear, direct written and verbal communication.

  • Comfort working in Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Looker, and G-Suite.

  • Fluency in German and English.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: hands-on, creative, team-oriented, happier building a process than waiting for one.


What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive salary and stock options program

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 300+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

raw.description:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

 

About the Role:

Build and mature Sitecore’s Employee Relations and Investigations practice, creating the operating model, investigation standards, policy framework, governance and practical toolkits needed to drive consistency and confidence across the business. Serve as the subject-matter expert for complex employee relations matters and workplace investigations, partnering with business leaders, People Business Partners and Legal to ensure fair, thorough and risk-conscious outcomes. Use case insights, early intervention, manager enablement and preventative practices to address issues before they escalate, strengthen working relationships and continuously improve the employee experience

 

What You'll Do:

Employee Relations

  • Develop and implement the ER framework covering intake, assessment, investigation, escalation, resolution and follow-up, with clear responsibilities, decision points, guidance and templates for managers/HRBPs

  • Partner with managers and HRBPs to recognise emerging concerns, intervene early; facilitate informal resolution and mediation where appropriate to resolve issues before they escalate

  • Independently manage grievances and workplace concerns; lead or coordinate fair investigations with clear documentation and evidence-based findings

  • Partner with managers and HRBPs on recommendations, decisions and communication, involving Legal and other specialists as appropriate and escalating sensitive or high-risk matters

  • Maintain accurate, confidential records; use case trends to identify recurring issues and preventative action. Build manager and HRBP capability through practical guidance, coaching and training

HR policies

  • Own the policy lifecycle: identify gaps, draft and update policies, and coordinate consultation, approval, communication and review to support business needs, consistent employee experiences and applicable employment requirements

  • Partner with Legal, HRBPs and subject matter experts to balance a consistent company approach with local requirements; maintain a central library with clear ownership, version control and review dates

  • Create accessible guidance, templates and communications for employees and managers, using employee feedback and case experience to improve policy clarity and application

Employment compliance

  • Maintain a compliance tracker with Legal and local HR partners covering requirements, actions, owners and deadlines; coordinate legislation implementation through policy, process, guidance and training updates

  • Review ER processes and policy application, identify gaps, agree corrective actions and track completion. Coordinate policy acknowledgements and relevant mandatory training, maintaining completion records

  • Support employment-related audits and information requests with clear records and track agreed follow-up actions.

 

What you will bring:

  • Substantial relevant ER experience, typically around eight years, or equivalent relevant education and experience; independent management of complex, sensitive cases from assessment through resolution

  • Experience in early intervention, manager coaching, informal resolution, ER process development and drafting, reviewing and implementing HR policies

  • Strong working knowledge of employment legislation in supported jurisdictions, judgement about seeking specialist legal advice, and experience across countries or partnering with local specialists on different employment requirements.

  • Sound judgement in assessing incomplete or conflicting information and making practical recommendations; strong investigation, documentation and communication skills, explaining sensitive issues clearly and influencing stakeholders.

  • Ability to build workable processes while managing an active caseload and competing priorities

  • Experience partnering closely with in-house Legal or external employment counsel

Nice to have:

  • A qualification or background in employment law, legal studies, or employment legislation and regulatory compliance

  • Litigation experience

A relevant HR qualification or professional accreditation

Why Join Sitecore?

At Sitecore, you'll have the opportunity to shape and strengthen how we manage employee relations, support our leaders and create consistent employee experience across a global organization.

This is a highly visible role where you will have the opportunity to influence people practices, build scalable frameworks and partner with stakeholders across the business, making a tangible contribution to both our culture and organizational effectiveness.

 

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore:

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.
