raw.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
raw.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team in London or Munich with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of our Gift Cards vertical; one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning provider integrations, checkout and redemption flows, and multi-market expansion across France, Germany, and Spain.

You will lead commercial relationships with key gift card providers, define the product roadmap, and partner with engineering and design to scale gift cards into an integrated core offering across web, app, and browser extensions.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PM1

#LI-Hybrid

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com is looking for a proactive, data-driven and highly technical Associate to join our global Network Fee Management team. In this role, you’ll be building end-to-end AI solutions and fee simulation models, querying large-scale databases and transaction datasets, and evaluating card scheme economics to ensure billing accuracy and identify cost efficiencies. Partnering directly with commercial teams, you’ll deliver client-facing insights, prepare data-backed scenarios and cost models to support pricing strategies and help win and retain key merchant business.

Based in London as a core quantitative and data contributor, you’ll collaborate across Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. You’ll maintain and expand analytical models, design and deploy AI models from inception to production and evaluate scheme release impacts through structured data pipelines helping to automate this process. By turning complex database and fee data into practical financial models and actionable recommendations, you’ll directly guide commercial strategy, pricing decisions, and merchant discussions through strong project ownership and stakeholder influence.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Tools, Data & Insight: Lead the end-to-end development of AI models - from data pipeline creation and training to final deployment - to drive automation, build predictive reporting, and improve analytical tools.

  • End-to-End AI & Predictive Modeling: Develop, train, and deploy machine learning and predictive models from start to finish to assess scheme changes (Visa, Mastercard), detect fee leakage, and identify cost optimization opportunities automatically.

  • Controls, Governance & Process Improvement: Maintain clear controls, documentation, and repeatable processes for fee analysis, reconciliations, and change management, helping the team work accurately and efficiently across markets.

  • Cost Simulation Engines: Architect and scale simulation engines and data models that enable internal Commercial and Finance teams to stress-test interchange and scheme fee changes without manual intervention.

  • Network Fee Analysis & Reconciliation: Analyse network and scheme fee data across data sources and scheme insights. Investigate variances, identify root causes, and document findings with clear supporting evidence.

What We're Looking For

  • Cost Model Delivery: Direct experience successfully designing, building, and launching complex global Cost models and structural frameworks, to aid the business in strategic design making.

  • Payments Expertise: 3+ years of experience in the payments industry within a fast-paced B2B environment, must have an understanding of payment network fee structures (Interchange, Scheme Fees, etc.) in particular Visa and Mastercard.

  • Operational Excellence & Commercial Impact: exceptionally organised and proactive operator who looks to drive continuous improvement, strengthens revenue assurance, and identifies opportunities to optimise costs.

  • Advanced SQL & Databases: Expert-level proficiency in SQL (window functions, query cost optimization, partitioning/clustering) and a comprehensive understanding of relational and analytical database architectures, with a strong proficiency in Big Query for data extraction and transformation; hands-on experience with BI tools.

  • Ambiguity & Drive: Takes ownership of complex, evolving scheme-fee challenges - reconciling data and turning fee changes into clear, practical guidance for merchants and internal teams.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

The Role

Checkout is looking for an experienced financial crime compliance lead to establish, grow, and maintain a global second-line team. This role will oversee the compliance frameworks supporting our rapidly evolving portfolio of mass market products.

This opportunity is a perfect fit if you are excited by the prospect of leveraging the momentum and resources of a global scale-up to support the launch and scale of high velocity products. As products expand and launch, there will be an opportunity to grow your team across multiple regions.

You will be expected to:

  • Build the Framework: Establish the global framework for second-line escalations for new products; working closely with relevant regional MLROs to ensure consistency and operational excellence.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Risk, Operations, and Product teams to align compliance requirements with fraud mitigation and user experience goals.

  • Monitor Emerging Trends: Maintain a deep understanding of financial crime typologies, regulatory guidance, and emerging industry trends, ensuring these are proactively factored into our control framework and knowledge base.

  • Design & Deliver Training: Develop and deliver targeted training to business and compliance teams regarding complex financial crime and fraud risks inherent in high-volume environments.

  • Ensure Compliance-by-Design: Partner with our Regulatory Compliance function to integrate compliance requirements early in the product development lifecycle.

  • Own Compliance Requirements: Assume central responsibility for mapping and maintaining SDD, CDD, and EDD requirements for our evolving product set, ensuring relevant factors are codified into global minimum standards.

  • Strategic Advisory: Directly advise Product and Operations teams on the opportunities and risks associated with automation, AI deployment, and system scale.

  • Integrate Risk Assessments: Collaborate closely with regional MLROs to ensure product-specific risk profiles are accurately captured and factored into Business-Wide Risk Assessments.

  • Implement Assurance: Collaborate with our Assurance and Internal Controls team to design and execute robust compliance monitoring processes for new product lines.

Experience we are looking for:

  • 6+ years of second-line compliance experience in fintech, payments, or banking at scale (neobank/fintech experience strongly preferred).

  • Deep expertise in financial crime (AML/CFT/Sanctions/Fraud) risk, with regulatory compliance experience as a strong plus.

  • Experience growing and leading a team, with cross-border/global management experience highly desirable.

  • Proven track record in architecting frameworks for high-volume environments and working directly with technical/product stakeholders to design solutions.

Personal qualities we look for:

  • Confident decision-maker: Ability to quickly assess risks, weigh mitigations, and provide strong, defensible rationale for your decisions.

  • Technical fluency: Comfortable working directly with technical leaders to drill down into the configuration of user journeys, systems, and tooling.

  • AI-first mindset: Experience deploying AI or automation tools to accelerate compliance processes at scale.

  • Strategic thinker: Ability to immerse yourself in fine details while keeping the broader organisational picture in mind.

  • Growth-oriented: Relentlessly curious and driven; always learning and spotting opportunities to develop yourself and others.

  • Proportionate and Collaborative: An obsession with balancing strong compliance with scalability and user experience, supported by exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

Company Description

Checkout.com will grow you faster than you expect - the deals, the pace, and the people demand it. If you've ever felt a role never let you show what you're truly capable of, this is the opposite problem: meaningful deals with some of the UK's and the world's biggest brands, real autonomy, and no ceiling on what you can take on.

You'll join the Solutions team in London and own the technical side of deals from first conversation to go-live. Pre-sale, you're front and centre: positioning the platform, building demos and POCs, winning over the merchant's engineers and architects while your Account Executive drives the commercial thread. Once the deal is ready, the weight shifts: our Implementation Engineers lead the build and you stay close, so your designs survive contact with reality.

You'll work on a modern, fast-moving platform with docs that answer your questions, alongside one of the strongest commercial teams in payments.

People who do well here are curious by default: they pull threads, teach themselves what the job needs next, and act before anyone asks. If that's how you work, you'll like it here.

What you will be doing:

  • Support the commercial team to position Checkout.com's products, solutions, and services - and win deals. You'll be a key partner to Account Executives on product, payments, regulation, and tech.

  • Understand merchant requirements and technical needs, map them to our APIs and products, create solution designs and internal documentation.

  • Run demos, build "show-me" payment flows, create POCs, customise and create presentations.

  • Provide thought leadership on all aspects of Payment Performance - Acceptance Rate, Fraud Prevention, Tokenisation, Payment Methods, and others.

  • Lead all technical interactions with merchants - chats, calls, meetings, and workshops - from first contact through go-live, partnering with our Implementation Engineers during integration.

  • Support the BID management team with RFP and RFI responses.

  • Enable internal functions, commercial and tech, with market and merchant feedback on product capabilities. Champion product change and improvement.

  • Stay up to date with industry standards, solutions, and tech.

  • Be an expert on Checkout.com's platform and products.

About You:

If the list below looks like you, apply.

Experience

  • 2+ years as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Consultant, Implementation Engineer, or TAM. At a PSP or payments company is a bonus.

  • Merchant-side counts too: checkout engineering, an in-house payments team, a payments product role.

  • Experience in a technical, client-facing role.

Payments and technical skills

We need real depth in one of the two areas below and the appetite to close the gap on the other. If payments is your strength, this job will make you more technical, you'll need to want that. Strong coder lighter on payments: payments can be taught, you'll have time.

Payments:

  • Understanding of the end-to-end payment flow and the industry's rules, regulations, and schemes.

  • Experience with 3DS, Network Tokenisation, Apple/Google Pay, APMs, Open Banking, or fraud-risk engines.

Tech:

  • You can code and you're comfortable with web technologies - payments run on the web. At least one front-end (JavaScript, React, Angular) or back-end (Java, .NET, Python, Node) language.

  • Familiar with API-based integration (REST/JSON, Postman); can reproduce, isolate, and explain issues using logs, API responses, and tests.

How you work

  • Clear written and verbal English; equally at home with developers and product teams as with payments, finance, and C-level stakeholders.

  • Commercially minded: you talk revenue, volume, and pricing, not just APIs, and push deals forward without being asked.

  • Highly organised; able to prioritise shifting workloads.

Nice to have:

  • Previous exposure to RFI/RFP processes.

  • Familiarity with PSD2/PSD3/PSR, FCA, ISO-8583.

  • An additional language.

  • Former engineering, developer, or product manager background.

  • Prior roles in the e-commerce industry.

Checkout.com is looking for a proactive, analytical Senior Associate, Network Fee Management to join our global NFM team. Partnering directly with Sales and Account Management, you’ll deliver client facing insights to help win and retain key merchant business.

Based in London as the regional expert, you’ll collaborate across Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations.   • Revenue Assurance & Cost Optimisation: Identify fee leakage, billing discrepancies, and opportunities to reduce costs through detailed analysis and ongoing monitoring. Recommend practical actions that protect revenue and improve fee accuracy.

  • Controls, Governance & Process Improvement: Maintain clear controls, documentation, and repeatable processes for fee analysis, reconciliations, and change management, helping the team work accurately and efficiently across markets.

  • Tools, Data & Insight: Utilising AI, this role will be expected to work on projects that improve reporting, analytical tools, and automation.

  • Operational Excellence & Commercial Impact: exceptionally organised and proactive operator who looks to drive continuous improvement, strengthens revenue assurance, and identifies opportunities to optimise costs.

  • Ambiguity & Drive: Takes ownership of complex, evolving scheme-fee challenges - reconciling data and turning fee changes into clear, practical guidance for merchants and internal teams.

Every payment we process runs on the infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com, the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are building a platform that lets product teams run across multiple clouds and regions. We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager who can turn a complex, multi-team technical programme into a plan people trust and deliver against.

This is a senior role in an established, fast-moving team. You will own the multi-cloud and multi-region programme end to end: the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the roadmap. You will bring enough technical depth to work as a peer with our engineers and architects, and pair it with a product mindset: you treat the platform as a product with internal customers, and you judge success by whether those teams adopt it.

As a Senior Technical Programme Manager, you are responsible for delivering the programme across teams you don't manage. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure the programme meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

What we are looking for:

  • A track record of delivering large infrastructure or platform programmes: a cloud migration, a new region, a cloud landing zone build, a data centre exit, or similar infrastructure related project within a fast paced technology environment

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers. You won’t need low level knowledge but you should be comfortable discussing networking between clouds and regions, identity and access, infrastructure as code pipelines, and what latency, data residency and failover mean for payments workloads

  • Experience working with cloud providers and partners to align their support and funding with your delivery plan, ideally Azure alongside AWS

  • Product thinking applied to internal platforms: you have treated engineering teams as customers, worked out what they need, and measured whether they adopted it.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders

  • Proven ability to get commitments from teams and leaders who don't report to you.

  • Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or payments

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Run the programme end to end, from sequencing the work through to production, across several teams and multiple cloud providers.

  • Turn architecture decisions into delivery plans. Work with our senior engineers and architects on design trade-offs, make sure decisions get written down, and spot when a decision is blocking delivery.

  • Manage dependencies and risk across teams you don't control, and escalate early, with options, when something is going to slip.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Staff Engineer (Payment Processing) at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for our Gateway, Routing and Payout platforms. Every payment and payout we process passes through these systems, from the merchant's API request to the routing decision that sends it to the right acquirer, payment method or payout rail. Correctness matters on every transaction, and small changes in availability, latency or routing quality show up directly in our merchants' approval rates and revenue.

This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade-offs that come with it: latency budgets on the authorisation path, failure domains and blast radius, consistency and idempotency across regions, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams - shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let them scale by an order of magnitude

  • Design for resilience from first principles - redundancy, graceful degradation, backpressure, idempotency and recovery - so that partial failures never become customer-facing outages

  • Set and defend the non-functional requirements that matter: availability targets, latency percentiles, throughput ceilings, data durability and recovery objectives

  • Lead the hardest technical decisions end to end, from problem framing and design review through to production rollout, migration and decommissioning of what came before

  • Drive operational excellence by improving observability, alerting, capacity planning, load and chaos testing, and incident response, and by closing the loop on the root causes you find

  • Raise the engineering bar across teams through design reviews, code review, pairing and mentorship, growing the senior engineers around you

  • Partner with product, platform and other engineering teams to sequence delivery, remove blockers and keep multi-team programmes aligned on a single technical direction

  • Make pragmatic build-versus-buy and refactor-versus-rewrite calls, and communicate the reasoning and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and senior leadership

Experience and qualifications

  • Significant experience building and operating distributed backend systems in production, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams

  • Demonstrable experience designing for high throughput and low latency, and a strong intuition for where systems break under load

  • Deep understanding of resilience patterns in distributed systems: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breaking, queueing and backpressure, consistency and failure modes

  • Strong proficiency in either .NET or Java, and the ability to write clear, production-ready code that others can maintain

  • Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures, and with relational and non-relational data stores at scale

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based application development (we use AWS & Azure), containers, orchestration and infrastructure as code

  • Experience owning production systems on call, with a strong sense of ownership for observability, monitoring and incident response

  • Experience leading complex migrations or re-architectures of live, business-critical systems with no loss of availability or data integrity

  • Excellent communication skills, able to influence without authority, write clear design documents, and express technical trade-offs to engineering and non-technical audiences alike

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in payments, financial services or another domain with strict correctness, auditability or regulatory requirements

  • Experience with multi-region or active-active architectures, including data replication and failover strategies

  • A history of mentoring engineers into senior and staff-level roles

Our Strategic & Leadership Hiring team leads Director, Senior Director, VP and C-suite hiring across functions and global locations. raw.title: VP of Engineering
raw.description:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

About Us

ClearBank is a technology‑enabled, fully regulated bank providing cloud‑based banking and payments infrastructure to financial institutions. We operate at scale in a highly regulated environment, where trust, resilience and security are critical.

Our engineering organisation is focused on enabling frequent, reliable change while maintaining strong controls. We believe quality is not a gate at the end of delivery, but something designed in from the very start.

Role Purpose

This is a senior leadership role accountable for the strategy, design, build, operation and ongoing resilience of ClearBank’s payments and cards platforms.

The VP of Payments & Cards will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for real-time, scheme-connected payments and cards systems across the UK, Europe, and future international markets. This requires deep experience working close to the infrastructure that moves money. Ideally, this will include direct integration with major payment schemes or rails, such as FPS, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK, SEPA payment schemes in Europe, or ACH and Fedwire in the US. We will also consider experience gained through payment infrastructure providers or connectivity platforms provided it includes sufficient technical depth in payment processing, scheme connectivity and the operation of highly available, regulated payments infrastructure. The role will define platform strategy, engineering standards, tooling and ways of working, while embedding a shift-left quality mindset across delivery. Success means delivering highly resilient, highly available, secure, scalable and compliant platforms that enable frequent, reliable change in a regulated banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, design, build and run of real-time payments and cards platforms across the UK, Europe, the US and future international markets, including direct scheme connectivity and integrations with third-party payment infrastructure providers.

  • Lead the delivery and operation of digital wallet capabilities, including Apple Pay and Google Pay implementations.

  • Set the technical direction for payments and cards platforms, ensuring architectural choices support resilience, availability, scalability, performance, security and cost efficiency.

  • Own the budget for the Payments and Cards engineering teams, ensuring effective investment in people, tooling and platforms.

  • Build, lead and develop high-performing engineering teams, creating clear accountability, strong delivery discipline and a culture of engineering excellence.

  • Ensure platforms are designed and operated to meet the following outcomes:

  • Highly resilient — supporting local and cross-region disaster recovery requirements.

  • Highly available — targeting 99.999% aggregate internal availability where appropriate.

  • Highly scalable — supporting aggressive growth targets and future business volumes.

  • Performant — meeting scheme performance requirements and exceeding client expectations on latency.

  • Cost optimised — balancing client value, operational efficiency and ClearBank’s cost base.

  • Establish scalable engineering quality standards, practices and governance across the payments and cards domain.

  • Embed quality, observability, operational readiness and control requirements into delivery practices and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive engineering productivity through AI-assisted and increasingly agentic software engineering, including the effective use of AI coding tools and multi-agent approaches across development, testing and engineering workflows, with appropriate risk, security and regulatory guardrails.

  • Partner closely with the CTO, engineering leaders, product, risk, compliance and operations teams to ensure delivery decisions balance pace, quality and control.

  • Ensure software development and platform operations meet regulatory, audit, resilience and compliance expectations.

Skills & Experience

  • Senior engineering leadership experience in payments, cards or highly regulated financial technology environments.

  • Proven experience establishing, scaling and operating engineering teams, standards and practices.

  • Direct experience integrating with, building against or operating connectivity to payment schemes or rails. Relevant examples include Faster Payments, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK; SEPA payment schemes and associated euro payment infrastructure in Europe; ACH or Fedwire in the US; or card networks and associated issuing or acquiring infrastructure. Alternatively, substantial experience delivering payment connectivity through a provider such as Form3 or an equivalent platform, with demonstrable technical depth in how payments are processed, routed and operated.

  • Experience delivering or operating digital wallet capabilities, such as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

  • Strong understanding of real-time, high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Strong background working in regulated environments, with practical experience of audit, compliance, operational resilience and control frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of shift-left quality, test automation, modern quality engineering and secure software development practices.

  • Experience using modern AI-enabled engineering tooling and a strong understanding of how agentic or multi-agent approaches can improve software development, testing and engineering delivery in a controlled and responsible way.

  • Strong security mindset, with an appreciation of evolving threats, mitigations and secure platform design.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence across multiple teams and senior stakeholders, including where direct line management is not present.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, risk, compliance and executive stakeholders.

  • Sound judgement in balancing delivery pace, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, operational risk and engineering quality.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

  • Comfort with research and insights work and conviction about AI moderation; deep research expertise is a plus, not a requirement

  • A charismatic presenter and leader

  • Strong commercial instinct: comfortable owning renewals, expansion and forecasts alongside Sales

raw.description:
What we are building at Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

#3 How we operate

  • We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time.

  • We work hard, and we have fun.

  • To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team.

The Role

As a Sales Manager at Conveo, you'll lead a team of six Account Executives and turn them into the best-performing sales team in our category. You'll own your team's number, coach every rep to their full potential, and build the rhythm that makes great selling repeatable: sharp discovery, airtight qualification, accurate forecasting, and winning bake-offs. You'll stay close to the deals that matter most, stepping in with CMOs, insights leaders, and procurement when it counts, and you'll make sure every account and every new-logo pursuit on your team has a clear owner and a clear plan. You'll work hand in hand with the founders, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product, and you'll help us hire and ramp the next wave of sellers as we scale across EMEA. You'll report to our EMEA Head of Revenue.

Your Mission

Lead and Grow a Team of Six AEs

  • Own your team's quarterly and annual targets, and make sure every AE has a clear path to hitting their own number.

  • Run weekly 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews that are short, sharp, and actually change outcomes.

  • Coach in the field: join discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, and give feedback the same day.

  • Build individual development plans so every AE knows exactly what great looks like and how to get there.

  • Set the bar on activity, pipeline generation, and deal quality, and hold the team to it with care and candour.

Build a Repeatable Sales Engine

  • Embed our sales methodology (SPICED discovery, MEDDIC qualification, and mutual close plans) into every deal.

  • Own a forecast you would bet your reputation on, with HubSpot as the single source of truth.

  • Keep every account and new-logo pursuit on your team owned, planned, and moving.

  • Turn the patterns in won and lost deals into better talk tracks, playbooks, and enablement.

  • Partner with Marketing and our BDRs to make sure your team always has 4-5x pipeline coverage.

Win the Deals That Matter

  • Get involved in your team's largest and most complex opportunities, from first meeting to signature.

  • Help your AEs multi-thread across insights, marketing, product, procurement, and the executive suite.

  • Lead from the front on competitive bake-offs and keep our winning record intact.

  • Bring in founders and senior leaders at the right moments to win.

  • Hand every new customer over to Customer Success set up to expand.

Hire and Ramp the Best

  • Help us hire world-class AEs as we scale the team aggressively over the next year.

  • Onboard new hires fast, so they're running their own deals within their first few months.

  • Build a team culture people want to join: ambitious, generous, high-energy, and obsessed with our clients.

What Success Looks Like

  • Your team consistently hits its number, quarter after quarter.

  • Every AE on your team is growing, with a clear development plan and visible progress against it.

  • Accurate forecasts and healthy 4-5x pipeline coverage across your team.

  • New hires fully ramped within their first four to five months.

  • Repeatable plays, talk tracks, and coaching habits we can roll out across the whole sales org.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of B2B sales in Enterprise SaaS or Martech, including a strong track record as a quota-carrying AE.

  • 3-5+ years leading and coaching a team of AEs, with a history of hitting team targets.

  • Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder deals into large enterprises with long sales cycles.

  • A coach first: you make people better, and your reps would follow you to your next company.

  • A data-driven operator who lives in the CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) and forecasts with precision.

  • Great if you have a background in market research, insights, brand, or consulting.

  • Great if you've scaled a sales team through hypergrowth, across EMEA and the US.

  • High energy, self-motivation, and a relentless drive to win.

  • Excellent communication skills: clear, direct, and credible with both your team and senior executives.

  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced, low-politics, high-standards environment.

Why join us

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

Plus

  • Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company.

  • Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

  • Lead a team selling to some of the world’s most iconic brands.

  • Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

raw.title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
raw.description:
Product Manager, Safety & Compliance

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.

The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.

If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

  • Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

  • Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

  • Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

  • Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS.

  • You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

  • You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

  • You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.

  • You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.

  • You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.

  • You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.

  • You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."

  • You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

Nice to have:

  • Experience with trust and safety, content moderation, risk scoring or compliance tooling.

  • Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

  • Experience with regulated content and privacy rules: FTC disclosure guidelines, music and content licensing, alcohol promotion, or GDPR and CCPA, and how they shape product requirements.

  • Experience shipping customer-facing APIs, webhooks or enterprise integrations.

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, martech or influencer workflows.

raw.title: Site Associate - Glasgow
raw.description:
Title: Site Associate 

Location: Glasgow

Pay: £13.25 per hour 

Part-time; (10 hours per week)

 

About Deliveroo Editions

With a dash of hard-work, a sprinkle of teamwork and a whole dollop of creativity, we created “Editions” which is our ‘dark kitchens’ business. We have partnered with some fantastic restaurants such as Wagamama, Starbucks, Pho and Gourmet Burger Company to help further connect them with hungry customers. 

Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. Deliveroo Editions were the world's first delivery-only kitchens, and we are still the market leaders in helping our restaurant partners succeed. What’s even more exciting is that we’re expanding our portfolio further.

Great people help to drive our business forward and we are always looking for more to join our sites. If you don’t have the exact experience, that’s okay, we’d still love to hear from you. 

Does this sound tasty to you? Take a look at our Kitchen Assistant role and apply below to join the Roo family.

About the role

The Cleaner / Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners. 

Responsibilities will include:

  • You will report into the Site Manager and the site management team.

  • Ensuring that the cleanliness of the site is maintained to a high standard by cleaning as you go throughout the shift as well as regular deep cleaning of various equipment throughout the week

  • Cleaning communal areas, such as staff room, bathrooms, stock rooms, maintaining site health and safety standards at all times

  • Working with the management team to ensure a safe and clean site by participating in regularly checking

  • Supporting our partners by keeping kitchen equipment clean and ready for use throughout the shift with the pot wash

Who we are looking for

  • You radiate positivity!

  • You have a great attitude to work, you are driven and have willingness to learn

  • You are a team player, punctuality and reliability is your forte

  • You always go above and beyond, you’re looking to progress in your career

  • You can work autonomously but you LOVE working with a fantastic team and with our partners

  • You like to solve problems, making recommendations on how to improve daily tasks

  • Previous experience in a Kitchen Porter or Kitchen Cleaner role is a bonus, but don’t worry if you haven’t, if you have the right attitude and drive, we can train you.

What to expect from the interview process

  • Step 1: apply for any role you'd like to be considered for - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Step 2: if your application is successful, you will receive an assessment from Maki People

  • Step 3: if you're successful following assessment, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

  • Step 4: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

  • Step 5: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

Why Deliveroo


Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. . We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace and Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

raw.title: Warehouse Associate - Part Time
raw.description:
Warehouse Associate

Location: Hoxton (E2)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Hoxton team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

  • Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

  • Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

  • Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

  • A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

  • Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

Our Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

raw.description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Brighton - St Josephs Business Park (BN3)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Brighton team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

raw.title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company's financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations EMEA (L3)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role outline

Proposed title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations

Location: London Head Office (The River Building) - Hybrid working (60% in Head Office)

Mission: Ensure a reliable and scalable courier network across EMEA markets by continuously optimising the end-to-end lifecycle experience. You will translate data-driven insights into practical actions that strengthen engagement, performance, and long-term participation. Your role is to maintain the right balance of supply to meet changing operational and customer demand across markets.

Core interfaces: EMEA Dasher & Logistics Operations (Regional Operations, Planning & Performance, Content & Engagement), Product, Data Science, Analytics Engineering as needed.

Job Description (ready to paste into Greenhouse)

The team

The EMEA Strategy & Operations team is responsible for ensuring our Dasher network remains stable, engaged, and responsive across multiple markets. We oversee the processes behind courier onboarding and activation, focusing on enabling new couriers to get started successfully and supporting ongoing participation over time.

Our mission is to maintain a reliable and adaptable supply base that can flex in line with changing customer and operational demand. We combine data insights, operational strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure our network remains healthy, resilient, and ready to scale.

The role

As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in shaping the performance and stability of our courier network across multiple markets. You will focus on supporting the teams responsible for onboarding and activation through data driven insights.

 

This is a fast-paced and high-impact role, centred on understanding network dynamics, identifying emerging risks or opportunities, and implementing effective operational responses. You will be accountable for maintaining a healthy and responsive supply base throughout the lifecycle, ensuring it aligns with business and customer needs.

 

You will operate as a hands-on operator, executing upon team initiatives and driving continuous improvement. Working closely with cross-functional partners across operations, product, analytics, and other central teams, you will translate data and insights into scalable processes and frameworks. 

 

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience delivering operational improvements through complex data analysis and modelling in fast-paced environments. You have a track record of identifying gaps or opportunities and working across teams to build scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical capability. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, structuring problems clearly and using data to inform decisions and prioritisation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and confidence working with large datasets. You can use data to answer business questions and track performance, combining strong logical thinking with the ability to learn quickly. Experience building dashboards or automating reporting is a plus.
  • Confidence using AI tools to improve how work gets done. You can integrate AI into existing processes to improve efficiency and the quality of outputs, applying sound judgement to validate results.
  • A strong bias for outcomes. You focus on delivering impact, measuring results, and iterating based on evidence and learning.

Preferred, but not required

  • Familiarity with experimentation, measurement design, and operational change management.
  • You have experience using basic automation tools (like Zapier, smart spreadsheets, or basic scripts) to automate repetitive tasks and build simple systems that handle high-volume operations.
  • Experience with courier, logistics, or gig economy operations.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to be the definitive food company. We are transforming the way the world eats by making food more convenient and accessible. We are a technology-driven company working at pace, with the autonomy to build, test, and ship. If you enjoy solving messy problems and turning them into scalable systems, you will find plenty to do here.

Location and working pattern

This role is based in our London Head Office (The River Building) and follows our hybrid working approach, with an expectation of around 60% of your time in the office. We aim to be flexible where possible, balancing individual needs with collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and delivery.

Benefits and diversity

At Deliveroo, people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer a wide range of competitive benefits across health, family, finance, community, growth, and time away.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. We welcome people from all backgrounds and identities. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of building one of the fastest growing technology businesses in an exciting space.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
