raw.title: Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
  • Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
  • Help build out DoorDash's international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.
  • Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.

We're excited about you because…

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.
  • You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.
  • You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.
  • You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities.
  • You're comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don't need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.
  • You're an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.
  • You're comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).
  • You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.
  • You're an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Partner closely with business stakeholders with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Learn something new everyday Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.title: Senior Global Rider Escalations Representative
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Role

We're looking for a talented person to join the Global Escalations department, a bustling and vibrant team who support riders with various escalated contact reasons. This is the perfect opportunity to join an exciting, fast-growing business and expand your operational abilities, whilst supporting riders when they need our support the most. You will also work closely with our Restaurant, Customer and Legal teams to resolve incidents involving riders. 

Reporting into the Rider Escalations Team Lead, you will be a key part of the team that ensures we are providing best in class support to our Riders, Customers and Restaurants. As a Senior Rep, you will work on escalated incidents, as well as supporting the team to drive improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Providing support to riders via email and sometimes over the phone
  • Reviewing incident reports and making decisions on rider behaviour inline with our internal policies
  • Being a key point of contact with our stakeholders in Customer Care, Legal, Restaurant Support and Policy, as well as within the Rider Services Centre and Safety teams in all markets
  • Working with our insurers and the police to resolve queries
  • Responding to escalated queries, and supporting junior members of the team through more complex incidents
  • Ensuring our training materials and best practice guides are up to date
  • Carrying out regular quality calibrations to ensure compliance to procedures and process
  • Identifying areas for improvement and working on those solutions with the Team Lead to increase team performance and quality
  • Reviewing Supplier Agreement offboardings to enhance trust and transparency
  • Working to ambitious targets while maintaining a high and consistent level of productivity and quality
  • Situations aren't always clear cut, so you will need to be confident making decisions in line with our internal policies.

Requirements

Required

  • Excellent Communicator: You are confident and highly proficient in written and spoken English, as well as a second language (currently prioritising applicants who are proficient in written and spoken French, Italian or Cantonese)
  • Organised: You are detail-oriented and can prioritise the right work at the right time
  • Collaborative: You enjoy working with others in a fast-changing environment with ambitious targets
  • Inquisitive: You are curious and can challenge processes that aren't working -- you get to the bottom of things
  • Adaptable: You are creative, resourceful and comfortable making decisions with ambiguous information
  • Motivated: You are enthusiastic, goal-oriented, and eager to always improve
  • Analytical: You are confident with data and familiar with Excel/Gsheets
  • Empathetic: You are keen to provide riders with world class support 

Desirable

  • Experience using Zendesk
  • You have a university degree or equivalent experience (Prior experience in Customer Support preferred)

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

raw.title: Software Engineer
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Engineering the future of customer support — at global scale 🌍

We believe exceptional customer service is more than just a feature, it's a fundamental part of who we are. That's why we've built our own internal support tooling from the ground up, tailored to help our customer, courier, and merchant support teams shine in every interaction.

As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. The Support Engineering group is at the heart of this mission. We build high-performance admin applications and core operational tools that empower our support teams to work smarter and faster. A key part of this is our in-house chat platform, which already handles around 5 million conversations every month. On top of this foundation, we're developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we're ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

 

About the role

We're now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You'll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

     

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • Production experience in Golang, with an interest in developing strong engineering practices.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

 

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

     

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

raw.title: Software Engineer II (Full-Stack) - Consumer Order Experience
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact on your own development, on Deliveroo as we scale, and on the marketplace and communities we serve.

Consumer Ordering Experience owns the core purchase journey: the store page, item page, basket, and checkout flow, across both app and web. It's a global team — the surfaces we build support all of our brands: Deliveroo, Wolt, and Doordash. You'd be the team's first dedicated web/full-stack engineer, helping us build out our web experience from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the store, item, basket, and checkout experiences on web, working primarily in React and TypeScript
  • Contribute to backend services written in Golang — deep Go experience isn't a hard requirement, but you should be comfortable picking up a new statically typed backend language
  • Improve code structure, shape architecture, and review code across the team
  • Partner closely with your Product Manager and fellow engineers to scope and ship changes to the ordering funnel
  • Take part in the hiring process and support the growth of your teammates as the team scales

 

What We're Looking For

Must haves:

  • Strong full-stack experience — comfortable working across web frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go, or similar) to unblock delivery end-to-end
  • Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)
  • Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief PRD through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding
  • Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience coordinating engineers across multiple platforms (iOS/Android/Web/BE) on a single initiative
  • Active use of AI-assisted coding workflows, and interest in building reusable tooling/skills for the team

 

We're looking for someone London-based who can work from our office 2–3 days a week alongside the rest of the team.

 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

There's a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll join a team building the technology that makes those connections possible. From creating user-friendly experiences to working on the systems behind them, you'll help develop, maintain and ship products used by customers, merchants and riders.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers to solve real problems, with support from a dedicated manager and mentor. Along the way, you'll build your skills, learn how we develop products at scale and see the impact of your work.

This is a full-time, 12-week internship based at our London HQ, starting in summer 2027. It's open to students currently enrolled in higher education and in the penultimate year of study. 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll join a team of engineers building technology that improves the experience of consumers, merchants and Riders. During your 12-week internship, you'll collaborate with your team to solve customer problems and help develop, maintain and ship products.

  • You'll contribute to technical projects with support from your manager, mentor and team.
  • You'll learn about the systems you work on, from user-friendly product experiences to scalable backend architecture.
  • You'll develop your engineering skills through feedback, coaching and mentorship.
  • You'll collaborate with your team to solve problems and contribute to business priorities.
  • You'll take part in intern programming, including leadership speaker sessions and social events, both virtually and in person.
  • You'll share what you've learned in a final presentation at the end of your internship.

We're looking for strong engineering foundations and curiosity to learn. Here's what you'll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You're pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field and expect to graduate between autumn 2027 and summer 2028.
  • You have no more than two years of full-time work experience.
  • You're available to start in June 2027 and work in person for the duration of the internship.
  • You have experience working with databases and technologies such as SQL.
  • You have a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures.
  • You're proficient in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Python, Java or Kotlin.
  • You have experience writing clean code, using version control and writing unit tests.

raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰Competitive Salary

This is an individual contributor position where you'll run the full sales cycle from outreach through to issued financial products (loans, cards and lines of credit). This is a fast-paced, phone-driven role built for high-performers who thrive on volume. You’ll turn outbound conversations into long-term funding partnerships and customers who keep coming back.

  • Engage, nurture, and close a high-volume (c.50 dials per day), high-quality pipeline of SME prospects, utilising data-driven lists provided directly to you

  • Unlock revenue through outbound execution and consultative selling - with no cold business development required!

  • Manage the entire commercial lifecycle end-to-end, independently understanding business goals and identifying financial solutions that set up our borrowers to win

  • Establish instant rapport with your customers via telephone and email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Be responsible for your own monthly target and continuously develop and improve your approach to help you get there

  • Proactively problem-solve, identifying and confidently mitigating risks, issues or control weaknesses that arise in your day-to-day, using a variety of tools, including Generative AI

  • Mentor junior colleagues, contributing to lifting performance across the team and to championing our collaborative sales culture

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • Proven success in B2B sales with a track record of hitting and exceeding sales targets

  • Confident running the entire sales cycle independently, with equal capability in both prospecting and closing

  • Highly organised approach to managing a busy, fast-paced pipeline, keeping deals at multiple stages accurate and moving forward

  • Exceptional telephone skills: you build rapport quickly and simplify complex products for non-finance audiences

  • Resilient, coachable, and motivated by earning potential

  • Confident using approved Generative AI tools to enhance your output and find a better way of working

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

raw.title: AI Platform Engineer
raw.description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

 

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building automated workflows. We expect every new hire to bring genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to working smarter and faster with it.

For some, this means staying open to new tools. For others, it means architecting new systems with AI at the core. We're transparent about expectations for every role, and we give you the tools and support to thrive.

About the Team

You'll join our small central AI team. We help every function at Harmonic, from sales to legal, achieve more with AI. People closest to the work bring the ideas and prototype solutions. We provide the shared platform, standards and guardrails, and turn the ideas with the most impact into AI solutions the whole company benefits from.

About the Role

At Harmonic we use AI to help us operate more effectively and scale as a business. You’ll take what works for one person and make it work for everyone: building skills, agents and workflows with AI at their core, and the shared platform where they are deployed and secured. You'll be the first engineer dedicated to this shared platform, working directly with the VP AI Engineering and with support from senior engineers across Harmonic.

Your time will be split roughly evenly between applied AI engineering, building the solutions, and platform and DevOps, the foundation they run on. Early on there is more platform work, as we set up things like agent deployment and a marketplace for sharing AI tools. As the platform matures, the balance moves towards building.

You'll partner closely with TechOps, Engineering, Security and the business teams we build with.

What You'll Do

You will be building and supporting the solutions and platform that let the whole company scale through AI, taking advantage of the latest vendor tools and capabilities. You'll use AI coding tools every day to do your work.

Applied AI Solutions that Work Company-Wide

  • Design and build AI skills, agents and workflows that use the latest models, tools and capabilities, working with the people who do the job.

  • Develop colleagues' ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable, cost effective companywide solutions.

  • Build and deploy shared AI capabilities as skills, agents, connectors and more.

  • Write tests and evaluations from real examples, and run them in CI within cost limits.

  • Monitor shared skills, agents and connectors, maintain and tune what's working, retire what isn't used.

  • Track, experiment with and evaluate the latest AI vendor features and tools as they are released.

Platform & DevOps: The Foundation Our AI-Powered Solutions Run On

  • Build and run shared AI infrastructure as code, reviewed and deployed through CI/CD pipelines, today on AWS, with Terraform and GitLab.

  • Deploy and operate secure connectors (MCP servers) so AI can act with the right constraints and permissions, with secrets managed centrally.

  • Build the pipeline for publishing, versioning and sharing skills, plugins and other AI tools.

  • Maintain and operate scheduled and triggered agents safely, each with its own identity, secrets and monitoring, tracking cost, performance, stability and usage across the platform.

  • Help colleagues build on the platform with docs, templates and support.

  • Create, document and maintain standards for AI solutions, such as how agents are deployed, so other teams can adopt them.

What You Bring

Engineering foundations

  • Demonstrable experience of hands-on DevOps, platform or cloud engineering in a real software team. A substantial internship on real production software counts.

  • Practical cloud infrastructure experience; for example AWS IAM, containers/ECS, S3 and networking basics.

  • Experience writing and reviewing infrastructure as code, for example with Terraform or OpenTofu, and shipping changes through CI/CD pipelines with a standard Git workflow.

  • Python (or similar) for tooling and automation, plus Linux and Docker basics.

Building with AI

  • Enthusiasm for solving real world problems with AI, shown by something you've built beyond using coding assistants, such as an agent, workflow or integration. A personal, university or work project counts.

  • Established day-to-day use of AI coding tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.

  • Awareness of the infrastructure and technical ecosystem that supports AI solutions; for example agent hosting platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, MCP services, plugin marketplaces, LLM APIs and SDKs.

Working with colleagues

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you explain technical choices, trade-offs and limits in plain language, in writing and in conversation.

  • Curiosity about how other teams work: you ask questions to understand a colleague’s problem before proposing a solution.

You don't need to have had an AI job title or an AI background, and you don't need to match every requirement.

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Are bright, curious, learn fast, and enjoy being the first person to build something.

  • See AI as a tool to help you build smarter, faster and better, and want to point it at problems that have real impact.

  • Want to spend at least half your time building AI solutions that colleagues rely on, using the latest tools and capabilities as they emerge.

  • Like being the link between engineers and the people who do the work.

  • Enjoy switching hats, moving between technical implementation and collaborating with colleagues.

  • Like to ship early and iterate.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve and ambiguity is the norm.

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job, it's a chance to help define a category, and to build this chapter of the story from its first page. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

  • Recognized momentum: named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity: join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity: a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits: 401K, generous PTO

  • A small, high-trust team: transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites: past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

  • Real ownership: you'll shape a new part of the company from day one

 

Harmonic's Core Values

 

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work.

You’ll take what works for one person and make it work for everyone: building skills, agents and workflows with AI at their core, and the shared platform where they are deployed and secured. You'll be the first engineer dedicated to this shared platform, working directly with the VP AI Engineering and with support from senior engineers across Harmonic.

Your time will be split roughly evenly between applied AI engineering, building the solutions, and platform and DevOps, the foundation they run on. Early on there is more platform work, as we set up things like agent deployment and a marketplace for sharing AI tools. As the platform matures, the balance moves towards building.

You'll partner closely with TechOps, Engineering, Security and the business teams we build with.

What You'll Do

You will be building and supporting the solutions and platform that let the whole company scale through AI, taking advantage of the latest vendor tools and capabilities. You'll use AI coding tools every day to do your work.

Applied AI Solutions that Work Company-Wide

  • Design and build AI skills, agents and workflows that use the latest models, tools and capabilities, working with the people who do the job.

  • Develop colleagues' ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable, cost effective companywide solutions.

  • Build and deploy shared AI capabilities as skills, agents, connectors and more.

  • Write tests and evaluations from real examples, and run them in CI within cost limits.

  • Monitor shared skills, agents and connectors, maintain and tune what's working, retire what isn't used.

  • Track, experiment with and evaluate the latest AI vendor features and tools as they are released.

Platform & DevOps: The Foundation Our AI-Powered Solutions Run On

  • Build and run shared AI infrastructure as code, reviewed and deployed through CI/CD pipelines, today on AWS, with Terraform and GitLab.

  • Deploy and operate secure connectors (MCP servers) so AI can act with the right constraints and permissions, with secrets managed centrally.

  • Build the pipeline for publishing, versioning and sharing skills, plugins and other AI tools.

  • Maintain and operate scheduled and triggered agents safely, each with its own identity, secrets and monitoring, tracking cost, performance, stability and usage across the platform.

  • Help colleagues build on the platform with docs, templates and support.

  • Create, document and maintain standards for AI solutions, such as how agents are deployed, so other teams can adopt them.

What You Bring

Engineering foundations

  • Demonstrable experience of hands-on DevOps, platform or cloud engineering in a real software team. A substantial internship on real production software counts.

  • Practical cloud infrastructure experience; for example AWS IAM, containers/ECS, S3 and networking basics.

  • Experience writing and reviewing infrastructure as code, for example with Terraform or OpenTofu, and shipping changes through CI/CD pipelines with a standard Git workflow.

  • Python (or similar) for tooling and automation, plus Linux and Docker basics.

Building with AI

  • Enthusiasm for solving real world problems with AI, shown by something you've built beyond using coding assistants, such as an agent, workflow or integration. A personal, university or work project counts.

  • Established day-to-day use of AI coding tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.

  • Awareness of the infrastructure and technical ecosystem that supports AI solutions; for example agent hosting platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, MCP services, plugin marketplaces, LLM APIs and SDKs.

Working with colleagues

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you explain technical choices, trade-offs and limits in plain language, in writing and in conversation.

  • Curiosity about how other teams work: you ask questions to understand a colleague’s problem before proposing a solution.

You don't need to have had an AI job title or an AI background, and you don't need to match every requirement.

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Are bright, curious, learn fast, and enjoy being the first person to build something.

  • See AI as a tool to help you build smarter, faster and better, and want to point it at problems that have real impact.

  • Want to spend at least half your time building AI solutions that colleagues rely on, using the latest tools and capabilities as they emerge.

  • Like being the link between engineers and the people who do the work.

  • Enjoy switching hats, moving between technical implementation and collaborating with colleagues.

  • Like to ship early and iterate.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve and ambiguity is the norm.

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job, it's a chance to help define a category, and to build this chapter of the story from its first page. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

  • Recognized momentum: named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity: join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity: a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits: 401K, generous PTO

  • A small, high-trust team: transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites: past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

  • Real ownership: you'll shape a new part of the company from day one

 

Harmonic's Core Values

 

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As one of Harvey’s founding SMB Account Executives, you'll play a pivotal role in driving growth within the legal and professional services markets. You will be responsible for establishing new business relationships with small law firms and in-house legal teams, deeply understanding their challenges, and delivering AI solutions that transform how they work. By combining a high-velocity sales motion with a consultative, solution-driven approach, you’ll set the foundation for how we win in SMB and create long term impact for our clients. We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments, is energized by building from scratch, and is passionate about bringing Harvey’s mission to life.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own your book of business by prioritizing warm leads and a named account list to maintain a high velocity sales motion.

  • Manage the new business lifecycle from prospecting to qualifying, validating Harvey’s solution, and contracting.

  • Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.

  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.

  • Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations.

  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet SMB customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.

  • Proactively develop tactics, collateral, and messaging to improve the SMB team’s performance, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.

 

What You Have

  • Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology at high velocity.

  • Capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish

  • Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene

  • Ability to lead a multi-threaded sale with executive stakeholders – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

  • Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.

  • Energized by contributing to the development of our team, sales processes, and culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.

You will guide firms from first adoption to Harvey being embedded in how their practice groups work, moving each firm along the AI maturity curve by connecting our technology and legal expertise to its own goals, so partners and associates see undeniable value and the firm builds a lasting AI advantage. You will act as a trusted adviser to innovation leaders and partners, run your book as a portfolio, and orchestrate Harvey's Legal Engineers, Product and Sales teams around each firm.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver the firm's journey: build and run a mutual success plan tied to each firm's objectives, priorities and metrics — practice-group adoption, capacity, client propositions — and deliver kickoffs, implementation reviews, QBRs and executive business reviews to a consistently high standard.

  • Drive adoption across practice groups: move Harvey from pilot to daily use, practice group by practice group, building on proven use cases, working with Legal Engineers on tailored enablement and with partners to sponsor change; go beyond the innovation team to practice group leaders, senior and managing partners, and cultivate champions who enable others.

  • Orchestrate cross-functionally: sequence Legal Engineers, Product, Innovation Partners and the Transformation Office intentionally, and bring the voice of the firm back to Product and Engineering.

  • Prove value and expand: align each firm on measurable outcomes — capacity, realisation, matter economics, client impact — capture value stories and ROI evidence, and qualify and progress expansion with your Account Executive.

  • Run your book and own renewal readiness: know whether each firm is in Defend, Maintain or Grow with evidence; prioritise by value, renewal timing and risk; surface risk early and partner with your Account Executive to renew and expand our strategic partnerships.


What You Have

Ideal candidates for the Enterprise Law Firm CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • 5+ years in customer-owning roles — Customer Success, account management, legal-tech consulting or an innovation / commercial role inside a law firm — with law-firm customers or stakeholders.

  • An understanding of how law firms work: how partnerships make decisions, how practice groups differ, and what partners, associates and innovation teams each care about.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily, can show how it has changed your own output, and have a point of view on how AI changes legal practice.

  • A track record of taking enterprise customers from initial adoption to embedded, organisation-wide use, with measurable outcomes grounded in concrete use cases.

  • Building multi-threaded relationships at senior level and influencing stakeholders who did not buy the product.

  • Strategic planning and revenue-based prioritisation across a portfolio, including early identification and mitigation of risk.

  • Quantifying and communicating business value and ROI to senior legal stakeholders.

  • Working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal Engineering and Product teams; comfort running in-person meetings with executives.

raw.title: Finance Analyst
raw.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to our Financial Planning and Analytics Director, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the way our Finance team manages and interprets financial data. This is a unique opportunity to influence decision-making across the business, helping to drive sustainable growth and operational efficiency through structured, insightful analysis.

Please note that this role is initially offered as a six-month fixed-term position. You will join a lean, collaborative FP&A team and contribute to building a new way of working, where data is clean, accessible, and actionable. You will be part of transformative projects, including system migrations, which will redefine our financial processes and reporting capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Clean, transform, and organise large volumes of financial data from multiple systems into a structured format suitable for analysis.

  • Extract and manage data from ERP and finance systems, including Sage, Adaptive (from Workday), Salesforce, Certinia, and Melon, ensuring consistency and reliability.

  • Collaborate closely with Operations and other stakeholders to aggregate and interpret data for reporting and decision-making purposes.

  • Conduct detailed financial analysis, variance reporting, and forecasting to support senior management in strategic planning.

  • Build accurate, actionable reports and dashboards that provide clear insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Support the development of greater process, structure, and discipline in financial data management and reporting across the business.

  • Work proactively to meet deadlines, balancing multiple priorities and ensuring data integrity.

Qualifications

  • Over 2 years’ experience in financial planning, analysis (FP&A), and forecasting, with hands-on experience extracting data from ERP systems.

  • Strong financial knowledge, with the ability to interpret financial data.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate raw data into reports and actionable insights, and to inform decisions and develop business strategies.

  • Structured approach to streamline and automate processes while maintaining data integrity.

  • You’re great at collaborating with team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Job Description

Reporting to the Deputy CFO in London, you'll contribute to establishing consistent global standards, processes, and controls across revenue assurance and client financial governance, ensuring revenue is accurately captured, recognised, and billed while minimising leakage.

Client Finance teams retain responsibility for day-to-day client financial management and execution, allowing you to act as a senior escalation point and high-impact strategic architect to ensure consistency across markets.

Responsibilities

  • Global Revenue Assurance

    • Partner with senior management and regional Finance teams to review revenue performance, monitor completeness, carryover and monthly billing discrepancies, and uncover missed revenue, underbilling or commercial opportunities.

    • Coordinate global revenue reporting and maintain end-to-end oversight of close-related actions, ensuring identified variances are promptly investigated, assigned and resolved.

  • Central Governance and Regional Client Finance Oversight

    • Partner with regional Commercial Finance Directors to maintain consistent controls, policies and reporting standards across regional Client Finance teams, monitoring adherence, driving corrective actions for recurring operational gaps, and clarifying accountability.

    • Provide central governance across project onboarding, amendments and closures to ensure commercial terms, billing arrangements and accounting setup requirements are accurately captured.

    • Be the central coordination point for systemic and cross-regional revenue or client finance matters, escalating material risks and exceptions.

  • Revenue Integrity and Financial Controls

    • Oversee global revenue consolidation and reconciliation across Encodify, RevOps and Sage, working with regional Finance, Client Finance and Regional Financial Controllers to resolve discrepancies and uphold revenue recognition and accounting controls.

    • Identify gaps in financial controls and implement targeted safeguards to minimise revenue leakage.

  • Client Contract Compliance and Audit Governance

    • Establish central oversight of material financial obligations within client contracts, collaborating with regional Client Finance, Procurement and Legal teams to ensure obligations are identified, monitored and effectively managed.

    • Own the annual external audit client confirmation programme, coordinating distribution, responses and exceptions across regions, while partnering with Financial Accounting to strengthen revenue audit processes and financial governance.

  • Systems, Data Quality and Process Improvement

    • Collaborate with regional Client Finance, Systems and Transformation teams to standardise cross-market workflows and automate revenue recognition, reconciliations, billing and reporting, eliminating manual intervention and accelerating financial delivery.

    • Monitor commercial and revenue-related data quality across Salesforce, Encodify, Sage and connected platforms to ensure reliable, accurate financial information.

Qualifications

  • Qualified accountant with approximately 5 years of post-qualification experience.

  • Experience in revenue accounting, finance business partnering, commercial finance, financial control or revenue operations.

  • Good understanding of revenue recognition, billing, commercial contracts and financial controls.

  • Experience working with ERP, CRM and project management systems.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into reports and actionable insights.

  • Stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge regional and senior Finance teams.

  • A structured approach to streamlining and automating financial processes, reporting and controls.

  • You’re great at collaborating with team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

raw.title: Senior Manager, Engagement
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Professional Services is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced leader to run Legora's Professional Services team, building and developing the people who own our most significant professional services relationships, and setting the standard for how those firms adopt Legora and change the way they work.

This is a role for someone who has led teams through change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed, not hoped for. You will own the performance of the team and the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers: hiring and developing Engagement Managers, setting the adoption strategy they execute against, governing quality and pace, and stepping in at the senior moments that decide whether a programme lands.

That portfolio includes our global relationship with one key Big 4 client, our most significant professional services partnership, delivered by the Engagement Managers in your team across its member firms. You will set the direction for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, hold the programme to account, and be the senior Legora voice in the room when it matters. You will travel when needed to support your team in market and build relationships at the most senior level.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption capability at Legora: designing the playbook the team works from, helping our clients realise measurable ROI, and scaling a function that can carry far more than it does today.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the Professional Services team and own the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers. Specifically, you will:

  • Lead, hire and develop the Professional Services team: set expectations, coach Engagement Managers, run performance and development conversations, and build a bench that can scale with the business.

  • Own the global adoption strategy for the portfolio, including our flagship Big 4 relationship, and hold the team accountable for coherent execution across regions and member firms.

  • Define the adoption playbook the team works from: the change-management approach, stakeholder mapping, operating cadence and target outcomes that make our programmes repeatable rather than heroic.

  • Govern delivery quality and pace: success plans, enablement, value reviews, escalation paths, and intervene where a programme is off track.

  • Act as the senior Legora relationship owner for the most important stakeholders in the portfolio, stepping in at executive moments, QBRs and escalations while your team runs the day-to-day programme.

  • Be accountable for adoption, retention and satisfaction across the portfolio, with clear measurable outcomes and ROI you can defend to clients and internally.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional engagement to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end context across the portfolio.

  • Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.

  • Travel internationally to support your team on the ground and build senior relationships across member firms.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You get satisfaction from making a team better than it was when you found it, and you're comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change.

We're looking for:

  • 8+ years' professional services experience - management consulting, legal, LegalTech or enterprise customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.

  • At least 5 years in a people management role, with a track record of hiring, developing and retaining high-performing teams.

  • Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable — we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms.

  • A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations.

  • Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes — and then making that approach repeatable across a team.

  • A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong cross-functional influence: much of what your team needs sits with Product, Engineering and GTM, and you can bring those people with you without direct authority.

  • Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries, or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.

  • Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident.

  • Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams.

  • High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise, when to act and when to let your team run.

  • A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.

  • Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

The Role

As Technical Delivery Lead, EMEA, you will own how Legora's customers across the region go live and scale. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Delivery Managers who run end-to-end implementations, from SSO to document-management integrations, and you will stay close enough to the work to step into the projects yourself.


This is a player-coach role. You set the delivery standard for EMEA, make sure every customer has a clear path from kickoff to adoption, and act as the link between the delivery team and Sales, Customer Success, Engineering and Product. You will also help shape the delivery playbook as Legora keeps expanding across the region.

What You'll Do

Lead the EMEA delivery team

  • Manage, coach and develop a team of Technical Delivery Managers across EMEA, including hiring, onboarding and performance

  • Allocate projects across the team based on complexity, customer priority and capacity, and keep workloads sustainable

  • Set clear expectations for quality, timelines and customer communication, and hold the team to them

Own delivery outcomes for the region

  • Oversee the pipeline of integration projects from kickoff through go-live, and step in early when a project is at risk

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex implementations, including SSO, authentication, and document-management integrations

  • Track delivery metrics such as time to go-live, project health and customer satisfaction, and report on them to leadership

  • Stay hands-on with select strategic customer projects

Build the delivery engine

  • Standardise how EMEA delivers: playbooks, technical documentation, test plans and rollout checklists that the team can reuse

  • Improve how delivery hands off to support, Customer Success and adoption teams after go-live

  • Work with global delivery leads so that practices stay consistent across regions while reflecting local customer needs, such as data residency and regional security requirements

Work across the business

  • Partner with GtM and Solutions Engineering on scoping and technical feasibility before deals close, so commitments made to customers can be delivered

  • Work with Engagement and Legal Engineering to turn successful go-lives into lasting adoption

  • Bring patterns from delivery projects back to Engineering and Product to influence the roadmap and make future implementations easier


Who You Are

  • Proven experience in technical delivery, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role, including at least 2 years leading or managing a team

  • Strong hands-on background with enterprise integrations and implementation

  • A track record of running multiple parallel implementation projects with a structured, proactive approach to blockers and risk

  • Experience building repeatable delivery processes, not only running individual projects

  • Able to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences, including senior customer stakeholders

  • A strong communicator who builds trusted relationships across customer and internal teams

  • A coach who gives direct, useful feedback and helps people grow

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, one of our EMEA hubs, with the flexibility to work with customers across European time zones

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering software to law firms, in-house legal teams or other regulated, security-conscious customers

  • Familiarity with SSO, iManage, SharePoint or similar document management platforms

  • Experience with EMEA data residency, GDPR and enterprise security review requirements

  • Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

London | Full-time | Onsite, five days a week

Reports to the Workplace Technology Lead

THE ROLE

The IT and AI Enablement function exists to make Legora itself run as well as the product we sell: secure, automated, and improving over time.

As our Workplace Technology Specialist in London, you'll help keep the technology our employees use every day working smoothly, from laptops and onboarding to meeting rooms and office connectivity. You'll report to our Workplace Technology Lead and work closely with Workplace, Office Managers, EAs, and the wider IT team.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You'll take ownership of everyday support requests, follow issues through to resolution, and help deliver office technology projects with direction from the Workplace Technology Lead. It's an opportunity to build your technical skills while making a visible difference to how our London office runs.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Be a helpful, responsive first point of contact for employees. Troubleshoot laptop, application, account, peripheral, and connectivity issues through our shared service desk and in person. Keep people informed and escalate complex issues with clear diagnostics.

  • Help new hires get productive from day one: stage devices, complete approved account and access setup, check equipment, and introduce colleagues to Legora's tools. Support offboarding and equipment returns using established processes.

  • Keep meeting rooms ready to use. Run regular AV checks, troubleshoot conferencing equipment, and support all-hands, events, and important meetings alongside the Workplace Technology Lead and the relevant teams.

  • Support the local hardware lifecycle, including provisioning, inventory, loaners, repairs, replacements, and returns. Keep asset records accurate and flag stock needs early.

  • Troubleshoot basic office Wi-Fi and wired connectivity problems. Gather useful information and work with the Workplace Technology Lead and the IT Systems team on issues that need deeper investigation.

  • Assist with office moves, desk setups, equipment installations, and vendor visits. Follow agreed checklists, test the work, and raise issues for the Workplace Technology Lead to resolve.

  • Help maintain badge readers, cameras, and other office technology by identifying faults and coordinating fixes under established processes. Security owns access policy and monitoring.

  • Write clear support guides and improve repeatable tasks. Help test practical automation and AI-assisted support workflows with the team so common issues become easier to prevent and resolve.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 3+ years of hands-on IT support, workplace technology, desktop support, or similar experience, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You can troubleshoot macOS devices, common business applications, peripherals, and basic network issues. You work through problems methodically and know when to ask for help.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues. You're patient, approachable, and calm when someone needs help quickly.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment. You assess what’s urgent, shift focus as priorities change, and follow through on the work that matters most. You set a high bar for delivery while keeping colleagues informed along the way.

  • You're comfortable following security and access procedures, handling employee information carefully, and escalating requests that need approval.

  • You're curious, willing to learn, and quick to act. You notice recurring problems and suggest practical improvements.

  • You enjoy being present in the office. This role is onsite in London five days a week, helping colleagues and keeping the space working.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with meeting-room AV and conferencing tools such as Zoom Rooms or Neat.

  • Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and an endpoint management platform, plus identity, access, and collaboration tools such as 1Password.

  • Exposure to office networking or physical-security hardware, such as Meraki, badge readers, or Verkada.

  • Experience with an ITSM platform such as Serval, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Freshservice, and an interest in simple scripting or workflow automation.

You don't need experience with every tool listed. Strong troubleshooting, dependable follow-through, and a willingness to learn matter most.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America.

  • Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

  • In-person environment: Office designed for ambitious builders and company provided lunch daily.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
