raw.title: Commercial Account Manager - UK
raw.description:
monday.com is building the AI work platform that not only helps manage and orchestrate work, but also does the work for you. Over 250,000 customers across departments worldwide use monday to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform, where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. From work management and CRM to service and dev, every product in our ecosystem runs on the same AI layer, automating tasks, running workflows, and helping teams deliver exponentially more with less effort.

We move fast with big impact, fuelled by a vibrant, ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations achieve more and outpace their competition.

This is a hybrid position, 3 days a week in our London office.


The role

We are building our UK Commercial Account Management team around one idea: we grow when our customers get real value from monday and can explicitly name the impact it has had for them.

As a Commercial Account Manager, you own a large book of existing customers and a revenue number. Your job is to understand each customer's business, find where monday can do more for them, build the case in their terms, and see it through to signature. It is a high-volume, high-activity role: you will speak to a lot of customers every week. You earn the right to ask for the business by being useful to the people you work with.

What you will do

  • Understand the customer's business first. Ask the questions that uncover what is costing them time or money, and build the business case in their numbers rather than ours.

  • Run a large book with intent. Prioritise your accounts, give the ones with the most potential a proper plan, and make sure no customer goes unspoken to.

  • Grow accounts across the platform. That means more teams, more products, AI that does real work for the customer, and services that help them get there faster.

  • Build your own pipeline. Pipeline is core to the job, not an afterthought. Plan your week around a high volume of customer conversations and protect that time.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery with executives and process owners, then build the deployment strategy with them: which departments, workflows, and use cases move to intelligent, agent-driven execution on the monday AI work platform.

  • Translate that strategy into a scoped and priced services engagement, owning packaging, effort and unit estimation, and the proposals and statements of work that carry it.

  • Define the work clearly enough for someone else to build it, capturing the outcome, the estimate, and the shape of the solution, then bring in the forward deployed consultants and engineers who execute it.

  • Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence.

  • Own AI value realisation inside your engagements, tracking consumption against the plan agreed at sale and diagnosing where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back.

  • Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified.

  • Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner.

  • Feed the practice from the field, contributing the patterns, estimation inputs, and playbooks that make each AI deployment faster than the last.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional services experience in delivery management, engagement management, or technical program management, with significant time in front of enterprise customers delivering successful strategic outcomes

  • Experience in B2B SaaS scoping and delivering software implementation, transformation, or managed services engagements in complex enterprise environments, working in industry-standard work management, project management, or CRM platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with Generative and Agentic AI tools, and a strong understanding of how AI changes the way work gets done.

  • Commercial acumen sufficient to scope, price, and support the sale of services rather than simply deliver them, including effort estimation and statement of work authorship.

  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills, able to establish credibility with executives, articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience, and frame business outcomes for a technical one.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.

  • Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.

raw.title: Senior Account Manager
raw.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing
 
Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.
 

We are seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our Customer Success team in London, tasked with driving the commercial success of valuable customer relationships.

You will step into a pivotal role, taking full ownership of a high-value enterprise portfolio offering our market-leading EV salary sacrifice scheme. You will be responsible for building multi-year growth plans, managing commercial risks, and securing maximum scheme adoption and long-term retention.

This role requires strong gravitas, expert commercial acumen, and an unwavering commitment to translating our mission of sustainable transport into quantifiable success for both our corporate clients and Octopus EV.
 
Please note that you must hold a valid UK driving licence.


This role is based in our Oxford Circus office. We’re pretty flexible, to do this role well we think you need to be in for minimum x2 days per week. 


What you'll do...

  • Drive portfolio growth. Own the account strategy and performance of the largest, most complex and strategically important accounts. Define and execute yearly account plans focused on maximising scheme penetration and expanding the relationship across all areas of the customer’s company.

  • Act a strategic thought leader. Consult with senior stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance, Sustainability) to architect their long term EV benefit or company car strategy. Translate the customer objectives into joint opportunities for scheme success  from initial pitch (where you will act as an influencer alongside the BD team), through onboarding and sustained high level adoption.

  • Own the smooth running of the account. While your focus is strategic growth, you will be the ultimate owner of the account. This means personally tackling and resolving client escalations, navigating internal roadblocks, and alongside our Scheme Delivery team ensuring the scheme's day-to-day operations run flawlessly. 

  • Help shape the Account Management team. You'll be a key part of how the account management team evolves, bringing your gravitas and positive communication to internal meetings and working groups. This means actively coaching and supporting our rising talent, leading by example with your proactive approach and excellent results, and sharing those 'lightbulb moment' learnings that make us all better. 

  • Cultivate Executive Partnership & Influence. Develop and deepen trusted, senior relationships, positioning Octopus EV as an indispensable partner in the customers’ long term business strategy. 

  • Ensure Strategic Account Integrity. Take full ownership of long-term account health and retention. Proactively design risk mitigation strategies for regulatory, commercial, or operational challenges, maintaining maximum scheme participation and minimising churn across your entire portfolio.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Alignment. Act as the primary internal voice of the strategic client portfolio. Direct and align internal teams (Product, Operations, Finance) on client requirements and solutions, ensuring the delivery of a seamless, high-quality experience that meets the needs of major corporate customers.

  • Leverage Data for Strategic Influence. Analyse portfolio data and share customer insights to quantify OEV's value to the customer and proactively influence the OEV Product roadmap and operational processes. 

  • Build expert-level knowledge. Build a deep understanding of your customer businesses, the industry, market risks and opportunities and link this to strategic plans for your portfolio, and future risks and opportunities for Octopus EV.


    • What you'll need...

  • Deep Commercial Experience (6+ years). Progressive, relevant experience in enterprise account management or another relevant commercial role, ideally within a B2B2C environment or where the revenue model is based on usage of the product

  • Accountability for Strategic Growth. Highly results-accountable, with evidence of exceeding growth and penetration targets and proactive risk mitigation across a high-value portfolio. 

  • Advanced Commercial Acumen. Financial literacy and strong commercial acumen used to reach win/win outcomes. Proven ability to lead negotiations with senior finance and procurement stakeholders.

  • Executive-Level Partnership. Demonstrated maturity and gravitas essential for building deep, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Proven ability to influence internal and external strategy and secure buy-in across large, complex organisational structures.

  • Complex Problem Solving. Operate with autonomy, taking full ownership of portfolio performance. Proven ability to design and implement robust solutions for commercial or operational challenges that could impact the entire OEV customer portfolio.

  • Thought Leadership & Senior Communication. A highly articulate and compelling presenter and communicator. Able to confidently present strategic plans and performance reviews to a varied audience.

  • Driving Client Value. Deep passion for client success, with a track record of quantifying and communicating tangible ROI and long-term quantifiable benefits back to clients, ensuring Octopus EV is viewed as an indispensable strategic partner.

  • A Scale-Up Mindset. Demonstrated ability to thrive and lead within a fast-moving, scale-up environment. Able to adjust to change, handle ambiguity, and proactively shape and influence internal process improvements and commercial strategy to support business growth.

  • Industry Knowledge. A genuine passion for sustainability and the EV transition. Knowledge of the EV, employee benefits, and/or automotive leasing markets is a ‘nice to have’.


    • 💚 Why else you'll love it here
  • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
    •  
  • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! 🎁 Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
    •  
  • 🏆 Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership

    • Things to note...
  • 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies
  • 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!
    • About us
     
    The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 
     
    We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.
     
    Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 
     
    We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.
     

    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
     
    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

raw.description:
Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.


🚀 Our Story

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly.

🖍️ This role

This is a forward-deployed solutions role at the front line of Partly's European expansion. You'll be the technical engine behind new-market deals across the UK and the Nordics, turning messy real-world problems into signed pilots and putting genuinely differentiated AI in front of the people who run the repair industry.

Here's what you'd be working with. Partly runs two connected layers. Partly.com is the infrastructure platform, the B2B layer that powers parts data, cataloging, and procurement across hundreds of integrations globally. Partly.ai is the AI tool for repairers, built on top of that infrastructure, that makes finding and sourcing the right part feel like magic. Both are powered by Interpreter, Partly's proprietary foundation model for understanding automotive parts at scale, trained on licensed OEM build data across 52+ manufacturer agreements and continuously sharpened by feedback from thousands of users across our global network. No general-purpose AI model comes close on parts accuracy, and that is what makes agentic procurement automation possible at the precision the repair industry demands.

Your job is to deploy that into markets we haven't cracked yet. Automotive data is scattered around the world in complex, inconsistent formats, and the interesting work is in unifying it into something that drives a customer's business. You'll sit between Sales, Product, and Engineering, resolving the technical blockers that stand between a prospect and a deal, building demos and experimental features that show off what Interpreter can do, and shaping how the product gets built for and applied to each new market.

Why join now: Partly closed a $50M Series B at a $500M valuation and is scaling fast across the UK, Europe, the U.S., and Australasia, in a $1.9 trillion industry that has barely been touched by modern software. You'd be early, close to the founders and the model, and given real ownership from day one. If you like ambiguity, owning a problem end to end, and being the person who makes a deal technically possible with frontier AI, this role is built for you.

💻 What will you do

  • Unblock new-market deals end to end. Own the technical path from first conversation to a signed pilot across the UK and the Nordics: scope integrations, map end-to-end estimating and parts workflows, and, together with the Commercial team, clear whatever stands between a prospect and a yes.

  • Build integrations that make pilots possible. Stand up and debug the connections customers depend on (for example, the CABAS estimating integration for Nordic customer pilots or quick custom interfaces for client-facing demos), working close to the data and the code to get them live in test and beyond.

  • Build demos and experimental features. Create market demos and portal prototypes that prove what Partly can do before committing core engineering, iterating fast on what prospects react to.

  • Run Technical Readiness Assessments. Produce the TRAs that map a customer's systems and dependencies so both sides know exactly what a pilot requires.

  • Turn data into a commercial case. Build value proposition frameworks, calculators, and reporting (for example, insurer reporting dashboards) that show customers the value in their own numbers.

  • Be the voice of the UK and Nordics customer to Product. Translate recurring deal blockers into clear, prioritized product asks, and shape how the product gets built and applied for each new market.

  • Work cross-functionally to hit deadlines. Coordinate across Sales, Product, and Engineering to solve customer problems and keep deals moving.

Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here: https://shorturl.at/iAFUX

🥷 Your skills

  • Comfortable working close to data and code, with the ability to review it independently. You can write SQL, read and debug your way around a codebase, and stand up demos or prototypes yourself rather than waiting on Engineering.

  • Strong technical problem solver and systems thinker. You break ambiguous, messy problems into root causes and generalizable solutions, not one-off fixes.

  • You're not afraid to use any tool available to improve your efficiency, but you understand that you ultimately own the outcome of your decisions.

  • Commercially minded. You understand how a technical decision affects a deal, and you can build the business case (frameworks, calculators, reporting) that moves a customer.

  • Excellent communicator who builds rapport. You hold your own with customers and translate fluently between their world and Partly's Product and Engineering teams.

  • Self-directed and high ownership. You're comfortable being the only solutions person in a market, owning problems end to end with little hand-holding.

  • (Preferred) Experience in a solutions engineering, forward-deployed, or technical pre-sales role, ideally integrating into or selling to enterprise customers.

  • (Bonus) Experience in the automotive, parts, insurance, or estimating space (CABAS, CCC, Audatex/Solera, or similar), or experience building integrations against messy external data formats.

Please note: if you don't have all the skills or experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many people count themselves out. We'd love the chance to learn more about you and why you're exceptional.

🪅Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + equity. We offer competitive salaries and generous equity options for all full-time employees, ensuring everyone shares in the financial upside when we win.

  • Annual global offsite in New Zealand. Travel with the rest of the UK and EU team as we gather and connect for 1-2 weeks at our product and engineering hub in Christchurch.

  • Parental leave: Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work (four days on full pay for your first three months back).

  • Team lunches: Lunch provided daily (Monday to Friday) in the office

  • Flexible working hours: We have flexible working hours and default to working from the office.

  • Season openers & events: We host regular events, including quarterly "season openers" for our UK/EU team, monthly team catch-ups, and weekly happy hours.

  • Healthy body, healthy mind: Every team member gets a £750 annual wellness allowance on a Partly-branded card. Use on gym memberships, rock climbing, physio, massage, GP visits, prescriptions; anything that you or your family, need.

raw.description:
Perplexity is hiring our founding Account Executive in EMEA. As our first seller in the region, you'll build the business from the ground up, landing our first EMEA enterprise customers, shaping how we go to market, and helping lay the foundation for the team that follows. This role is ideal for a tenured seller who loves being in the field, wants to build something new, and is excited to shape the future of enterprise AI.

Responsibilities

  • Drive new business by prospecting, pitching, and closing Perplexity Enterprise across EMEA. We expect early traction to mirror our strongest customer industries in the US, including legal, financial services, healthcare, and professional services, but this person will help shape the initial territory strategy, prioritize opportunities, and lay the foundation for the EMEA team that follows

  • Build pipeline from scratch through outbound, events and your own network

  • Lead the full sales cycle, from first meeting through technical evaluation, security and procurement, negotiation, close and onboarding

  • Build senior relationships with C-suite and technology leaders, championing Perplexity's value and customer outcomes

  • Run high-impact demos and respond to RFPs and technical inquiries

  • Shape our EMEA go-to-market: messaging, pricing feedback, partnerships and the playbook future hires will run

  • Partner closely with US-based Sales, Product, Marketing and Customer Success teams across time zones

  • Meet or exceed individual revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis

  • Keep accurate pipeline and account records in Salesforce

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of full-cycle SaaS sales experience selling to UK enterprise customers

  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding annual revenue targets in a high-growth environment

  • Experience opening a new market, territory or segment, ideally as an early or founding seller

  • Skilled at complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders and decision makers

  • Proven success self-sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting

  • Comfortable operating independently with ambiguity and limited local support

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, comfortable presenting to C-suite executives

  • Experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce)

  • Right to work in the UK

Nice to have

  • Experience as a sales leader who wants to return to carrying a bag

  • An existing network across UK enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling AI or data products

offer.title: Member of Technical Staff (Index Engineer, Search Crawler)

raw.title: Member of Technical Staff (Index Engineer, Search Crawler)
raw.description:
AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure.

  • Develop and optimize indexing strategies that balance performance, freshness, and resource efficiency.

  • Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current.

  • Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput conditions.

  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interface contracts that stay flexible as the system evolves.

  • Define and implement observability across offline and near line pipelines, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals.

  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations as business needs change.

  • Partner with retrieval, ranking, and ML teams to make sure indexing outputs meet their requirements.

  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems.

  • Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust.

  • Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets.

  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability.

  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents.

  • A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.

raw.description:
Perplexity builds frontier intelligence systems for the world's most discerning users. We're rapidly scaling our technical team to meet this ambition, including with Perplexity London, our UK-based research & development hub.

We're seeking an exceptional R&D leader to serve as Site Lead for Perplexity London. As our senior leader in the United Kingdom, you'll shape Perplexity's presence in one of the world's leading AI & technology hubs. You'll exercise functional responsibility over a major technical portfolio, along with organizational responsibility for Perplexity London at large.

Joining Perplexity London as Site Lead represents an opportunity to build and scale a world-class R&D organization in a region known for technical excellence in AI. You'll enjoy autonomy and support from our cofounders (who each possess extensive research backgrounds) to make Perplexity London a leader in the UK AI ecosystem. You'll also help shape the growth of Perplexity Frontier Research in London. This comes with the opportunity to define major parts of our technical agenda across multi-agent orchestration, reinforcement learning, continual learning, systems, and frontier evaluations.

Strong research and/or engineering chops are essential, along with the ability to build strong culture, inspire exceptional team members, and collaborate closely with leaders and colleagues around the world.

 

Responsibilities

  • Head up Perplexity London, taking responsibility for what the site delivers, how it scales and its standing in the UK.

  • Work directly with Perplexity's cofounders & leaders in other offices so London's work connects to company priorities.

  • Shape how the London office runs day to day including its culture and quality bar.

  • Keep a working grasp of the detail weighing in on designs and research plans

  • Be the face of Perplexity in the UK AI community building relationships with universities, labs and at events.

  • Define our R&D agenda in London across numerous areas of AI and other technical disciplines.

 

Qualifications

  • Extensive background in research and engineering, with evidence of real-world impact via shipped systems, published papers, and/or open source.

raw.description:
Accountant

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're seeking an Accountant to join our Finance team and become the backbone of our financial operations. Working day-to-day with the Senior Accountant and Manager – Group Reporting, you'll be responsible for keeping cash flowing, invoices accurate, records clean, and month-end close predictable. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure company where your accuracy and initiative directly enable faster decision-making and smoother operations.

You'll have broad exposure to financial operations across Radiant's global platform — from day-to-day banking and AR/AP to supporting the setup of new entities as we expand. If you're someone who takes pride in getting numbers right, enjoys solving problems, and wants to grow as the business scales, this role offers real visibility and development opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own AR/AP and banking activities that keep cash flowing and vendor relationships strong, processing invoices, payments, and queries with speed and accuracy.

  • Support and gradually own month-end close processes toward becoming predictable and smooth, preparing journals, accruals, and management schedules that leadership can rely on.

  • Assist with and learn revenue billing to ensure invoices go out accurately and on time, supporting clean revenue recognition and customer relationships.

  • Prepare reconciliations (balance sheet, bank, intercompany) that give the business confidence in its numbers, identifying and resolving issues quickly.

  • Support new global entity setups as Radiant expands into new jurisdictions, working with the Senior Accountant and external advisors to ensure proper accounting foundations from day one.

  • Collaborate across finance and operations to understand the business behind the transactions, learning how deals, contracts, and operations flow through the numbers.

  • Assist with year-end financial statement preparation and audit support, ensuring auditors have clean deliverables and the process runs smoothly.

  • Contribute ideas for process improvements and automation - spotting inefficiencies and suggesting ways to work smarter as we scale.

What You'll Bring

  • Part-qualified or actively working towards a professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Experience in accounting or finance, ideally in a fast-paced or multi-entity environment where you've worked hands-on with AR/AP, reconciliations, and month-end close.

  • Solid accounting systems knowledge, strong Excel skills and comfort picking up new tools quickly.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy, you catch errors before they become problems and take pride in clean, reconciled numbers

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, you can investigate discrepancies and resolve them with support from the Senior Accountant.

  • Clear communication and collaborative approach, you work well with the Senior Accountant, colleagues across finance, and stakeholders in operations

  • Strong organisation and time management, you can juggle multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment

  • Intellectual curiosity about the business, you want to understand not just how to process a transaction, but why it matters and how it impacts the company

  • Proactive mindset, you don't just follow processes, you suggest better ways to do them

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Xero or other modern accounting platforms and navigating system migrations

  • Exposure to fast-scaling or multi-entity businesses

  • Familiarity with energy, infrastructure, or capital-intensive industries

What Success Looks Like

AR/AP runs smoothly, invoices are processed on time, and payments happen without friction or escalation.

Month-end close is predictable and efficient, the team trust your work, your schedules, and your ability to own pieces of the close.

Your reconciliations are thorough and timely, you catch issues early, resolve them fast, and the business has clean, accurate numbers it can rely on.

You contribute ideas that improve how we work, suggesting automations or process changes that make the team more efficient.

Why Join Radiant

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Work on a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure business at the forefront of the industry

  • Get broad exposure to financial operations, AR/AP, close processes, entity setup, audit - developing well-rounded accounting skills

  • Be part of a team where you're genuinely valued and your work directly enables business decisions

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield-backed company with resources, mentorship, and genuine growth opportunities

Job Title: Associate, Capital Markets

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring an Associate to join our capital markets team.

You will support the capital markets function responsible for raising, monitoring and refinancing the debt required to build out Radiant’s AI infrastructure platform. Working closely with senior members of the capital markets, investment and executive leadership teams, you will build financial models, prepare lender materials, help evaluate commercial term sheets, coordinate execution and contribute to the development of the group’s financing strategy. You will interact with teams across the business, from procurement and construction to power and operations, to ensure financings are aligned with GPU delivery schedules and capex requirements.

You will operate at the intersection of power, compute, capital and software — gaining exposure to complex financings while helping deploy significant capital into infrastructure assets that will underpin the next era of the AI economy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support all financing activities for new GPU clusters and AI factories, including project financings, GPU / equipment-backed financings, and corporate facilities.

  • Track broad bank / debt capital markets conditions and market developments relevant to our business.

  • Build and maintain financial models covering debt sizing, cash flow waterfalls, covenant and ratio analysis, sensitivities and downside cases.

  • Analyse offtake arrangements and associated credit support to assess bankability and inform financing structure.

  • Draft lender information memoranda, credit rating agency materials and financing recommendations for senior management.

  • Review and comment on financing documentation (e.g. credit agreements, intercreditor arrangements, and security packages).

  • Coordinate transaction execution, including data rooms, due diligence requests, closing checklists and conditions precedent, through to financial close.

  • Support the platform’s preparation for debt capital markets issuance to term out bank and project financings, including analysis of market comparables, pricing and investor appetite.

  • Contribute to financing strategy discussions and the growth of Radiant’s capital markets capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • 4–6 years of credit experience gained in project finance, acquisition finance, debt capital markets, private credit or infrastructure lending, with a working knowledge of debt structuring and credit documentation.

  • Advanced financial modelling skills, including the ability to build and audit project finance and corporate debt models.

  • Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience drafting lender presentations, information memoranda and credit papers.

  • Ability to read and interpret commercial contracts, including customer, supply and financing agreements, and identify financing implications.

  • Experience working with guidance and increasing independence in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, managing multiple workstreams and delivering high-quality work under tight timelines.

  • High levels of ownership, accountability and attention to detail together with commercial judgement, intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for AI infrastructure.

Desirable:

  • Experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, power, utilities or cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure or hyperscaler ecosystems and their financing considerations.

  • Exposure to interest rate, FX, power or commodity hedging.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Produce robust credit analysis, financial models and lender materials that support sound decisions and execution.

  • Help execute financings efficiently from term sheet through closing and post-close, across multiple deployments.

  • Grow into greater responsibility for structuring, negotiation and financing strategy while contributing to a diversified funding base and lower cost of capital.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

  • Solid understanding of UK corporate tax, with working knowledge of EU and US tax regimes.

  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on contributor in a cross functional team, managing advisor relationships.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, and accountability.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a willingness to build processes and take on new challenges as the business scales.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Desirable:

  • Experience in infrastructure, data centres, energy, or technology sectors.

  • Transfer pricing experience, including designing intercompany models in line with OECD guidelines.

  • Experience with tax accounting and reporting (IAS 12 and/or ASC 740).

raw.title: Director, Technical Product Marketing
raw.description:
• Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads.

  • Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software for customers with demanding AI requirements.

  • As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions to provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant.

About the Role

Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing with deep, hands-on knowledge of AI infrastructure, GPU compute and datacenters to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.

The role in brief

  • An embedded role, close to the product, close to engineering, and close to what we are building: end-to-end datacenters purpose-built for large-scale GPU compute and AI model training and inference.

  • You will spend time with infrastructure, datacenter design and operations, product, engineering, solutions, partnerships and the leadership team.

  • You will extract the technical truth from the building (power and cooling design, GPU cluster architecture, networking fabric, how customers train and serve models) and identify what is differentiated.

  • You will turn that into blogs, web pages, whitepapers, case studies, executive thought leadership, speaking narratives and product storytelling.

What this role is not

  • Not a conventional PMM role centred only on launch checklists, personas and sales decks. Our audience is hyperfocused and well understood.

  • Not a technical writing role.

The right person

  • Technically curious, commercially sharp, and an exceptional writer.

  • Deeply technical in data centers / AI factories and AI infrastructure.

  • Understands GPU and accelerator architectures, how frontier models are trained and served, and what those workloads demand of power, cooling, networking and physical design.

  • Knows how to sit with engineers, ask good questions, pressure-test claims, and translate complex infrastructure into language that is accurate, compelling and useful.

What You'll Do

Technical Product Narrative

  • Own Radiant's technical product narrative across our GPU platform, infrastructure, datacenter footprint and market-facing offerings.

  • Work with product and engineering to understand what we build, how it works, what problems it solves and why it is different, from site, power and thermal design through to GPU cluster performance and model workload efficiency.

  • Translate that into positioning, messaging, product explanations and technical narratives for customers, partners, analysts, executives and the broader market.

  • The questions you'll be asking:

    • Why did we build this this way?

    • What breaks at scale: power density, liquid cooling, GPU interconnect, cluster utilisation?

    • What tradeoff did we avoid?

    • What is genuinely differentiated, and what is defensible?

    • What should a technical buyer, such as a model builder or hyperscaler infrastructure lead, care about?

Technical Content & Thought Leadership

  • Create the core technical content that gives hyperscaler and AI lab customers confidence that Radiant is who they should trust to run their most demanding GPU workloads.

  • Formats include:

    • Technical blog posts, product pages and solution pages

    • Whitepapers and reference architecture content (GPU cluster design, high-density rack deployments, liquid cooling, power architecture)

    • Case studies and customer stories

    • Launch narratives and technical explainers

    • Executive essays and long-form thought leadership

  • Make complex topics understandable without making them simplistic.

  • Write for technical buyers, ML and infrastructure engineers, datacenter engineers, business decision-makers, partners, investors and industry observers, adjusting the level of detail without losing credibility.

Web & Product Copy

  • Help shape the language on Radiant's website and product pages.

  • Turn internal product reality into strong external copy that covers:

    • What the product does and who it is for

    • Why it matters and how it is different

    • The proof points that support the claim (GPU performance, power efficiency, capacity, deployment speed)

  • Work with design, web, product and marketing teams to create pages that are clear, technically grounded and commercially useful.

Speaking & Executive Substance

  • Create the technical spine behind talks, panels, submissions, keynotes, podcasts, executive posts and strategic narratives across the AI and datacenter industry calendar.

  • The social and communications team may own the opportunity pipeline and distribution cadence. You provide the substance: the thesis, the architecture, the proof points, the technical argument, the story arc and the language.

  • Ghostwrite for corporate and executive voices where content needs technical depth, product understanding or strategic market framing, on topics such as GPU generations, AI compute supply, power availability and model scaling.

  • Be public-facing yourself: an excellent communicator with a credible presence in the datacenter and AI infrastructure community, able to hold your own on stage and in a room of engineers and AI researchers.

Case Studies, Customer Stories & Proof Points

  • Build Radiant's library of customer, partner and product proof.

  • Work with sales, solutions, customer teams, GPU and hardware partners, and leadership to identify strong stories.

  • Turn them into case studies, web copy, blogs, presentations and sales-supporting narratives.

  • Find the real story behind each account:

    • What problem existed

    • What was deployed (compute, cooling, power, network)

    • What changed for the customer's models and workloads

    • What was hard, what mattered, and what the market should learn from it

Internal Translation

  • Act as a bridge between engineering, datacenter operations, product, sales, marketing and leadership.

  • Engineers should trust you because you ask good questions and represent the technology accurately, down to the GPU, the rack and the megawatt.

  • Marketing should trust you because you can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling language.

  • Sales should trust you because your work helps customers understand why Radiant matters.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days

  • Strong working relationships built with product and engineering.

  • A clear understanding of Radiant's technical architecture, GPU platform, datacenter design and product priorities.

  • A meaningful set of market-facing assets shipped.

  • A repeatable process for extracting technical stories from the organisation and turning them into blogs, web copy, technical narratives, executive content, speaking inputs and longer-form assets.

Over time

  • Radiant has a deeper, sharper, more technically credible voice and is recognised as a leading voice in AI infrastructure and datacenters.

  • The website explains the product more clearly.

  • Our blogs are technical, differentiated, and read by the people who build and run AI at scale.

Who You Are

Experience and technical depth

  • 8–12+ years in technical product marketing, product marketing, technical content, developer marketing, infrastructure marketing, solutions marketing or a closely related role, with a substantial part of that in AI infrastructure, GPU compute or datacenters.

  • A background in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, datacenters or high-performance computing.

  • Deep technical AI experience (essential): you understand how GPUs and accelerators work, how models are trained and served, and how those workloads drive compute, networking, power and cooling design. A technical degree is preferred.

  • You know datacenters from the inside: power density, liquid and air cooling, electrical and mechanical design, capacity planning and build-out, with a visible presence or network in the datacenter community.

  • Technically fluent enough to work directly with product managers, engineers, architects, ML practitioners, datacenter engineers and technical executives. You don't need to be an engineer, but you understand complex systems, from GPU interconnects and cluster topology to the power and thermal envelope of a hall.

  • You keep up with the market: GPU roadmaps, model releases and datacenter developments, and you can explain what each new generation means for infrastructure.

Writing and judgment

  • An excellent writer who can produce product pages, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, executive essays, launch narratives and technical explainers on GPU infrastructure, AI models and datacenter design with minimal handholding.

  • Strong product judgment: you can distinguish a feature from a benefit, a claim from a proof point, a capability from a differentiated position, and a generic AI market trend from a useful point of view.

  • Strong editorial taste: you know when copy is too generic, too inflated, too shallow or too complicated, and can make technical content sharper without making it flashy or imprecise.

Ways of working

  • Comfortable working in the building: regular face time with product, engineering and leadership is part of the job, as is time on site in our datacenters.

  • Highly autonomous: you don't wait for perfect briefs. You find the right people, ask the right questions, create the draft, pressure-test the claims and move the work forward.

  • Commercially aware: you understand that technical marketing exists to help the market understand the company, help customers evaluate the product, help sales tell the story, help executives communicate clearly, and help the company build credibility in a highly competitive AI infrastructure market.

Ideal Background

  • Where you've worked: high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, GPU cloud / neocloud providers, hyperscale and colocation datacenter operators, AI model companies, cloud platforms, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems (particularly GPU and accelerator vendors), or technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

  • Strongly preferred: experience working with engineers, architects, ML researchers, datacenter design teams, product leaders, founders or technical executives.

  • Required: experience writing about complex technical topics for external audiences, specifically on GPU compute, AI models and datacenter infrastructure.

  • Strong advantage: a track record of speaking, publishing or being visibly active in the AI infrastructure or datacenter community.

To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.

raw.title: Group Finance Director
raw.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Group Finance Director to lead across financial reporting, financial planning, strategic finance and finance operations.

This is a highly visible role working directly with the executive team and shareholders that will interact with all parts of the business from procurement to operations. You will lead the finance function on a day-to day basis and build scalable processes to support business growth.

What You'll Do

  • Leadership and development of group finance functions, overseeing all aspects across; FP&A, Controllership, Treasury and Finance Operations

  • Provide support for the process around acquisitions and strategic partnerships

  • Build meaningful relationships with customers and suppliers ensuring best in class working capital management, overseeing AR, AP, payroll

  • Manage debt compliance in project finance and SPV environment, managing complex organisation structure.

  • Manage customer and supplier onboarding as well as shareholder requests

  • Develop and review the annual budget, forecast and scenario planning process and facilitate monthly business reviews, ensuring the constant measurement of business performance against target.

  • Implement strategies to enhance profit margins through effective pricing, cost control, and operational efficiencies. Own monitoring of key customer and supplier contracts and collaborate across functions to identify opportunities for margin improvement and ensure alignment with overall business objectives.

  • Document and improve current finance processes, identifying manual workarounds, control gaps and opportunities for automation.

  • Lead or support finance system improvements, reporting enhancements and implementation projects, with external support where required.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to assess ROI, funnel conversion across customer segments.

  • Lead scenario modelling and commercial forecasting to support data-led decision-making.

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel (Director) to join Radiant's Legal Team, working alongside and reporting to the General Counsel as one of the first lawyers in the business. You will take ownership of and lead on contractual negotiations and drafting of a wide range of agreements covering our customers and supply chain, plus areas of compliance and the development of new systems and processes. You will get to shape how the business operates and functions, allowing it to seize opportunities and grow rapidly, whilst managing risk, scaling sustainably and keeping clear long-term goals in focus.

Strong technical legal skills are the bedrock of this role, combined with a strong sense of commercial judgment and the wider risk environment. The answers are not always clear or certain and being able to balance a range of factors and still give clear guidance or make a decision is part of this role.

Your experience will ideally be built in commercial contracting within the data centre and AI space or, more generally, IT or technology, alongside developing or running in-house compliance programmes.

You will work across hyperscaler and enterprise customer contracts, supply chain arrangements and data centre agreements. Integrating with our debt financing and understanding and managing how that impacts and shapes so much of what we do will be critical. Supporting or leading on ABC and other areas of compliance will be essential.

Additional areas of work will be numerous. You need to be at ease with being out of your comfort zone, bringing your experience and intelligence to new areas and will view this as a great opportunity to grow and expand rather than just turning up 9 to 5. This is a role for someone who gets stuck in: happy leading on and owning work, working collaboratively cross-function, figuring out the answers and coming up with solutions, as well as guiding others, as Radiant builds its Legal function to enable the business to succeed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead on the negotiation and drafting of complex hyperscaler and enterprise customer contracts for GPU as a service, balancing commercial opportunity with risk and managing pertinent regulatory matters.

  • Lead on supply chain agreements for the procurement of hardware and associated maintenance services, along with data centre agreements and FM outsourcing arrangements that underpin how Radiant builds and operates its infrastructure.

  • Understand the importance of financing to our business and how this threads through the Radiant ecosystem. Help ensure our customer and supply chain arrangements enable and are carefully calibrated against our financing requirements. Build connectivity across the business to help manage those requirements throughout their lifetime to keep Radiant well funded, stable and ready to seize future growth when opportunity arises.

  • Advise colleagues, including the C-Suite and Heads of Department on regulatory and contractual positions as deals develop.

  • Assist the General Counsel in developing Compliance at Radiant (including anti-bribery and corruption, data protection, modern slavery and broader corporate compliance).

  • Work with a wide range of business functions to integrate Compliance into how we operate and ensure Radiant meets its legal and regulatory obligations as it grows in scale and expands into new markets.

  • Support the General Counsel and business more widely in maturing and scaling Radiant as it grows at pace. Set-up or help set-up new systems, processes and interconnectivity throughout the group to empower the business, breaking-down or preventing silos and ensuring that decision-making is informed and risk-adjusted yet agile.

  • Partner closely with commercial, procurement, development, operations, technology, and business leadership teams to achieve the business’ goals.

  • Instruct and manage external counsel across multiple jurisdictions where specialist input is needed.

  • Partner with the General Counsel on legal strategy and priorities.

  • Help shape how the Legal function operates as it grows, including developing templates, playbooks and ways of working with the business.

Other Responsibilities May Include:

  • Support or lead on horizon scanning.

  • Help manage the group’s Trademarks portfolio.

  • Support in areas across the business, such as Company Secretarial and Governance, HR, Marketing, Finance and so on.

  • Assist with planning, permitting, power and construction-related matters, drawing on specialist advice where needed.

  • Acquisitions and joint ventures.

Qualifications:

raw.title: Treasury Manager
raw.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our capital markets capabilities with leaders who can combine rigorous underwriting with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As Radiant scales its portfolio of GPU clusters, AI factories, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Treasury Manager to support the Group's treasury function, partnering with the Group Finance Director and Head of Capital Markets to build a best in class treasury operation.

You will play a central role in managing Radiant's cash and liquidity position, supporting bank relationships and financing activities, and helping build out treasury processes and controls as the business scales. You will work closely with finance, capital markets, accounting, and the wider business to ensure the Group has the visibility and controls it needs over its cash, funding, and financial risk exposures.

This is an opportunity to help build treasury capabilities from the ground up within a fast-growing AI infrastructure platform, working alongside senior finance leadership on high-impact, high-visibility initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day cash management activities, including bank account administration, payments oversight, and intercompany funding.

  • Prepare and maintain short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts across the Group, monitoring actual versus forecast performance.

  • Support management of banking relationships, including account opening/closing, KYC processes, and day-to-day bank queries.

  • Assist with the administration of financing arrangements, including drawdowns, covenant monitoring, and compliance reporting.

  • Support treasury-related aspects of financing transactions, including due diligence, documentation review, and liaison with lenders and advisors.

  • Monitor and help manage financial risk exposures (FX, interest rate, and counterparty risk), including implementing hedging strategies where appropriate.

  • Maintain and develop treasury policies, procedures, and controls, ensuring compliance with internal governance requirements.

  • Prepare treasury reporting and analysis for senior management, including liquidity, debt, and risk dashboards.

  • Partner with the wider finance team on cash forecasting, working capital initiatives, and ad hoc treasury projects as the function scales.

What You'll Bring

  • 5–8 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, banking, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of cash and liquidity management, banking operations, and financial risk management.

  • Experience with financing documentation, covenant monitoring, or debt administration is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with treasury management systems (TMS) or ERP systems including implementation is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and the wider business.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, and accountability when handling sensitive financial information.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a willingness to build processes and take on new challenges as the function scales.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Nice to Have

  • Professional qualification (or progress towards one), such as ACT (Association of Corporate Treasurers), ACA, ACCA, or CFA.

  • Experience in infrastructure, data centres, energy, or technology sectors.

  • Exposure to project or acquisition finance, syndicated debt, or capital markets transactions.

  • Experience with FX and interest rate hedging instruments.

  • Familiarity with treasury management systems (e.g., Kyriba, GTreasury, or similar).

What Success Looks Like

  • Robust, reliable cash flow forecasting and reporting across the Group.

  • Strong, well-managed banking relationships and efficient payment processes.

  • Clear visibility and proactive management of the Group's financial risk exposures.

  • Well-documented and controlled treasury policies that scale with the business.

  • Become a trusted advisor to the wider team.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

  • Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

This may not be the right role for you if: 

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will: 

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems,  email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
